text.body:
dharmo viśvasya jagata: pratiṣṭhā
prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍala granthamālā
mīmāṃsākoṣa:
pañcamo bhāga:
( pa-va )
saṃpādaka: kevalānandasarasvatī
mārgaśīrṣa: kṛṣṇa: 10 bhaumavāsara: śaka: 1882.
bhāratasaṃgharājyamukhyena rāṣṭrapatinā śrīrājendraprasādena ayaṃ pañcamo bhāgaḥ svakarakamalena prakāśitaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ 10 śakaḥ 1882
anukramaṇikā
prakāśakasya nivedanam ... ... ... ... 1-8 śrīkevalānandayateścaritrasāraḥ ... ... ... ... 9-14 granthādisaṃkṣepākṣarāṇi tadvivaraṇaṃ ca ... ... ... 2409-2995 mīmāṃsākoṣaḥ ... ... ... ... ... 2409-2995
prakāśakasya nivedanam
mīmāṃsākoṣacaturthabhāgasya prakāśanānantaraṃ pañcamabhāgaprakāśanaparyantaṃ varṣatrayātmako dīrghaḥ kālo vyatītaḥ |
tatkāraṇaṃ ca gurucaraṇanirmitalekhasya punaḥ saṃskāraḥ kartavya āsīditi |
śrīdurgā rāmaśāstriṇā upādhye ityupanāmnā etat punaḥsaṃskārakāryamaṅgīkṛtya asya bhāgasya paryāyo gurulekhaḥ śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇā vāraṃvāraṃ darśitapaddhatyā pariśodhitaḥ |
asya pañcamabhāgasya yathāpūrvaṃ mudritapariśodhanaṃ ca sūkṣmekṣikayā dharmakośasya kāryakārī- saṃpādakena śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇā nirvartitam |
śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇaḥ etādṛśakāryanirvartana- sāmarthye gurucaraṇānāmapi viśvāsa āsīt |
nyūnātiriktadoṣaparihārāya gurubhistena saha punaḥpunaḥ vimarśo'pi kṛto'sti |
guṇavattāsaṃpattāveva śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇaścittasamādhānami- tyasmākamapi cirakālīno'nubhava iti tasminviśvaśrabhya dharmakośakāryamapi vayaṃ saṃcālayāmaḥ |
adhikaraṇadisaṃkhyā— pañcame'smin bhāge bhāṣyādhikaraṇāni 99, saṃkarṣādhikaraṇāni 43, kevalanandīvṛttyadhikaraṇāni 134, tautātitādhikaraṇāni 25, nyāyāḥ 127, laghusiddhāntāśca 4484 bhavanti |
atha prathamabhāgamārabhya bhāṣyādhikaraṇāni 698, saṃkarṣādhikaraṇāni 227, kevala- nandīvṛttyadhikaraṇāni 590, tautātitādhikaraṇāni 61, nyāyāḥ 1032, laghusiddhāntāśca 17647 iti |
mārgaśīrṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ 10
lakṣmaṇaśāstrī jośī, tarkatīrthaḥ adhyakṣaḥ prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍalasya mukhyasaṃpādakaśca dharmakośasya
asya kośasya kartuḥ
śrīkevalānandayateścaritrasāraḥ
śāntasvānto yogajādātmadharmāt siddhatantraṃ tārayan jaimineryaḥ |
dhanyaṃ dhīraṃ dhāriṇaṃ mokṣalakṣmyāḥ prājñācāryaṃ kevalaṃ taṃ praṇaumi ||
asmadguruḥ śrīkevalānandasvāmī ‘omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharan māmanusmaran |
yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
’ (bha. gītā 8|13) iti bhāgavataṃ siddhānta- manusṛlyāntakāle apunarāvṛttimākāṅkṣan akṣaraṃ brahmaṇe'bhidhānabhūtamokṣāramuccārayan tallakṣyaṃ bhagavantamanusmaran svīyaṃ vinaśvaraṃ dehaṃ parityajya paramaṃ padaṃ prāṇaśe śake 1878 phālgune śuklapakṣe saptamyām |
tena mīmāṃsākoṣe viracitaḥ saṃnyāsāśramapraveśana- ntarameva |
‘brahmacaryādeva pravrajet’ iti jābālaśrutimanusaṃdhānena catuṣpañcāśattame vayasi brahmacaryaṃ samāpya svasaṃthāpitasaṃsthāyāḥ ‘prājñapāṭhaśālā’ ityabhidhayāyāḥ kāryadvirasya saṃnyāsāśrama āśrita āsīt |
parivrajyāyā aṅgīkaraṇottaraṃ antimocchvāsaparyantaṃ tadarthacintanapareṇa dharmabrahmapare ubheye pūrvottaramīmāṃsā vimṛśya vividiṣuṇā'upakārāya (1) padasūcī-sūtrasūcīsahitaḥ adhikaraṇasaṃjñāvimarśayuktaḥ pāṭhabhedacarcānvitaḥ jaiminīya- mīmāṃsāsūtrapāṭhaḥ (mudritaḥ), (2) mīmāṃsākoṣaḥ (kramaśaḥ mudraṇayantrasthaḥ), (3) kauṣītakibrāhmaṇāraṇyakaviṣayakoṣaḥ (mudritaḥ), (4) aitareyabrāhmaṇāraṇyakaviṣayakośaḥ (mudritaḥ), (5) taittirīyamantrasūcī (amudritā), (6) taittirīyaśākhāviṣayasūcī (amudritā), (7) satyāpāṭhasūtraviṣayasūcī (amudritā), (8) śāṃkarabhāṣya- paribhāṣākoṣaḥ (amudritā), (9) advaitasiddhermarāṭhībhāṣāntaram (amudritā), (10) navyavedāntaparamāṇumālā advaitasiddhayantargatasiddhāntavākyakoṣikā (amudritā) ityete granthāḥ praṇītāḥ |
tena praṇītānāṃ amudritānāṃ granthānāṃ hastalikhitāni prājñapāṭhaśālā- maṇḍalasaṃsthāyāḥ saṃgrahe surakṣitāni sthāpitāni santi |
teṣāṃ mudraṇa prakāśanaṃ ca draviṇa- lābhā'ukūlye sati kartumicchāmaḥ |
etat sarvagranthapraṇayanaṃ tena vinaivanveṣāṃ dhanādirūpaṃ sāhāyyaṃ nirvartitam, dhanaparigrahaṃ vāntinagaranibha pravrajyāśramānusāreṇa matvā |
kaumārāvasthāmārabhya saṃnyāsāśramasvīkaraṇakālaparyantamapi dehadharaṇamātraparyāptaṃ bhaikṣa- mamṛtamiva matvā jīvitayātrā tena nirvāhitā |
yauvane eva saṃnyastasaṃkalpasya tasya bāhya- lakṣaṇaparivartanarūpa eva saṃnyāsaparigraha āsīditi tasya brahmacaryovasthācaritraṃ sūcayati |
tasya caritrasārakathane nātrānavasaradoṣaḥ prasarati iti tat saṃkṣiptaṃ kathayāmaḥ |
ā śaiśavāddevāntāntukūlacittavṛttirāsam|
tatkenopaniṣadvākyapravacanaṃ śrutvaiva nārāyaṇa- śākhiṇaḥ buddhistanmayī jātā|
'vākyādevāparokṣī:' iti sadgurukrūpaiva phalitā|
"kāśīto rāmeśvaraparyantaṃ matasvāminaḥ śārīrikabhāṣyapravacanakhyātiḥ prasṛtā''sīt|
bahavo vidvāṃso vāīnagaramāgatya matasvāmino darśanaṃ tatpravacanaśravaṇaṃ ca kṛttvaiva prati- nyavartanta|
rātrau ekāntasamaye sāmāni gāyan 'viṭhṭhala viṭhṭhala, jaya jaya viṭhṭhala' iti bhagavannāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ vā kurvan matasvāmī īśvarapraṇidhāne rata āsīt|
vāīgrāme plegopadrava udbhūtaḥ śake 1826 āśvine māsi|
tasminneva māsi śuddhāṣṭamyāṃ tithau plegasaṃsargadoṣāt tridoṣaprasramimaṃ dehaṃ hitvā mama svāmī brahmaṇyanante līnaḥ|
tadanantaraṃ śake 1287 saṃvatsaramārabhya śāṃkaragītopaniṣadbrahmasūtrabhāṣyapravacanāyāhaṃ pravṛtta:|
"svādhyāyapravacanayostapasyaiva ca āyuḥ kṣapaṇīya iti ahaṃ nirdīrghaṃ vayasaḥ trayoviṃśatitame varṣe śārīrikam, mānasikam, bauddhikaṃ ca balamanukūlamiti matvā|
gṛhāśramo nāvalambanīya ityapi niracinavam|
vinā dravyārjanaṃ na gṛhāśramaḥ kartuṃ pāryate, dravyārjanaṃ ca prāyaḥ savyāpapūjayā lāṃgūlacālanena svābhimānarāhityena ca doṣeṇa vinā kartuṃ na pāryate ityahamadarśam|
atidu:sahaṃ pāratantryam, tasmin svonnatirna śakyeti vāraṃvāraṃ amaṃsi, pratyājñāsi ca yāvajjīvaṃ mithyayā vartiṣya iti|
trayoviṃśatitamaṃ varṣamārabhya tripna- ṣaṣṭhavarṣaparyantaṃ saṃnyāsagrahaṇakṣaṇāvadhi adhyāpanaṃ tapa iti matvā niravartayam|
snānaṃ saṃkhyāṃ yogābhyāsaṃ tṛtīyapraharādau bhikṣāṃ bhojanaṃ nidrāṃ ca vihāya mama sarva: kālo'dhyayanā- dhyāpanayorvyatītaḥ|
madhye madhye prasaṅgānusāreṇa sāmājike rājakīye cāndolne'pi kiñcitkāryaṃ mayā kṛtam|
ayamaṃśa: asmadguro: kevalānandasya marāṭhībhāṣāyāṃ likhitātvātmacaritrāduddhṛtātra saṃskṛte'nudya ca niveśita:|
īśavīyavatsare 1901 asmadguruṇā adhyāpanaṃ prārabdhaṃ goḍabolekulanāmna: sakha- mbhaṭṭasya gṛhe sthitiṃ labdhā|
tryaścatvāro vā vidyārthina: saṃskṛtādhyayanārthaṃ prathamamāgatā:|
varṣadvayāduttaraṃ tena goḍabole-gṛhaṃ tyaktvā gaṅgāpuṇyāṃ kṛṣṇātīrasthaprastaraghaṭṭasaṃnidhau vartamānaṃ svagurusthāne nivāsārthamela prājñamaṭhākhyā saṃskṛtapāṭhaśālā sthāpitā|
asyāṃ pāṭhaśālāyāṃ sāmānyatastriṃśatsaṃkhyākā vidyārthino nyavasan, pañcamahākāvyāni, vaiṣṇava- bhāgavatam, vyākaraṇam, vedāntam, nyāyam, dharmaśāstramanyāni ca darśanāni adhīyata ca|
uttamaśreṇīpraviṣṭāste prathamaśreṇīgatā vidyārthina: apāṭhayan ācāryakāryabhāgaṃ laghukartum|
ete'dhyayanādhyāpanayo: ratā vidyārthina: kramaśa: śikṣitā adhyāpanakāryakauśalamapi prāpnuvan|
dīpādīpāntaramiva ācāryādanya ācāryo'nayā śikṣaṇapraṇālyā prādurabhūt|
bhāratīyaprācīnapaddhatimanurudhya prājñamaṭhe śikṣāvidhiranusṛta:|
parantu kaṇṭhato dāḍharyena pāṭhadhāraṇasya mahimā prācīnapaddhatyāṃ yāvatā āgrahaṇa dhṛta
oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividha: smṛta: |
bhagavadgītā 17|23|
āsīttāvānāgraha: asmadācāryeṇa nāvalambita: |
ata: kaṇṭhata: koṣadhāraṇaṃ parityaktam |
koṣapāṭhasthāne anyatsāhityaṃ kaṇṭhato dhāraṇārthamadhyāpanaviṣayeṣu niveśitam |
kālidāsā- diṣpūpalabhyamānotkṛṣṭaśṛṅgāro'pi pāṭhaviṣayakramamārjita: |
kecidādhunikā api viṣayā itihāsabhūgolalaukikasāhityapadārthavijñānadaya: pāṭhakrame niveśitā: |
laukikavyavahāre ādhunikapāścimadeśodbhūtasaṃskṛteṣva jñānamāvaśyaka miti hṛdi nidhāya tadviṣayāṇi pustakāni ca pāṭhakrame'ntarbhāvitani |
śāstrī dharmopadeśakaśca vartamānadeśakāla- paristhitijño yathā bhavettathāvidha: śikṣakramo'smadācāryeṇa nārāyaṇaśākhiṇā svasaṃsthāyā: kṛte aṅgīkṛta: |
prājñamaṭha: prājñapāṭhaśālākhyāṃ yathā prāptatadāvasareprāptaṃ kathyate |
'samarthavidyālaya:' iti nāmnā viśrutā rāṣṭrīyapāṭhaśālā puṇyapattanamaṇḍalastha 'taḻegāvadābhāḍe 'grāma- saṃnihitavane sthāpitā''sīt viṣṇuṃ govindaputraṃ vijāpurakarakulotbhavaṃ puraskṛtya kaiścit svadeśaṃ vaideśikapāratantryāduddidhīrṣubhirbhādhunikaśikṣitai: |
īśavīye 1910 vatsare briṭiśaprabhubhi: 'samarthavidyālaya: ' āṅglasamāja: virodhaṃ briṭiśaprabhutvasya vidrohaṃ ca rāṣṭrīyaśikṣāmiṣeṇa adhyāpayati ' ityaparādhamāropya vidhvaṃsita: |
katipayyā: prauḍhā vidyārthina: prājñamaṭhāgata rāṣṭrīyaśikṣāpraṇālyā: puna: pravartanārthaṃ vedāntādhyayanārthaṃ ca nyavasan |
svadeśanirmitamātravastukayaṇaṃ paradeśaniṣṭapannavastubahiṣkāra: svarājyārthaprayatlo rāṣṭrīyaśikṣāpravartanaṃ ceti caturvidhaṃ kāryakramamādadha vartitavyamiti eteṣāṃ vidyārthināṃ samuddiṣṭamāsīt |
teṣu kānaḍekulanāmā dinakaraśāstrī, divekarakulanāmā mahādevaśāstrī ca rāṣṭrīyaśikṣāpraṇālyā prājñamaṭhe adhyayanaṃ pravartanīyamiti manasi nidhāya mukhyācārya nārāyaṇaśākhiṇaṃ prati sāhāyyamakurūtām |
īśavīye 1916 vatsare sitambaramāse śake 1838 saṃvatsare āśvine māsi vijayādaśamyāṃ prājñamaṭhasya prājñapāṭhaśālā iti nāmakaraṇaṃ kṛtam |
vidyārthināṃ yatra vidyādhigamastatra jīvanam, na prātisvike gṛhe vāsa: pāṭha- śālāyāṃ ca adhyayanamityevaṃ niyama: asyā: pāṭhaśālāyā: kṛte vihita: |
vidyārthināṃ vasatigṛhe prātarārabhya rātrau śayanaparyantaṃ vidyārthināṃ vividhācaraṇasya viśiṣṭā paddhati- rapyanuśāsitā |
sā yathā- prāta: uṣa:kāle prabodhanasamanāntaraṃ prāta:smaraṇīyasya vaidikasya sūktasya, devatāstotrāṇāṃ rāṣṭrabhaktibhāvānvitagītāṃnāṃ ca sarvevidyārthibhirniryatasamaya uttiṣṭhaitarekatravāsyāya paṭhanam, dantādhavānādiśaucakriyā, śītadakasnānam, saṃdhyāvandanam, sūryanamaskārādi vyāyāma: , śikṣakāṇāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca sāmūhika prārthanā, madhyāhabhojana- samayaparyantaṃ mādhyamikaśikṣākāryakramānusāreṇa uccaśikṣākramānusāreṇa ca vargabhedena pāṭha- grahaṇam, sarveṣāṃ sahabhojanam, madhyāhne bhojanottaraṃ viśrama:, punaśca pāṭhagrahaṇaṃ saṃdhyā- samayaparyantam, saṃdhyāsamaye śārīrikavyāyāmaparā krīḍā prājñaṇe vyāyāmagṛhe vā, sāyaṃsaṃdhyāvandanam, rātrimojanam, svādhyāya:, śayanaṃ ca ityevaṃ prakāreṇa virāmadivasa-
| 8 utsṛṣṭavyā ityetat gurucaraṇamataṃ yuktamāsīditi mayā varṣatrayādūrdhvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tacchākhā- kāryaṃ sarveṣāmaikamatyena viramitam, dharmakośakāryaṃ saṃskṛtavidyāśikṣāya kāryaṃ ca anuvartita- madhyāvat |
gurucaraṇāśca taduttaraṃ parivrājakāvasthāyāmagnyāgneye jaiminīyabādarāyaṇīya- mīmāṃsayormanane, tadanusaṃdhānena granthalekhane, dhyānābhyāse ca ciraṃ sthitāḥ |
prāpte ca prayāṇasamaye dīrghakālaṃ nirantaraṃ nirantarāyaṃ ca japitasya praṇavasyaikākṣarabrahmaṇo vyāhāramuccaiḥ kṛtvā kevalaṃ brahmaṇi līnāḥ |
taiḥ praṇītagranthānāṃ mudraṇaprakāśanakāryasya kartavyatā prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍalasaṃsthayā gurucaraṇānāmumāpākaraṇāya svīkṛtā'stīti |
tasyaitasya gurucaraṇacaritrasārasya saṃkṣipya nivedanaṃ parisamāpyate |
lakṣmaṇaśāstrī jośī adhyakṣaḥ prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍalasya vāī nagarī |

anumitsā ca yādṛśyādṛccha- sattve anumitiḥ sā sā vivakṣitā |
tena ‘pratyakṣamidaṃ vahnijñānaṃ jāyatām’ ‘ālokena vahnijñānaṃ jāyatām’ ityādīcchāsaṃgrahaḥ |
atrāyaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ— tatsādhyatā'vacche- dakāvacchinnasādhyaviśiṣṭapakṣatā'vacchedakaviśiṣṭaminna- viṣayikā, anumititvamapramitivibhājakadharmāvaviṣaka- tacchidvā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā sati tadanyaliṅgatā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā, talli- ṅgatā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā, talli- ṅgatā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā'numityanu- katve sati talliṅgadharmāvaviśiṣṭaliṅgatvāprakārikā- mititvāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā, tadviśiṣṭaliṅgatvāprakārikā- talliṅgakālānyākālaviṣayiṇī yā tadanyānumitsā, tadvirahaviśiṣṭasiddhabhāvaḥ pakṣatā ityarthaḥ |
atra ‘tatsādhyatā'vacchedakāvacchinnasādhyaviśiṣṭa- tathyakṣatā'vacchedakaviśiṣṭaminnaviṣayikā’ iti ni- veśāt ‘parvate vahnumitijāyatām’ ‘pratyakṣātiriktaṃ jñānaṃ jāyatām’ parvate vahnipratyakṣam, tad-vyāpya- parāmarśaḥ, viṣayāntare ca anumitisāmagrībhāvaḥ; tatra ‘yatkiñcijñānaṃ jāyatām’ itīcchādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ |
‘anumititvamapramitivibhājakadharmāvaviṣaka’ iti nive- śāt anumitau pratyakṣatvamadaśāyām ‘parvato vahnimān iti pratyakṣaṃ jāyatām’ itīcchāyā na saṃgrahaḥ |
tacchidvā- tā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikātve sati tadanya- liṅgatā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvāprakārikā iti ni- veśāt dhūmatvāvacchedaka vyāpyatvaparāmarśadaśāyāṃ dravyatvā- vacchedena dravyatvāvacchinnaliṅgatvā'numitīcchāyā na saṃgrahaḥ |
talliṅgatā'vacchedakāvacchinnaliṅgatvā'numititvāvacchichānu- derayatve sati talliṅgatā'vacchedakāviśiṣṭadharmaviśiṣṭa- liṅgakānumititvāvacchinnaliṅgatvādeyikā iti niveśāt ‘dhūmena ālokena ca vahnumitijāyatām’ itīcchā- chāyā na saṃgrahaḥ |
yatra dravyatvasya liṅgatā'vacchedakatvā- nulekhinī ‘dravyeṇa vahnimanuminām’ itīcchā, tasyāḥ saṃgrahaḥ |
tadviśiṣṭaliṅgatvāprakārikātve sati tadviruddha- dharmaviśiṣṭaliṅgatvāprakārikā iti niveśāt yatra ālo- katvasya avacchedakatvānavagāhini ‘ālokena vahnimanu- minām’ itīcchā tasyā na saṃgrahaḥ |
talliṅgakālānyā- kālaviṣayiṇī iti niveśāt ‘pūrvakālī naparvatīyadhūmena vahnumitijāyatām’ itīcchāyā na saṃgrahaḥ |

jyotiṣṭome 'āśvināgrān gṛhṇīyādāmayāvinaḥ' 'śukrāgrān gṛhṇīyādamicarataḥ' 'manvyagrān gṛhṇīyādami- caryamāṇasya' iti aindravāyavāt pare grahāḥ kāmāya śrūyante |

yasya grahasya agratā pāṭhakramena siddhā tāmeva anūdya sasa maho phalatva vidhīyate, na tu agratā vidhīyate |

āśvināgratāśukrāgratā- manvyagratāḥ kāmāya śrūyante |

phalāya |
nityārthena agrasya nityārthā yā pāṭhasiddhā āśvinādīnāṃ agratā tataḥ tada- saṃyogāt tena āmayāvitvādinimittaphalena asaṃyogāt saṃyogābhāvāt |

tat kiṃ ādyapratyakṣaṃ sāvayava-manityam , uta niravayavaṃ nityam ? yadi sāvayava-manityam , tadā tasyāvayavatvena kāraṇatvena ca dravyā-ntarānumānaprasaṅgīkṛtaḥ paramāṇuḥ |
niravayavaṃ nityamityā-śrīyemāṇe uttarottarasāvayavanityakāryadravyasya kāraṇatvaṃ na syāt |
yadyata ghaṭādikāryadravyakāraṇaṃ piṇḍādi tattat-sāvayavamanityaṃ ca dṛṣṭam , niravayavasya cākāśāde-rdvyārambhakatvamapi na dṛṣṭaṃ ato niravayavanityenādyapratyakṣe-gottarottarakāryārambho na sidhyati |
atha satyapi tathā darśane uttarottarakāryadarśanabalāt nityamādyapratyakṣaṃ kāraṇamiti kalpyeta, tarhi paramāṇurpi nityo niravayava eva kāraṇaṃ bhavatu, dvyaṇukamapi nityadravyakāryaṃ bhavatviti tulyacarcam |
nanu asmākaṃ chedaviruddhanityavayavasya kāryadravyasamāśrayākāraṇatve kalpyamāne'pi ubhayasaṃpratipanne ādyapratyakṣe dharmamātrameva kalpanīyam , tatra tu dvyaṇuka-paramāṇurūpadharmakalpanāṃ kṛtvā tatra niravayavanityakāratva-dharmakalpanāmapi na tulyavat |
satyam , dṛṣṭasvarūpe
paramāṇusamarthanam 2447 paramātmanaḥ
ādyapratyakṣe na viruddhadharmakalpanāmucitam , klṛptahāni-prasaṅgāt |
adṛṣṭasvarūpaṃ paramāṇvādikameva kalpyate, ataḥ klṛptahāniparihārāṇāklṛptakalpaneva nyāyyam , itarathā parvatadhūmasya kāraṇatvenādhikalpane lāghavamastītyanya-numānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha dhūmajātīyasyāśrite'nyasyāva-gatatvāt klṛptahāniprasaṅga iti cet , tarhiāpi dravyasya sāvayavānityatvasvabhāvasya klṛptatvāt tatparityāge klṛptahāniḥ samaiva |
evaṃ kriyāśaktindriyādiṣvapi lāghavadanumānaṃ na syāt |
ata evoktam ' pramāṇabala-kalpyāni suhṛdani ' iti |
ataḥ kāryadravyaṃ sama-vāyikāraṇavat ityetāvedānumānatvam , na mahatkāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavat , nāpi kriyāśrayārambhadhamiti |
kiñca kāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavaditi sāmānyāvyāptyupajīvanena ' mahatkāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavat ' , ' kāraṇamapi kāryadravyameva ' ityādi-niṣedhatvam , tathā ca sati mahatvadāvyatirekābhāvāt prayo-jakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati |
tathāhi, itarasāmagrīsaṃbhave'pi yasya vyatirekāt kāryotpādo dṛṣṭaḥ , tasyaiva dharmasya prayoja-katvam , atra tu kāryatve satyapi mahatvadādharmābhāvāt kāraṇatvatvābhāvaḥ |
kacidapi na dṛṣṭaḥ , ataḥ kāraṇaditye-tadeva prayojakam |
kiñca kāryadravyaṃ kāryadravyadharmātiīyaṃ vyāptirubhayopi vādinorvyabhicāriṇī, tava tu ādya-pratyakṣe uttarakāryārambhake vyabhicāraḥ , mama tu paramamahataḥ kāryāt tryaṇukat dvyaṇukasiddhiḥ , dvyaṇukakāryāt paramāṇusiddhiḥ |
nanu paramāṇusvarūpamevabhārambhāt , kimantargatā dvyaṇukakārambhameva ? naivam , mahataḥ kāryadravyasya alpaparimāṇakāryadravyāntaramyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tadanusāreṇa dvyaṇukasya kāryadravyameva kāraṇamanumeyam , viśeṣyateḥ parityāgāyogyāt , paramāṇuśca nityā iti naistyaṇa-kārambhaḥ |
nanu anityāḥ paramāṇavaḥ mūrttatvāt , ghaṭā-divat , tathā sāvayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ sarvadikkatvādvat , ghaṭādivat ityebhirniruktāḥ paramāṇuḥ kathaṃ sidhyati ? sidhyantyeva tairaiva hetubhiḥ |

yathā aśvamedhe ‘īśānāya parasvata ālameta’ iti prakṛtya ‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ iti śrutam, tathā aikādaśinyāṃ ‘tvāṣṭraṃ patnīvatamālabhate’ iti prakṛtya ‘paryagnikṛtaṃ patnīvatamutsṛjati ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ iti śrūyate |

śabdasya pūrva- vaccātha pravṛttipūrvakatvāt yāgapravṛttipūrvakavaccāt |
prakṛte īśānavākyaṃ yadi yāgavidhiḥ paryagnikathaṃ ca paryagnikaraṇa- duttarāṅgapratiṣedhakaṃ syāt tadaiva tulyaśrutitvāt pālī- vatavākyaṃ taduttaraparyagnikaraṇaṃ pāḥ nītavākyasya paryagnikaraṇo- ttarāṅgabhāvāt ‘ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ iti karmā- ntaravidhānaṃ ca upapadyate |

paryagnikṛtānāmutsarge prājāpatyānāṃ karmo- tsargeḥ, śrutisāmānyādāraṇyavat, tasmād brahma- sāmni codanāpṛthaktvaṃ syāt |
vājapeye prājāpatyān paśūn prakṛtya śrūyate- ‘tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti, brahmasāmni ālabhante’ iti |
atra paryagnikṛtānāṃ prājāpatyānāṃ prajāpatidevatānāṃ paśūnāṃ utsargaṃ śrayamāṇe karmotsargaḥ karmaṇa eva utsargaḥ pratyetavyaḥ |
āraṇyavat śrutisāmānyāt, aśvamedhe yathā ‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ iti śrutiḥ tasmānnaiva prakṛtā vājapeyatā śrutiḥ |
evaṃ śrutisāmānyāt āraṇya- vat prājāpatyānāmapi karmotsargaḥ |
yasmāt pūrvaṃ karmotsargaḥ tasmāt brahmasāmni brāhmaṇācchaṃsisāmakāle codanāpṛthaktvaṃ karmāntarasya codanā syāt |
pūrvaṃ saptadaśa paśavaḥ utsraṣṭavyāḥ : brāhmaṇācchaṃsisāmakāle ca apare saptadaśa paśavaḥ ālabdhavyāḥ |

bhāṭṭa--jyotiṣṭome krayasaṃnidhau agnīṣomīyaḥ paśu- rāmnātaḥ, 'sa eṣa aupavasathye'hni savanīyaḥ' itya- smādvacanāt caturthe'hni anuṣṭhīyate |
paśudharmāśca tatraiva paśupākaraṇadāyaḥ samāmnātāḥ |
savanīyaśca paśuḥ saule- 'hni samāmnātaḥ : 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' iti |
anu- bandhaśca ante samāmnātaḥ |
tadiha kiṃ paśudharmāṇāṃ paśu- trayasādhāraṇyam, uta savanīyamātratvam, uta savanīyā- gnīṣomīyabhayārthatvam, uta agnīṣomīyamātrārthatvameva iti cintāṃ mahāprakaraṇatvāt jyotiṣṭomavandanāṃ dharmāṇāṃ paśudharmatvena sākṣāt saṃbandhayogyatā ānarthakyatadannyāyena ( 3|1|9 ) paśuyāgādārā janakatvātgateḥ, teṣāṃ ca madhye kasya cit viśiṣṭa prakaraṇabādhabalavatpramāṇābhāvena aviśeṣāt sarvārthatvaṃ ityāha : ( pakṣaḥ ) |
dvitīyastu satyapi jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇasya paśudharmāgrahāttve savanīyā- vāntaraprakaraṇena tadāha : tasya hi aupavasathye ahnayaiva utpattiḥ |
'āgneyaḥ paśurāmiśe ālabhyaḥ, aindrāma ukthye dvitīyaḥ ; aindro vṛṣṇaḥ ṣoḍaśini tṛtīyaḥ, sārasvatī medhyatirātre caturthī' ityetairvacanaiḥ |
kratupṛṣṭhānāṃ vidhānāt |

aindrādyādideśanāṃ tu saṃsthādhikaraṇanyāyena ( 3|6|16 ) samānavidhānatvābhāvā- deva na paśudharmāgrāhakatvaśaṅkā |
astu vā teṣāmapi avāntaraprakaraṇatvāt dharmagrāhakatvam, naitāvatā sarvārthatvam |
na saule'hani tadvidhiḥ, savanīyoddeśena tasya āśvina- grahagrahaṇakālatvamātravidhāyakatvāt |
yūpaparibyāṇasya 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti sāmānyavidhinā 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti paribyāṇavidhinā vā prāptatvena anuvādāt |
parivyāṇāntare trivṛttvasya raśanāsādhāraṇādhikaraṇe ( 3|6|10 ) eva upādapiṣyamāṇatvāt |

na ca prātaḥ savane utkṛ- ṣṭādeva upasthitiḥ, ānuṣṭhānikopasthiteḥ aṅgagrāhaka- tve'pi prakaraṇāntarapratikatvasya kāpi adarśanāt |
astu vā tat, tathāpi vapyāsāmātrasya prātaḥsavane utkṛṣṭe'pi upākaraṇotkarṣe pramāṇābhāvāt upasthityanu- papatteḥ |

yadyapi ca vapāpracārottara- bhāvipadārthānāṃ tadāyutkarṣanayena ( 5|1|12 ) utkarṣaḥ saṃbhāvyate, tathāpi na tatpūrvabhāvināmupākaraṇādīnāmutkarṣe pramāṇamasti |
vastutastu pūrvairvaidikaraṇanyāyena apūrva- tvāt taduttarabhāvināmapi notkarṣaḥ |
vastutastu 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau śakyārthasya ghoṣā- nvayaprāptāve'pi lakṣaṇādarśanāt tayoścaratkālatvaprāpya- bhāve'pi upālokarotinā vapyāsanālakṣaṇopapatteḥ paśvanapakramo- payogiṣūpākaraṇe sarvapādadvitīyayūpaparibyāṇasya āśvina- grahaṇottarakālavicita eva taduttarabhāvipāgasyāpi āśvinagrahaṇottarakālatvasiddheḥ |
etadākhyavaiyarthyabhiyeva abhyāsāt etasyotpatticihnitam |
tatrāpi itarasya sarvasya dvitīyayūpaparibyāṇādeḥ vākyāntaraprāptatvāt kālaviśiṣṭaṃ śuddhameva vā dravyadevatāviśiṣṭaṃ karmaiva vidhīyate |
tataśca anenaiva vākyena āgneyasavanīyasya etatsamānajātīyasya vākyāntaraiḥ aindrādīnāṃ vidhānāt aupavasathye ahani teṣāṃ punaḥ śravaṇamanuvādamātram |
tathāpi 'yathā vai matsyo'drivaditi janamavadhute, evamete'praśamamānā janamavadhanvante', ityarthavādakṛtasaṃtatakaraṇanimittakanindopa- pādakaitacchadāpekṣitapaśusamarpaṇārthe nindotītadopari- hārārthaṃ ca 'vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti' ityādinā vapāpracārodeśena prātaḥsavanādikālavidhiḥ |
nyaṇḍaśaḥ kālamedenānuṣṭhāne hi madhye smṛtyarthe avakāśalābhāt doṣaparihāraḥ |
yadyapi ca atrāpi kālavidhānaṃ dūrasthakramānu- vādena aśakyaṃ tathāpi arthavāda eva tadupapatteḥ na kaściddoṣaḥ |
yattu pravāraviprakarṣasya upādeyasya guṇasya sattvāt na doṣa iti mūloktaṃ samādhānam, tat vipra- karṣasya aśābdasya vidheyatvābhāvāt upekṣitam |
ato na savanīyasya avāntaraprakaraṇam |
sthānāt agnīṣomīya- yāgāt paśudharmāḥ |
na ca jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe sthānabādhaḥ, paśudharmāṇāṃ śrutyādibhiḥ paśusaṃskāratayā viniyuktānāṃ ayogyatā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe agrahaṇāt |

paśupuroḍāśādhikaraṇam |
amīṣomīyapaśupuro- ḍāśo pāśukameva tantraṃ prasajyate ||
tantrisamavāye codanātaḥ samānānāmaikatanatrya- matulyeṣu tu bhedo vidhivikramatādarthyāt, tādarthya śrutikālanirdeśāt |
bhāṣyam- amīṣomīye paśau puroḍāśaḥ 'amīṣo- mīyasya vapāya pracaryāmīṣomīya paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' kiṃ tasya pṛthaktvena aṅgāni kartavyāni, uta yāni paśau kṛtāni tasyāpyupakurvantīti |
tataḥ sūtraiṇaivopakam |
'tantrisamavāye... kālanirdeśāt' |
tantraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ dharmagrāmaḥ |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayorājyabhāgādiḥ
pūrveḥ, svikṛdādiruttaraḥ |
yeṣāṃ pradhānānām, tāni tantrīṇi pradhānāni |
teṣāṃ samavāye ekadeśakālakartṛtve, codanātaḥ samānānāṃ ekavākyacoditānāṃ ekatantratvaṃ bhavati |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ, yathā ca citrāyāmiṣṭau |
atulyeṣu tu bhedaḥ syāt |
yāni tu codanāto na tulyāni nānāvākyaiścoditāni, teṣu tu bhedaḥ syāt tantrasya |
yathā atraiva 'amīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta', 'amīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? vidhivikramatādarthyāt |
vidhividhānaṃ tadaṅgānāṃ prayogaḥ, tasya prakramaḥ tadarthā pravṛttiḥ |
vidhiprakramatadarthe vijñāyate, atha paśvarthaḥ vidhiprakramaḥ |
na puroḍāśārtha iti |
kathaṃ punaḥ paśvarthatvaṃ vidhiprakramasya ? tādarthya śrutikālanirdeśāt |
śrutyā tatra kālo nirdiṣṭaḥ |
amīṣomaprayanādanantaraṃ paśoḥ kālaḥ |
tatra hi tasya codanā |
vapāpracārādūrdhvaṃ puroḍāśasya kālaḥ |
paśoravarasare yo vidhiprakramaḥ sa kevalaḥ paśvartho vijñāyate puroḍāśasyā- prāptatvāt |
atastasya pṛthak tantraṃ kartavyam |
liṅgaṃ ca paśvarthatāṃ tasya darśayati |
'yadekādaśaprayājān yajati paśumeva tat prayajati, yadekādaśānuyājān yajati paśumeva tadanuyajati' iti |
evakārakaraṇāt avadhāraṇaṃ vijñāyate, paśumeva, na puroḍāśamiti |
ḍup-- tantrisamavāye ... nidaśāt ||
(agnī- ṣomīye paśau) 'amīṣomīyasya vapāya pracaryāmīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti (śrūyate) |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ tasya (paśukebhyaḥ aṅgebhyaḥ) pṛthagjñāni kartavyāni, uta yāni paśoḥ (arthena kṛtāni) aṅgāni, tāni (eva) tasyāpi upakurvanti prasaṅgena iti |
tataḥ etatsandehārthaṃ prasaṅgo'sti nāsti iti vicāryate |
(tatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ) nāsti prasaṅga iti |
kutaḥ ? (uttaratvena sūtraṃ yojayati -) tantrisamavāye (sādhāraṇa dharmagrāma- santram |
sa yeṣām, te tantriṇaḥ, teṣām - ) pradhānānāṃ (amīṣomīyādīnāṃ paśupuroḍāśādīnāṃ ca) samavāye (ekadeśakālakartṛtve sati) codanātaḥ samānānāmaika- tantratvam |
yāni ekacodanayā codyante (ekayā pradhāna- codanayā saha codyante,) teṣāṃ samānatantratvam |
yathā daśapūrṇamāsayoḥ, yathā ca citrāyāmiṣṭau (dadhyādīnām) |
atulyeṣu tu bhedaḥ syāt |
yāni punaḥ (pradhāna-) coda- nāto bhidyante, teṣāṃ bheda eva yathā darśapūrṇamāsasya ca |
tasmāt dviprākālatvāt karmaṇāṃ tṛtīyaḥ prakāro nāsti |
(evaṃ sāmānyānmayāyuktā prakṛte yojayati |
paśu-) puroḍāśāḥ (dāśapūrṇamāsikāt) amīṣomīyāt (puroḍāśāt) vidhyantaṃ gṛhṇāti, paśurapi sānāyāt |
etāvāntideśasya vyāpāraḥ |
(tatra) tayoḥ (paśu- puroḍāśayoḥ) bhinnacoditatvāt na tantram |
loke tu yuktaḥ prasaṅgaḥ pratyakṣagamyatvāt (upakārasya) |
atra pari- codyate, citraite : anudāharaṇam (tantritvena bahuyāgā- bhāvāt) |
katham ? 'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ, tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam' iti (atra) tat ityeka- vacanāntaṃ sarvanāma saṃsṛṣṭaśabdena saṃbadhyate ekavacanā- naiva |
yadi dadhyādibhiḥ saṃbadhyeta, bahuvacanāntaṃ syāt (tāni iti) vīpsā vā (tattat iti), na ca vīpsā śrūyate, na bahuvacanam |
tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭaśabdena (eva) saṃbandhaḥ |
saṃsṛṣṭasya ca (tacchabdānnirdiṣṭasya) prajāpatisaṃbandhaḥ (prajāpatiśabdena saṃbandhaḥ) |
saṃsṛṣṭaṃ caikaṃ vastu |
tasmāt (dravyadevatvāt) eka eva yāgaḥ; kutastantram (iti) |
atrocyate |
dadhyādibhiḥ (evaṃ sarvanāma) saṃbadhyate (na tu saṃsṛṣṭena) |
nirdiṣṭasya hi pratinideśakaṃ sarvanāma (bhavati), nirdiṣṭāni (ceha) dadhyādīni prathamatayā vibhaktyā |
atastāntyeva śabdapāttāni (sākāṅkṣāṇi) parivartamānāni sarvanāmā pratinirdiśyante, na tu kena cit śabdena (dadhyādi-) saṃsarmo nirdiṣṭaḥ yaḥ sarva- nāmā pratinirdiśyeta (tasmāt teṣāmeva nirdeśaḥ) |

paurauḍāśikastu codakaḥ uttasiprāptī karotyeva |
prayoga- vacanastu pāśukrena prayogavacanena upasaṃgṛhītatvāt na praya- gupasaṃgṛhāti upakārān |

natarāṃ padārthānāṃ guṇāḥ |

bhāṣyam-- ekeṣāṃ cārthināṃ aśakyatvāt bhedena kriyā |
yathā vederanuddharaṇasya vratopāyanasyeti |
vediḥ kṛtā anapavṛktā tiṣṭhati |
sā na śakyā kartum |
nahi arthaḥ kṛtaḥ san kartuṃ śakyate |
athocyate, anyāṃ kariṣyatīti |
āhopuruṣikaṃ syāt |
tiryak cāsau bhavet |
tatra dikkṛtaṃ mukheta |
vihārapṛthaktvaṃ śāstramāptameva |
tatra 'ekādaśa- kālakṛtatvamaṅgadhānām' iti sthito nyāyaḥ |
pratyud- dhriyeta |
evamagnuddharaṇaṃ tadāhavanīyanirvṛttyartham |
sakṛ- duddharaṇena ca nirvartito'sau |
na ca nirvartitaḥ śakyo nirvartitum, yathā kṛtaḥ kartum |
athocyate, anya- cchrivartayiṣyatīti |
na tasminnupate dvīyastatra āha- vanīyo'sti |
yat kāraṇam, gārhapatyāhavanīyau ubhā- vekṣasvau |
āhavanīyo'pyātate pariśiṣṭo gārhapatyo bhavati |
yathā sarvasādhāraṇāt auvājyāt upāṃśuyājārtha- mupāyāti pariśiṣṭamanyadevatāthaṃ bhavati |
vihārapṛthaktvaṃ ca pūrvavadāpadyate |
tatra pūrvoktā eva doṣāḥ |
tathā vrataṃ yad gṛhītam, na tat punarrlubdhaṃ śakyate grahītum |
anuṣṭuṣṭaṃ ca tadā pradhānapāvargāt |
ekābhiṣava darśanam |
bhāṣyam-- ekābhi paśoḥ puroḍāśaśca darśayati 'madhye'merāyajāhutīrjuhoti, puroḍāśāhutīḥ paśāhutīśca' iti |
nāgnyuddharaṇasya bhedaḥ |
tasmāt pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puro- ḍāśe prasajyate iti |
śā - sakṛdanuṣṭhitamapi, aṅgaṃ bahūnāṃ pradhānāmeka- deśakālakartṛtvāt na śaknoti upakartum ityetat tantralakṣaṇokta- mupajīvya kimayyamānāviśeṣatvādeva vā evaṃ bhavati, uta 'ase idamanuṣṭhānam, nāsai' ityevaṃ gṛhyamāṇe'pi viśeṣe anyārthamapi anuṣṭhitamapi aṅgamansyapi deśā- dyamede śaknotyupakartum, na tādarthyena punaranuṣṭhātavyamiti cintyate |
iti tantraprasaṅgohetumuttamattā |
tatra 'aṅgāni paśukālāni paśvarthānityasaṃśayam |
anāgate puro- ḍāśakāle nahi tadarthatā |
anyārthānuṣṭhitaṃ cāṅgaṃ nahyanyasyopakārakam |
tadyena kṛtaṃ caiva tathā prakṛtidarśanāt |
' kiñca 'vidhīyamānaṃ kālādau karma sāṅgaṃ vidhīyate |
svakāle'taḥ puroḍāśaḥ kāryaḥ sarvāṅgasaṃgataḥ |
guṇakālakṛtaṃ cāpi vaiguṇyaṃ bhāṣya īritam |
tenāpi na prasaṅgo'sti prāpte'bhi- dhīyate |
vitate pāśuke tantre samāptāgate sati |
madhye patan puroḍāśastantramapajīvati |
codakena puroḍāśo yo vidyantaḥ samarthitaḥ |
aiṣṭikaḥ sa pāśaiva vitato dṛśyate yadā |
tadā tenaiva saṃtuṣṭaḥ puroḍāśavidhiḥ svayam |
prākṛtānāṃ padārthānāṃ na karotyupasaṃgraham |
tasmādasti prasaṅgaḥ |
soma - sūtrārthastu- sādhāraṇāṅgagrāmabhājāṃ samavāye ekadeśakālakartṛttve sati yāni ekacodanācoditāni āgneyādīni teṣāmeva aikatvaṃ syāt, bhinnacodanā- coditeṣu paśupuroḍāśādiṣu aṅgānuṣṭhānasa śrutyā agnīṣomīyapraṇayanānantaralakṣaṇākālanirdeśena paśvarthatvāt puroḍāśārthaṃ tantramedeḥ syāt iti |
vi-- 'paśvarthānuṣṭhito'sti puroḍāśa upakriyā |
asti vā, vidhyabhāvācca, hyatatastvastu lokavat |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'agnīṣomīyasya |
nirvapati' iti śrute agnīṣomīyapaśuyāgāṅgabhūte darśikāgnīṣomīyayāgakṛtike paśupuroḍāśayāge kiṃ pāśukāni prayājādīnyaṅgāni prasajyante, uta bhedenānuṣṭhīyante iti cintāyām, na tāvat pauroḍāśikaṃ codakaṃ prayogavidhiṃ ca prayājādye'pi abhyupagamya kevalamanuṣṭhānaprasaṅga evamabhyupagantuṃ śakyaḥ |
prayogavidhinā vapāpacārāccottarakālaviśeṣāṅgapuroḍāśayāga- prayogavidhau tataḥ pūrvakṛtaprayājādīnāṃ akālakṛtatvena upakārakatvānupapatteḥ |
yadi tu nāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ, apitu paśupuroḍāśamāsādyasakṛdanuṣṭhānasādeśyāt vākyādeva vā paśvaṅgatvāt tatrayogeṇa : pāle'nuṣṭhānasiddheḥ ayaṃ kramavidhiraiva ityucyate, tathāpi puroḍāśāyārthaṃ pradhāna- vidhinaivānuṣṭhāpitānāṃ prākṛtānāmaṅgānāṃ atrākaraṇe vaiguṇyā- pattirnivāryeta |
yatra hi paśvaṅgānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ ca na vailakṣaṇyam, tatra sakṛtkaraṇe vaiguṇyābhāve'pi tantratvavai- ghāpatteḥ na prasaṅgāpattiḥ |
yatra vailakṣaṇyam, yathā paśau ekādaśa prayājāḥ tiṣṭhanti ca paśau pṛṣadājyenānūyājāḥ |
ekādaśa vaikṛtayājyāntarayuktāḥ, puroḍāśe tu prayājāḥ pañca havirāsādanottarakālīnāḥ, anūyājāśca śuddhājyena trayaḥ ityādi |
tatra tritvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ codakenāṅgavatprāptau prayogavidhinā cānuṣṭhāpane kathaṃ puṣkalasyānuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyānāpattiḥ ? |
ato'vaśyaṃ prasaṅgavādinā tadeśe śāstrasyaiva vyāpāraḥ iti abhyupagantavyam |
astu tarhi tadeśe codakastvai'pi prayogavidhilopaḥ |
tathātve puroḍāśadeśapravṛttapuruṣakṛtau prayājādyanukūlyā prayājādeḥ kārakatvābhāvena puroḍāśatvānavāpatyā codakavaiyarthyāt |
prayājādyanuṣṭhānasa paśvaddeśyakatvena puroḍāśahedyakatvā- bhāvāt |
atha puroḍāśayāgānukūlabhāvanāyāmeva prayājādeḥ itikartavyatātvenānanyātadaṅgatvamityucyate, tathāpi anu- ṣṭhānābhāve'pi aṅgacodanākāditadeśādisattve kṛraṇeṣu ava- ghātātideśāpatyā prābhākaramatapraveśāpatteḥ |
atha upakāra- pṛṣṭhabhāvena padārthānāmatideśāt upakāralope iva anyata upakāralabhe'pi na padārthātideśaḥ |
upakārasya siddha- tvena janakāpekṣā'bhāve tadeśe atideśakalpane pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
ata eva puroḍāśātideśena prayājādijanyo vijātīyopakāra eva atidiśyate, na tu tajjanakaprayājā- dikamapi |
ataśca padyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaprayājādibhereva tādṛśavijātīyopakārasya labdhatvāt tenaiva puroḍāśayāge- 'pi yogyatājananarūpopapatteḥ prasaṅgāvirodhaḥ |
ata eva kālasaṃkhyādyabhāvakṛtaṃ na vaiguṇyamapi |
prayājādīnā- mevānatideśena tattṛṣṭhabhāvena teṣāṃ sutarāmanatideśāt |
iti cet, tathā'pi paśvyāgādeśena anuṣṭhita- prayājādyaṅgānāṃ paśvupakāraṃ pratyaiva phalopadhāyakatayā puroḍāśayāgopakārakatvānupapatteḥ |
anyathā svargoddeśena anuṣṭhitadarśapūrṇamāsādiḥ punarutpatyādye'pi utpattyā- patteḥ |
ata paśvarthe kriyamāṇaprayājādyaṅgaiḥ puroḍāśopa- kārakatvānupapatteḥ tadarthaṃ medenānuṣṭheyāni prayājādīni ; na ca 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ' ityādinā aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇaprayājādyuddeśena ekādaśatvādividhānāt sakṛtkṛtaiva taiḥ tantreṇa ubhayopakāropapattiḥ |
'ekādaśa prayājān yajati, paśumeva tat prayajati' 'ekā- daśānūyājān yajati, paśumeva tadanuyajati' ityādinā ekādaśatvādīnāṃ paśvapūrvasādhanībhūtaprayājārthatvagamanena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatayā tantratvānupapattiḥ |
iti prāpte, sa
paśupuroḍāśādhikaraṇam |
paśupuroḍāśanyāyaḥ
yogyatāyā api sāmagrīsattvenotpattau bādhakābhāvāt |
nahi ekaṃ kāraṇaṃ yugapat krameṇa vā ekameva kāryaṃ janayati ityatra niyāmakam asti, ekasyaiva ghaṭasya yugapat krameṇa vā rūparasasaṃyogādyutpādakatvadarśanāt |
kāmoddeśena anuṣṭhitadarśapūrṇamāsajanyapūrvāt nityaprayogīyapāpakṣayasyāpi upapatteśca |
sāmagrībhedasya prakṛte'pi samānatvācca |
ekasmāt kāraṇāt yugapat ekakāryatā'vacchedakatva- cchinnasya ekarūpatveti |
itarathā ghaṭadvayotpattirapi yuga- padāpadyeta |
ata eva 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādau arthavādāpācakāmatadvānurodhena pravṛttaprayojakamānāviṣa- yatvasyaiva uddeśyatā'vacchedakatvena sthāpitatvāt tadava- cchinnasyaiva yugapadutpattiḥ |
nānekasya |
na tarhi krameṇa tasyotpattiprasaṅgaḥ, pūrvotpannakāryaṇa apūrvasya nāśe uttarotpattau āpādakābhāvāt |
na caivaṃ ihāpi prātha- mikena puroḍāśaparamparāpūrve

paśupuroḍāśanyāyaḥ
hi saṃskārapakṣe vyudvacanamarthavādaḥ evamitarasmin pakṣe arthavādo bhaviṣyati |
nāsaṃhānāt kapālavat |
bhāṣyam-- naitadevam |
bhavadīye pakṣe na kiñcidapi hīnam |
yathaiva ekena kapālena yujye upamānyeṣu anyeṣāṃ kapālānāṃ na kiñciddīyate, evamanyayā devatayā paśu- puroḍāśayāge nirvartamāne na kiñcit paśudevatāyā hīyate |
tatra anyudde eva vyudvacanaṃ bhavati |
madīye tu pakṣe devatāprakāśanamaṅgabhūtaṃ hīyate |
anyadetaducyate yat vyudvamapi samṛddhaṃ bhavatīti |
ahīne tu vyudvaśabde uccarite na śabdārtho gṛhyata iti |
grahāṇāṃ ca saṃpratipattau tadvacanaṃ tadarthatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- itthaṃ saṃskārakarmeti |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ saṃ- pratipadyadevatākeṣu graheṣu tadvacanaṃ bhavati puroḍāśavacanam |
' naitāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā vidyante ahupuroḍāśā hyete paśavaḥ ' iti |
na tāvacca vidyante |
vipratipadyadevatākeṣu saṃskārābhāvālocya evamucyate |
grahā eṣāṃ puroḍāśāḥ ' grahapuroḍāśā hyete ' iti |
kiṃ teṣāṃ puroḍāśāḥ sāmānyam ? yadete devatāsaṃskārārthāḥ |
yadi puroḍāśā api devatāsaṃskārārthāḥ, evametadakalpate |
tasmāt saṃskārapakṣaḥ eva śreyān |
mahābhāve ca tadvacanam |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ śrūyate ' naitasya paśorgrahaṃ gṛhṇanti puroḍāśāvane paśuḥ ' iti paśupuroḍāśavattuhetukaṃ mahābhāve śruvan grahapuroḍāśayoḥ ekārthatāṃ darśayati |
tatra grahasya devatāsaṃskārārthatā vijñātā |
yadi puroḍāśo'pi devatā- saṃskārārthaḥ, evametadakalpate |
devatāyāśca hetutvaṃ prasiddhaṃ tena darśayati |
bhāṣyam-- itaśca paśyāmaḥ saṃskārakarmeti |
evaṃ hyāmnāyate-- ' agnibhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ paśāva ālabhyante, kāmā vā agnayaḥ, āgneyāḥ puroḍāśā bhavanti, āgneyā hi paśavaḥ ' iti |
paśudevatāhetukān puroḍāśān śruvan devatāsaṃskārārthatāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ darśayati |
aviruddhopapattirarthapatteḥ śṛtavad guṇabhūta- vikāraḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ guṇabhūtayordharmaḥ pradhānabhūtayo- ramīṣamayordharmaḥ syāditi |
ucyate |
aviruddhā pradhānabhūta- yorapi abhīṣamayordharmo'māmupapattiḥ |
kutaḥ ? arthapatteḥ |
pradhānabhūtavapi prākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ yāganirvṛttiṃ kurvāṇo dvāra- bhūto iti dharmayoriṣyate śṛtavat |
yathā ' śṛte carum ' ' dadhiśrutam ' iti pradānārthe dadhiśte praṇītākāryaṃ kurvāte iti dharmayoriṣyate |
na ca doṣo bhavati |
sa vyarthaḥ syādubhayoḥ śrutibhūtatvād vipratipattau tādarthyād vikāratvam |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ aindavāruṇasāvitrāṇāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ sautrāmaṇīkaraṇatvāt utkarṣaḥ prāpnoti |
tadetaducyate |
sa dvāyāṃ yāgo devatāsaṃskārārthaḥ |
chidrāpi- dhānārthaśca |
ubhayoryayoḥ śrutibhūtatvāt |
ato viprati- padyadevatākeṣu chidrāpidhānārthatayā prakaraṇādutkarṣo na bhaviṣyati |
tadyakaraṇagata evāyaṃ vikāro bhaviṣyatīti |
tasyāpyutkarṣamarthādatvam |
bhāṣyam-- iti yaduktam, tadetaducyate |
vipratipattau tāsāmāsyāvikāraḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ tarhi anena prakāreṇa prakaraṇādanu- tkarṣaḥ |
devatāsaṃskārāstāvat prakaraṇādutkarṣaṃ na śakyate bādhitum |
tatra sautrāmaṇyāṃ saṃpratipadyadevatākā eva codakena puroḍāśāḥ prāptāḥ |
tatra indradayaḥ śabdāḥ paśudevatānāmeva vācakāḥ |
katham ? ekadeśā hi teṣā- mime varṇāntarasahitā uccāritā iti gamyate |
śaknuvanti hi ekadeśāḥ samudāyān |
samudāyaṃ pratyāyya samudāyārthān gamayitum |
yathā gānyādayaḥ |
yathā ca sarasvatīdevatāke nigade ' sarasvatī devanido nirvahaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsasya māyinaḥ ' |
( ṛ.saṃ. 6|61|3 ) iti bṛsaśabdo bṛhacchabdārthaṃ gamayati |
kimarthaṃ punarevaṃ kalpyate ? yato devatāntarāṇi paśudevatāsaṃskārārtheṣu yāgeṣu pratyāyyamānāni anarthakāni bhaveyuḥ |

abhyāso vā prayājavadekadeśo'nyadevatyaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- saṃskārapakṣe eva vāśabdo yuktiṃ vyāva- rtayati, na pakṣam |
na vā ākhyāvikāraḥ |
saṃskārapakṣe anyathā'nupapadyamāne ākhyāvikārā bhavanti |
anākhyā- vikāre'pi saṃskārapakṣaḥ avakalpate eva |
katham ? abhyāsa eva puroḍāśayāgasya bhaviṣyati |
tatra hi codakena paśudevatā prāpnoti puroḍāśaśca |
paśudevatāyā anyat dravyaṃ vidhīyate grahaḥ |
puroḍāśasya anyā devatā |
yāgastu avikṛta eva tiṣṭhati |
sa paśudevatāsaṃbaddhaśca kartavyo grahasaṃbaddhaśca |
tadubhayamapi abhyasyate yāge na saṃbhavati iti arthādabhyasyate yāgaḥ |
tasya ekadeśaḥ anyadevatyaḥ prayājavat |
tadyathā pañcānāṃ prayājānāṃ codakena prāptānāmekādaśasaṃkhyā vidhīyate |
sā ca antareṇābhyāsaṃ nāvakalpate iti abhyasyante prayājāḥ |
teṣāmabhyasyamānānāṃ ekadeśe anyā devatāḥ duḥ |
upāsānaktā ityevamādayaḥ |
evamihāpi abhyāsaḥ puroḍāśayāgasya |
tasmādutkarṣaḥ saṃskārapakṣe'pīti |
ṭup-- asyā ( sautrāmaṇyām ) codakena paśudevatā ( paśupuroḍāśayāge ) prāpnoti, paśupuroḍāśaśca |
tatra paśudevatāyā dravyāntaram ( grahaḥ ) vidhīyate, paśupuro- ḍāśasya ca devatā'ntaram ( indrādi ) vidhīyate |
yāgastu avikṛta eva ( avatiṣṭhate ) yathā'bhyuditeṣṭyām |
saḥ ( yāgaḥ ) abhyasyate yathā somayāgaḥ |
ime sūtrabhāṣye ayukte |
asyāṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ ( pradhānabhūtāḥ ) paśuyāgā ānnāyante, devatāsaṃskāradvāreṇa ca ( teṣu codakena ) puroḍāśāḥ prāpnuvanti |
tatra vācaniko'yaṃ devatāvidhiḥ |

yo aho devatāsaṃbaddhaḥ, sa paśupuroḍāśayāgena na saṃbadhyate |
katham ? aviparivartamānatvāt |
kathamaviparivṛttiḥ ? avidhānāt |
kathamavidhānam ? ( uttaram-- ) atra ( vikṛtau ) upa- kārā atidiśyante ( na padārthāḥ ) yatra ( tu teṣām ) prakaraṇam, tatra viparivṛttiḥ |
tacca prakṛtau ( eva ) |
abhyupetya brūmaḥ |

tatra ( ' somena yajeta ' iti ) somaviśiṣṭo yāgo vidhīyate ( aindrāyāgādīni ca ) grahaṇāni somayāga- dravyasya saṃskārakāṇi |
tāni ( ca sarvāṇi ) grahaṇāni prakaraṇe gṛhyante |
arthāt tatra yāgābhyāsaḥ |
iha ( tu paśu- ) puroḍāśasya grahadevatāyā vā na kaścit saṃskāraḥ ( kriyate ) |

nanu abhyuditeṣṭivat bhaviṣyati |
naitat ( abhyuditeṣṭyā ) tulyam |

na tu iha tathā ( vibhāgavacanam ), yena abhyuditeṣṭyā tulyaṃ syāt |

ānu- mānikastu ( kalpyastu ) grahadevatāsaṃbandhe ( yāgaḥ ) |

' agnīṣomīyaṃ paśu-mālabhate ', ' somena yajeta ' iti ālabhanaṃ yāgaśca apūrva karma vidhīyate ||
dravyasaṃyogodyodanā paśusomayo: prakaraṇe hyana-rthako dravyasaṃyogo nahi tasya guṇārthena |
bhāṣyam - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate - ' yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate ' iti |
tanedamāmantritaṃ ' hṛdaya-syāgre'vadyati atha jihvāyā atha vakṣasa: ' iti |
tathā ' somena yajeta ' iti, tathā ' aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti ', ' maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti ', ' āśvinaṃ gṛhṇāti ' ityevamādi |

kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? samudāyasyeti |
kuta: ? ye ime ālabhatiyajatibhyāṃ karmaṇī vidhīyete-yātāmiti cintyate, pūrvameva te avayavatigṛhṇātibhyāva-gamyate |
na ca avagamyate'rtho vidhīyate |

yajeta svargakāmo vasante vasante iti phalguṇasaṃknyartha: |
' paśumālabheta ' iti ca ālabhatiagnīṣomasaṃvanyārtha: |
api ca ' daśa-tānadhvaryu: prāta:savane mahān gṛhṇāti tṛtīyo hūyate ' iti ca krama: |

acodakācca saṃskārāḥ |
bhāṣyam— evaṃ tāvat prakṛteṣu satsvapi nānuvādau ityuktam |
athedānīṃ prakṛtā eva yāgā na santītyucyate |
kutaḥ ? acodakāḥ saṃskārāḥ |
na ca aindravāyavādibhiḥ yāgā vidhīyante |
tena grahaṇamupakalpyamānaṃ dṛṣṭārtham |
upakalpyamāne tu devatākīrtanamadṛṣṭārtham |
ataḥ ‘aindra- vāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti indrāvāyubhyāṃ saṃkalpayati iti etāvaduktaṃ bhavati |
tatra yāgāmantareṇa saṃkalpayati ityetanna yujyate iti yāgaḥ kalpyeta |
sa evāmnāto yāgo yasmin sati saṃkalpo''vakalpyate |
tasmācca ‘aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ ityevamādibhiḥ yāgā vidhīyante |
prakṛtānāṃ yāgānā- mabhāvāt na samudāyaśabdo yajatiḥ |
tathā ālabhati- śabda iti |
vā— naiva etau samudāyānuvādau, ‘codanā vā'prakṛta- tvāt’ (2|4|10) ityetasādeva hetoḥ |
kathaṃ prakṛtā na sambhavanti ? yataḥ avadyatigṛhṇātyaḥ na yāgānāṃ kṣānāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? saṃskāramātravidhayaḥ, tanmātraparyava- sānāt |
tanmātraparyavasāyini vākye niṣpannakatvāt na aśrutayāgakalpanaṃ śakyam |
evaṃ hi sa kalpyamānaḥ kalpyeta, ‘devatoddeśena gṛhītaṃ dravyaṃ na yāvat yāgena saṃbadhyate na tāvat tadarthatvaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhavati’ iti |
tata evaiṣa anyathānupapattyā yāgaṃ kalpayitumārabhate, tadaiva saṃnihitaḥ pratyakṣo yajiḥ |
aviśeṣāt sarvān dravyadevatāsaṃyogān upapādayitumupasthitam yāgāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ nirupyate |
tasminprāpte kasya samudāyānuvādo bhaviṣyati |
yaduktaṃ āgneyādivat nāparikalpite yajñī vākyāntarā- pekṣeta |
tatra brūmaḥ |
‘puṇyāpāraniyogena vākyaṃ sarvatra pūryate |
tadalabdhe tvapūrṇatvaṃ tallābhe vākya- saṃgatiḥ ||
’ ‘āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati’ iti na yāgādanyaḥ |
puṇyāpāraḥ pratīyate iti prāk tadanumānāt aparipūrṇaṃ vākyam |
iha tu ‘aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti grahaṇabhāvanāyāṃ puruṣo niyujyate |
tatra prāgpi yajya- numānāt asti vidheyaiḥ iti samāptye vākyam |
idaṃ tu anyat, yat tataḥ paramapi kiñcideṣyate |
sarvameva hi vākyaṃ svārthe paryavasyate arthāntarāpekṣāṃ na jahāti, na ca tāvatā tadasamāptaṃ bhavati |
yā tu asau apekṣā, sā vākyāntareṇa pūryyate ityavagamāt na vākyāntarasaṃnadhaṃ na sahate |
tena yajyanumānavelāyāṃ prati- vākyam ‘somena yajeta’ ityasyopasthānaṃ na virudhyate |
‘āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ’ iti tu bhavateḥ apuruṣavyāpārā- tmakatvāt prāk yajeḥ na kiñcit vihitaṃ na kiñcit pratiṣiddham, iti asamāpte vākye, vākyāntare cāna- pekṣite yajiḥ anumīyamānaḥ na vākyāntaragataḥ saṃbadhyate iti vaiṣamyam |
atha yaduktaṃ utpattiśiṣṭayoḥ paśusomayoḥ na vākyāntaragatā vikārapattiryuktā iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
‘dravyeṇānyatabhinnatvena saha cintyaṃ balābalam |
hṛdayādisadṛśamajjatvaṃ paśusomayoḥ ||
’ yaccauta- tsikī paśusomau parityajya atyantātiriktaṃ kiñcit dravyaṃ vidhīyate; tato virodhaḥ syāt |
iha tu paśuneva hṛdayā- didvāreṇa yāgaḥ sādhyate, somena ca rasadvāreṇa |
na ca itikartavyatāsaṃndhe kaścidvirodhaḥ |
paśusomau hi yāga- sādhanatvena codyamānau itikartavyatāmākāṅkṣataḥ |
tatra ca rasahṛdayādibhistadvāreṇa ityevaṃ kathambhāvaḥ pūryyate |
tena anugrāhakatvāt na tatkalpane virodhopapattiḥ |
tatya prākara- ṇikaiḥ krayādibhyaiva prāptatvāt iha dravyasaṃyogo'narthaka iti |
satrāpi ‘acodakācca saṃskārāḥ’ ityevottaram |
nahi te vidhayaḥ somasa paśorvā codakāḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? tayoreva saṃskārāḥ |
tena coditasya dravyasya yathākatha- ñcit upādānena yāgasādhanatve prasakte krayādipadena abhi- ṣavādisaṃskṛtena ca sādhyatayamiti vidhīyate |
na ca mantravarṇasyānyāvihitacchrāgaprāpaṇasāmarthyam, paśucodanā- vihitasya tu saṃdehapyanyatramātramupayujyate |
na cāvadyatiḥ ekāntena yāgamanumāpayati, vinā'pi tena khaṇḍanamātrayā loke vede copapatteḥ |
dravyadevatāsaṃyogastu na kathañcit yāgādinā sthita ityanumānavaiṣamyam |
na ca sānāyyā- vadyatiḥ prakṛtau coditaḥ; atastathaivatvāt, yatastaddharma- prāptirapi syāt |
na cāsya yāgadravyatvaṃ itikartavyatā, yena tadatidiśyeta |
na ca īdṛśaye sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ prakramate |
pūtīkābhibhavaphalasamakṣasotyu vākyaprakaraṇābhyāṃ tādātmyavidhānaṃ ityasamānatā |

kiṃ prāptam ? pūrvo mantraḥ uttaraṃ ( mantra pāṭhena pratyakṣa- ṇaiva ) upasthāpayati |
( yathā ) ' samidho yajati ' iti samāpyamānaḥ tanūnapātamupasthāpayati |
ato dvayorapi samāmnāyapāṭhayoḥ pratyakṣatvāt aniyamaḥ |
iti prāpte, ( brūmaḥ ) |
mantrapāṭho balīyān |
kutaḥ ? ( brāhmaṇa- pāṭhasya viprakṛṣṭatvāt |
tathāhi, ) ' samidho yajati ' ityanena padārtho vihitaḥ |
saḥ anuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ yena vākyena vihitaḥ , tat vākyaṃ smārayati |
tena vākyena smṛtena anuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ sa padārthaḥ smāritaḥ san anu- ṣṭhīyate , ( anuṣṭhitaścau jhaṭityeva ) dvitīyaṃ padārthaṃ na smārayati ( arthānāṃ granthānapekṣatvena paurvāparyasya anava- klaptatvāt ) |
kiṃ tarhi ? anuṣṭhānottarakālaṃ yo'sau kṛtaḥ padārthaḥ , tamālocayati |
sa cālocyamānaḥ yena ( samidho yajatītyanena ) brāhmaṇakhaṇḍena vihitaḥ , tat smārayati |
tacca ( smṛtam ) syāduccaraṃ brāhmaṇa- khaṇḍam ( tanūnapātaṃ yajati ityetat brāhmaṇakhaṇḍa- kam ) smārayati |
tat brāhmaṇaṃ punaḥ padārthaṃ vidadhāti ( punaḥ śabdaḥ tu -śabdārthakaḥ ) |
anuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ tat ( brāhmaṇam ) smārakamapekṣitavyam |
ayaṃ ( mantrapāṭhāt brāhmaṇapāṭhe ) viprakarṣaḥ |
mantraḥ punaḥ ( antaḥkratu prayojyamānaḥ ) parisamāpyamānaḥ uttaraṃ mantraṃ paryupasthāpayati |
sa ca ( uttaro mantraḥ ) paryupasthāpya- mānaḥ uttaraṃ padārthaṃ paryupasthāpyanaiva paryupatiṣṭhate |
tasmāt tatra ( ālocanā- ) apekṣā'bhāvāt nāsti viprakarṣaḥ |
' utpattideśaḥ : saḥ ' iti ( sūtrāṃśasya ayamarthaḥ -- ) pūrvaḥ padārtho vihitaḥ , uttaraḥ padārtho vihitaḥ iti vidyamānānāṃ yaḥ kramaḥ , tena arthavān brāhmaṇapāṭhakramaḥ , nānuṣṭhānakrameṇeti |
( tasmāt mantrakramo balīyān |
) śā-- ' vidhimramabalīyastvamupattāvavadhāra- ṇāt |
utpannaṣu niyukteṣu mantre mantrakramo bhavet |
, naivaṃ smṛtimeveha anuṣṭhānakramo bhavet |
smāraka- kramatvāpi smṛtīnāṃ krama iṣyate |
mantrānnāmnāya- kāryatvāt smṛtyarthī viṣayaḥ punaḥ |
vidhinaiva kṛtārtha- tvāccāvaśyaṃ smārakā matāḥ |
' tasmāt mantrakrameṇai- vānuṣṭhānam , tadabhāve tu vidhirapi smārakaḥ iti tatraiva tatkramasya prāmāṇyam |
soma-- prathamāvagatatvāt yathā pūrvatra pāṭhakramasya prābalyamevaṃ ihāpīti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrā- rthastu --- mantrabrāhmaṇakramavirodhe mantrapāṭhakramaḥ padārthakramaḥ syāt prayogasāmarthyāt mantrasya prayojyapadārthasāraṇe sāmarthyāt , brāhmaṇapāṭhastu utpattideśaḥ iti na prayoga- kāle smṛtyupayuktaḥ iti |

brāhmaṇakramato , maivaṃ mantrakramabalitvataḥ |

' ( 'ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vadhaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe' ityādiḥ pūrṇamāsāgataparvahomamantraḥ |
'amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā dhenuriva bhūya āpyāyamānā' ityādiḥ darśagataparvaṇa- homamantraḥ |
) bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'suveṇa parvaṇau homau juhoti' iti śrutam |
tatra saṃvyābhiḥ karmadayaṃ suparva- devatāviśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
na ca haviḥsamabhivyāhārāt nāyaṃ devatātādvitaḥ ; saṃcadhasāmāyavācina eva yogyatayā devatāparatvopapatteḥ |
tadidaṃ homadayaṃ vikṛtāvātidiśyate na veti cintāyām, prayājavadatideśasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca parvaśabdavācyakarmasamudāyasyaiva devatābhūtasya uddeśyārthe saṃskārāt, tasya ca vikṛtau abhāvāt atideśaḥ, parvaśabdasya kāle mukhyatayā karmaṇo lakṣaṇāṅgīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt |
ato'tra kālasyaiva devatātvāt, tasya cāsaṃskāryatvāt ārādupakārakayoranayoryukta evātideśaḥ |
yadi tu kālasyāpi karmāṅgatvopayogāt smṛtibalena sarvādī smṛta- syāpi punarākālikatvasaṃbhāvanānimittakaśraddhāparihārāya karmadeva smaraṇopapatteḥ sāmavāyikatvalābhāya kālasaṃskāra- katvamabhipreta, tathāpi vikṛtau tatkālīnāyāmatideśe bādhakābhāvāt |
anyakālīnāyāmāpi paśupuroḍāśādivat uddeśanātideśopapatterna kācit kṣatiḥ |
astu vā parvaśabdasya puṇatādeinavācitvāt adhikaraṇavyutpattyā kālavācitvavat bhāṣyavyutpattyā karmavācitvasyāpi saṃbhavatvāt prakaraṇātkarmapara- tvameva, tathāpi parvaśabdavācyasyāpi āgneyādisamudāyasya vikṛtatvāpi devatātvasaṃbhavādādupakārakayoḥ anayoratideśe na kiñcidbādhakam |
yadi tu saṃnipatyopakārakatvalābhāthaṃ devatāsaṃskāratvamabhipreta, tathāpi parvatvasya dānatvāpa- ryāyasya pratyekamāgneyādivṛttitvā samudāyavṛttitvābhāvā- dapūrvasādhanatvena rūpeṇa āgneyādīnāṃ pratyekamevadevatvalā- gateḥ havirbhirśanamantravat vikṛtāvātideśopapattiḥ |
na ca tatra śabdata eva haviṣāpyuddeśyatvāvagateḥ uddeśyāsāhityasya tvāccittvatvāt yukto'tideśaḥ |
prakṛte tu taddhitaśabdena devatātvena eteṣāmupādānāt sāhityaviṣayopapatteḥ |
satyapi vaiguṇyanyāyenoddeśyavācakapadāntarakalpanāyā āgne- yādīnāṃ pratyekamuddeśyatve upādeyatādaśāyāṃ vivakṣita- sāhityānāmāgneyādīnāmeva devatātvāvagamāt, vikṛtau ca teṣāmanupayogitvena saṃskāryatvā'nupapatterdevatāsaṃskārakayoḥ parvaṇahomayornatideśaḥ iti vācyam |
uddeśya- sāmarthyānurodhenāgneyādīnāmapūrvasādhanatvena rūpeṇa devatā- tvāvagateḥ vikṛtāvātideśopapatteḥ |
itarathā svāhākārapaśu- puroḍāśādāvapi agnīṣomatyādineva devatātvāpatteḥ saurya- savanīyādau teṣāmatideśānāpattiḥ |
idaṃ ca sarvaṃ taddhitasya devatāvidhāyakatvamaṅgīkṛtyoktam |
vastutastu viśiṣṭavidhau gauravāpatteḥ, haviḥsamabhivyāhārābhāvena ca devatātādvita- tvānniścayāt parvaṇau bhavo parvasaṃskārakau ca ityevamapi taddhitopapatteryatastathā tadavadhāraṇādyogāt nāyaṃ devatā- taddhitaḥ |
mantravarṇādeva tu kramāvagatāṅgatatvāt devatā- prāptisiddheḥ parvaṇamidaṃ nāmetyameva |
ata eva yājñikānāṃ 'ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vadhaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe' 'amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā' iti mantragatapūrṇamāsāmāvāsyāśabdayoreva tyāgavelāyāmuddeśaḥ, na tu parvaśabdasya |
evaṃ ca tatra- tpūrṇamāsāmāvāsyāśabdayoḥ kāle prayogābhāvāt mantrārtha- paryālocanayā karmaparatvāvagateḥ aikaikasya āgneyādi- trikasaṃskārakatve'pi pūrvoktarītyā paśupuroḍāśādivat sauryādāvatideśe bādhakābhāvāt |
nabuddeśyāṃśasya prayojaka- sattve paramuddeśyadevatopajīvitvāgāśe svarūpeṇa āgneyā- devaitattvaṃ saṃbhavati |
ato yenaiva apūrvasādhanaviśeṣa- rūpeṇa uddeśyāṃśaṃ prati saṃskāryatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa, tyāgāṃśaṃ prati devatātvamiti yukta eva paśupuroḍāśāderiva parvaṇa- homorapi atideśaḥ |
evaṃ vaiguṇyeḍapi yenaiva rūpeṇa apūrvasādhanaviśeṣatvāt pūrṇamāsā uddeśyatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa uttarakālapratiyogitvaṃ dṛṣṭārthatvāt, na tu samu- ditāmevatvādilepeti uddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭi sāhitya- syāmeyatayā avivakṣitatvāt yukta eva vaiguṇyasyāpi vikṛtāvātideśaḥ |
astu vā tatroddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭau sāhityādyavivakṣayāyāmyuttarakālapratiyogitve upādeyatvāt 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā' itivat vivakṣā |
ataśca saume vikṛtyuttaratvaprasaṅgatvat sauryādāvapi paurṇamāsyuttaratvā- bhāvāt nātideśaprasaṅgaḥ |
anyārambhaṇīyāyāṃ tu sāhityā- derivakṣā darśapūrṇamāsātvasya uddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭi- praviṣṭatvābhāvāditi yuktastathā atideśaḥ |
prakṛte parvaṇa- homayostu āśrayikarmatvena paraprayuktadevatopajīvitvāt svarūpeṇa āgneyādīnāṃ devatātvānupapatteryukta evatideśaḥ |
yattu samudāyaparvaprayuktatvān parvaṇahomayoraḥ, vikṛtau na sauryādau tadabhāvādanatideśa iti |
tanna, evamapi vaiśvadevādiparvāṇi tatsattvena atideśāpatteḥ |
prayājāderapi tattadyuktatvena sauryādāvanatideśāpatteśca |
nahi prayājādīnāṃ prakṛtau parvaṇapūrvaprayuktatvam, dviḥkaraṇānāpatteḥ |
apitu samudāyaparvaprayuktatvameva |
atha tasya prayojakatā na samudāyaparvatvena, apitu utsaparvaṇapūrvaparvatveneti teṣāṃ sauryādāvatideśaḥ, tataḥ parvaṇahomayorapi tulyam |
iti prāpte, satyamevam, tathāpi keṣāmapi yājñikānāṃ vikṛtau parvaṇahomānanuṣṭhānāt, ācārasyaiva prakṛtau sāhi- tyasya āgneyāderdevatātvacchedakakoṭi vivakṣā, na tu tasya ca vikṛtau abhāvādanatideśaḥ parvaṇahomādīnām |
ata eva nātideśaḥ tattaddhitārthupadeśenāpyanyathāśruti- kalpanā, gauravāpatteḥ |

aśvasahasramuccame'hani' iti (17|8|136) |

mānave sūtrāntare ca caturthame'gniṣṭomaḥ pāṭhakrameṇa daśama uktaḥ |
ke. pauṇḍarīke gavāyatasya aśvasahasrasya ca dakṣiṇāyāḥ pratyahaṃ vibhajya veyormadhye uttarasyāṃ diśi nayanam |
pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāraḥ, prakṛtitvat, sarvāsāṃ sarva-śeṣatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- pauṇḍarīkaḥ evodāharaṇam |
tavaitat samadhigataṃ sakṛdeva parikraya iti |
asti tu prakṛtau 'mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nīyante' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sarvāsāṃ kāryasya pratyahaṃ nayanam, uta sakṛnnayanam, athavā pravibhajya nayanamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? pratyahaṃ sarvāsāṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtau hi sakalā dakṣiṇāstasmin kāle saṃskṛtāḥ |
ihāpi tadeva sakalaḥ saṃskartavyā iti |
katham ? ahāṃ prādhānyāt |
tadguṇabhāvācca dakṣiṇānām |
sarvā etāḥ sarveṣāmahaḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ |
śeṣabhūtasya yaḥ saṃskāraḥ, sa tenenāhā prayujyate iti |
tasmāt pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāraḥ |
ekārthatvānneti cet |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāra iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? sakṛdeva saṃskāraḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? ekārthatvā-dakṣiṇānām |
ekaṃ kāryamānamanam |

tasmāt sakṛt saṃskaryeran iti |
syādutpattau kālabhedāt |

kiṃ tarhi ? pratyaham |
kutaḥ ? utpattau kālabhedāt |

sarvā-śraitāḥ sarveṣāmahaḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ |
teṣāṃ cāhnāṃ mādhyaṃdināni savanāni bhidyante |

kiṃ tarhi ? vibhajya saṃskuyeran |
kutaḥ ? vacanāt |
dvādaśāhe pratyahaṃ nayanādisaṃskāro vacanāt 'pratyahaṃ 'annahaṃ daśasahasraṃ dadāti' iti |
pauṇḍarīkaḥ dvādaśāhaprakṛtiḥ, na jyotiṣṭomaprakṛtiḥ |

śā-- prakṛtau mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nayanaṃ śrutam |
pauṇḍarīke ca ayutaṃ gavāṃ aśvasahasraṃ ca mādhyaṃdine savane pratyahaṃ netavyam, uta ekasminnahani, athavā vibhajya pratyahaṃ gavāṃ sahasraṃ netavyaṃ aśvasahasraṃ tu ekādaśe ahani niyamiti saṃśayaḥ |
vibhajya nayanamiti siddhāntaḥ |
soma-- pūrvavat pratyahaṃ kṛtsnanayanaṃ na bādhanīya-mityupatānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- pratyahaṃ sarvāsāṃ nayanaṃ syāt, sarveṣaḥsa kṛtsnadakṣiṇāyāḥ śeṣatvāt, mūlaprakṛtau jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdine dakṣiṇāyāḥ nayanasya dṛṣṭatvāt iti |
vi-- 'sakṛt kiṃ pratyahaṃ vā'sya nayanaṃ tatra cottame |
sarvasya vā vibhaktasya, sakṛt saṃskārasiddhitaḥ |
pratimādhyaṃdinaṃ coktaprāpteḥ pratyahaṃ syāt |
sarve tada-katvāt, vibhajya dvādaśāhavat |
pauṇḍarīke asya
dakṣaṇādravyasya kiṃ sakṛt nayanaṃ pratyahaṃ vā nayanaṃ ityekaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
tatra ca uttame dvitīye pakṣe pratyahaṃ sarvasya nayanaṃ vibhaktasya vā nayanaṃ iti dvitīyaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
saṃskāra- siddhitaḥ sakṛt nayanaṃ ityekaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
codakamāpteḥ pratyahaṃ nayanam, tadā'pi pratimādhyādine tadekatvāt sarvaṃ neyaṃ iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvādaśāhavat pratyahaṃ vibhajya nayanaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |

bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, dakṣiṇābheda iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? sakṛdeva dakṣiṇā dīyeteti |

na cāvayavaḥ phalavān, samudāyāt phalaniṣyate |

bhāṭṭa-- ( bhāṣye 17-18 adhikaraṇe ekīkṛtya vyākhyā draṣṭavyā ) |
pauṇḍarīko nāmāhīnaḥ ekādaśarātraḥ |
tatra 'ayutaṃ dakṣiṇā aśvasahasramekādaśa' iti śrutam |
tatra kiṃ pratyahamaśvasahasraṃ gavāṃ cāyutaṃ deyam, utaikameva vibhajya deyaṃ iti cintāyām, satyapi jyotiṣṭome dakṣiṇāyāḥ ahīnātmake dvādaśāhe tathaiva prātāvāpi ca tatra 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' ityanena tattadaharahastvena dvādaśaśatavidhānācca dakṣiṇāyāḥ kṛtsnaprayogadāttattvam, ataśca tattalakṣaṇānnabhavet iyaṃ dakṣiṇā aheṣu prasaṅgādupakarotīti na tato'nyā dīyate |
ataśca pauṇḍarīke'pi pratisutyamatideśena medenaiva dakṣiṇāprāptau aśvasahasramutaṃ ca vidhīyamānaṃ medenaiva dvādaśaśatavat prāpnoti |
vastutastu jyotiṣṭome'pi prayogāṅkarnatvarthatayā sāṅgapradhānārthatvena prātāyā api dakṣiṇāyāḥ 'dakṣiṇā somasya' iti vacanena pradhāna- mātrārthatvāvasāyāt dvādaśāheḍapi pratikarmāvasāyābhi- środakabhedena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatayā savanīyādivatpradhāna- mātrārthe dakṣiṇāprāpteḥ : 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' ityayaṃ vidhirna pradhānārthatvabodhakaḥ ; kintu dvādaśaśātātiriktā- śrādiparisaṃkhyārtha eva |
anvahamiti tu atideśaprāpta- pradhānārthānuvādaḥ |
ataśca pūrvavadeva prakṛtito'pi prati- sutyaṃ medenaiva dakṣiṇāprāpteḥ : tatrāśvasahasraṃ vidhīyamānaṃ medenaiva prāpnoti |
iti prāpte, jyotiṣṭome pradhāna- mātrārthayā api dakṣiṇāyāḥ pradhānaprayogaikatrānatidreva pradhānārthatvam, na tu sākṣāt |
ata eva nāṅgeṣu pṛthak tasyāḥ karaṇam |
evaṃ satyāpi pradhānamātrārthatve : prayo- janaṃ aṅgavikāreṣvanatideśaḥ |
ataśca dvādaśāhe'pi prati- karmāvasāyābhiḥ codakastvadaharmātratvena prāpyamāṇamapi dvādaśaśataṃ tattadahaḥprayogaikatraitadeva prāpyate |
ataścaitanniva pradhānāntareṣvapi na pṛthakaraṇaṃ prāpnoti |
ataśca vinigamanāvirāhadekameva dvādaśaśatamādavante vā dīyamānaṃ sarvapradhānānāṃ saṃpadyate |
ataśca 'anvahaṃ dvādaśa-

śatam' ityanena prāsāyā dakṣiṇāyāḥ punastadaṅgatvena vidhī vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, sakṛtkriyāmātratvena prasaktāyāḥ 'anvaham' ityanena āvṛtticinteḥ |
itarathā aśvā- diparisaṃkhyārthatve anvahaṃ ityasya ānarthakyāpatteḥ |
sā cāvṛttiḥ na dvādaśaśatasya, tatsattulāmātraupakāraka- tayā ekasminnahani dīyamānasya tasya prayogenyena sulāntaropakārakatvāvaśyambhāvāt |

atideśaprāptavayavibhāgavaśa eva avayavaśo vibhajya pratyahaṃ deyam |
ata eva 'saṃpūrṇamayutamasahasraṃ ca pratyahaṃ mārthadinasadhane netavyam, athavā ekasmin kasmiṃścihani' iti pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ mūloktaṃ (18169 sūtra- bhāṣye) upekṣitam, atideśaprāptavibhāgabhāve pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
tadarthamadhikaraṇāntaraṃ tu dhyeyam |

bhāṭṭa - yāni tvaṅgāni ājyabhāgāvāghātādīni paśau na vidyante, tāni kiṃ puroḍāśe kartavyāni na veti cintāyām, puroḍāśabhāvanāyā: itikartavyatāpekṣāyāṃ saṃnihitapāśukodakaprāptitajjanyaupakārāmeva upasthita- tvena svāpūrvajananānukūlayogyatājanakatvamātrakalpanāyā iti- kartavyatākāṅkṣāśānte: na puroḍāśavidhinā svatantrāti- deśakalpanena gauravāt |
ataśca yathaiva gṛhamedhīye klṛpto- pakāraājyabhāgābhāveva nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpanam, tathā prakṛte'pi klṛptaireva upakārāt nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpanānupapatte:, nājyabhāgādīnāmaṅgatve pramāṇa- masti |
ata eva prayojyabhāgāt puroḍāśaprayoga- tridherapi pradhānamātre eva vyāpāra:, na tu ajñānāṃ, tajjanyaupakārārtha vā, ityapi lāghavam |
na ca evamapi ekādaśakapālasaṃpādakasaṃnipatyopakārakāpekṣayaiva ati- deśakalpanam, tathātve gṛhamedhīye'pi tadāpatte: |
vastutastu anauvāsā'dhikaraṇanyāyena ( 7|1|129 ) lokasiddhaikādaśakapālasya grahaṇāt na prayogamadhye tat- raṇāvaśyakatā |
gṛhamedhīyarostu vācanikānāmeva kati- payānāṃ saṃnipatyopakārāṇāṃ pāṭhāt prayogamadhye karaṇaṃ iti viśeṣa: |
ataśca nājyabhāgādī puroḍāśārtha karaṇam |
iti prāpte, pāśukāṅgopakārāṇāṃ puroḍāśāpūrva- jananānukūlayogyatāṃ prati tattadajyātīyāpatvenaiva vastuto janakatve'pi tatkāryakāraṇabhāvabodhakapada ( kalpanāma ) na tāvat puroḍāśāgapradhānabhūtaparvaṇisaṃbandhvaṅgasyopa- kārai: yogyatāṃ bhāvayet ityevihā kalpanā, tathātve apūrvāṇāmapi upajādājanyapātrāṇāṃ etadyogyatājanaka- tvāpatte: |
na ceṣṭāpatti: |

ata: avaśyaṃ svapradhānabhūtapaśusāhacaryopasthitānājyasaṃbandha- bandhajanyabhāvādhitātotkarṣa: |
niruktayogyatāṃ bhāvayet ityeva kalpanā vācya, tada varaṃ svasāhacaryopasthitāmī- pomīyapuroḍāśasaṃbandhapañcajanyaupakārai: niruktayogyatāṃ
bhāvayet ityeva kalpanā |
ataśca yukta eva puroḍāśe aiṣṭikadharmātideśa: |
tena ca sarvopakāreṇa prāpteṣu tatsaṃba- bhāvena padārthatideśavelāyāṃ ya evopakāro nānyato labhyate tadeśe padārthatideśasya tatprayogavidhiśeṣa āvaśyakatvāt yuktameva ājyabhāgādīnām |
ye tūkārā anyato labdhā: , tadviṣaye atideśaprayojanābhāvāt nātideśa: |
padārthānupakārāśe tvasyeva sa: |
yadyapi ca nopakārasya prayagātideśo gauravāt , atideśalakṣaṇasya anyāteśca, tathāpi ekenaivātideśena prākṛtopakāradvārā padārthānāṃ vikalpatvena bodhyatā upakārasyāpi vikṛtisaṃbandhavādhamāt sidhyati tasyāpi atideśaviṣayatvam |
evaṃ ca prasaṅgha- sthale atideśena prākṛtopakāradvārā anyata upakāralābhe eva padārthavidhānāt tadabhāve upakārasaṃbandhasiddhāvapi padārthavidhāyābhāvāt nātideśa: |
padārthānāṃ anuṣṭheya- tvābhāvācca na prayogavidhirapi |
ata eva sarvatra prakṛtau vikṛtau vā aṅgavidhiṣu evaṃ vākyārtha: - 'anyata upakārā- lābhe anenāṅgena yogyatāṃ saṃpādayat ' iti |
ata eva prakṛte'pi daivāt vitatavikṛtiprayogamadhye'nuṣṭhāne prasaṅghena upakāralābhāt na prayājādyanuṣṭhānam |

ata eva tantramadhyapātādikamapi upakāra- lābhopalakṣaṇameva |
ato yatra anyata upakāralābha: , tajjanakapadārtho na vā atideśa:, na vā prayogavidhi: , itarāṃśe tu ubhayaṃ iti siddham |

uktavākyadanantaraṃ 'ṛtumukhaṃ caivā paurṇamāsī saṃvatsarasya, yā caitrī paurṇamāsī' iti śrūyate |
saṃdigdhepu vākyaśeṣāt iti nyāyena sā paurṇamāsī caitrīti niścīyate iti dvitīya: pūrvapakṣa: |
māghī vaikādaśāśrute: |
pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirastan siddhāntamāha |
sā paurṇamāsī māghī māghamāsasya syāt |
kuta: ? ekādaśāśrute: |
somakraye hi ekādaśāśrutirbhavati |
'teṣāmekādaśāṃ kraya: saṃpadyate' iti |
māghyā: paurṇamāsyā: purastāt caturahe dīkṣitasya ekādaśyāṃ māghakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kraya: śakyate kartum |
tasmāt māghī paurṇamāsī iti siddhānta: |
anyā apīti cet |
paurṇamāsyāṃ |
paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe
yasmin kāle bhavanti satriṇaḥ sa ārtaḥ kālaḥ |
śītena ca ārtā bhavanti |
śītaṃ ca māghe, na caitre |
tathā ‘vyastaṃ vā ete saṃvatsarasyābhidadhante, ya ekādaśyāṃ dīkṣante’ iti |
ayanaparicchittiḥ vyastaśabdena ucyate |
ayanaparicchittiśca māghaphālgunayoḥ, na caitre |
tathā ‘apo nābhinandanto'vabhṛthamabhyayanti’ iti |
māghānte śaile sati avabhṛthamagamane apāmabhinandanaṃ na syāt |
caitre tu abhinandantaḥ avabhṛthamabhyayeyuḥ |
etebhyo liṅgebhyo jñāyate māghyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ purastāccaturdaśe gavāyamanasya dīkṣā, na caitryāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ purastāt iti |

kau. 2|2|122 pṛ. 266. darśapūrṇamāsanāmannaḥ prasiddhārthakatvaṃ upāditaṃ paurṇa- māsyādhikaraṇe |

na kevalaṃ avādha- pakṣapātitvena vākyena tayoḥ ( liṅkakramayoḥ ) abhāvaḥ; apitu niyamavidhilāghavādharopeṇāpi ityuktaṃ paurṇamāsyādhi- karaṇe |
kau. 3|1|123 pṛ. 212, ‘ya iṣṭyā’ ityādau yatra prayogo'pi prāptastatra karmānuvādena kālā- yaṃśe viniyogavidhirityevamuktaṃ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe |
2| 3|1|126 pṛ. 93 |
yatrānekāryavidhivyāpāraṃ vinā viśeṣaṇavaiśiṣṭyasyāsiddhiḥ, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasambandha- siddhayarthaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānārthaṃ ca vidhāyakapratyayasya vyāpāra- bhedāt vidhyāvṛttyā vākyabhedaḥ, yathā paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe vidvadvākyavihitakarmaṇi āgneyādivākyairguṇavidhike |
ku. 2|2|124|127 |
yatrāpūrvabhāvanāsattvāt tatra vidhi- phalasya viśeṣaṇe evaikasmin sattvāt sādhyatvena ca vidhyantareṇa viśeṣaṇānāṃ vidhānāt āvṛttiḥ iti spaṣṭaṃ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe |
kau. 2|2|156 pṛ. 199, yatra tu kārakatvasaṃbandhena vṛttiḥ yathā āgneyaḥ ityādi tatra prāthamikakriyā'nvayaṃ vinā kārakatvayogāt vṛtteśca pārthikasaṃbandhatvenāpi nirvāhopapatteḥ nādāveva aṣṭakapāla- saṃbandhaḥ |
apitu bhāvanāsaṃbandhadvārā evāsau |

paurṇamāsīnyāyaḥ |
vidvadvākyadvayaṃ samudāya- dvayānuvādaḥ |
prakaraṇaṃ tu paurṇamāsyāṃ rūpāvacanāt |
bhāṣyam- evaṃ hi samāmananti 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭā- kapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' 'tāva- ṛtāmagrīṣomāvājyasyeva nāvupāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan iti. tābhyāmetamagrīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāse prāyacchat, aindraṃ dadhyamāvāsyāyām, aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyām' iti|
tathā 'āghāramāghārayati' 'ājyabhāgau yajati' 'sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' 'patnīsaṃyājān yajati' 'samidhayajurjuhoti' |
tathā 'evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ 'ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ sarvāpyetāni samapradhānāni uta āgneyādīni payo'ntāni pradhānāni, āghārādīni ārādupakārakāṇya- jñāni |
tathā ya evaṃ vidvānityevaṃ saṃyuktā prakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāmanuvāditāro athavā 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate, ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' ityapūrvayoḥ karmaṇorvidhātārā, tatrete guṇavidhayaḥ iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? śabdāntaratvādāgneyādīnāṃ samapradhānāni |
iti prāpte, brūmaḥ |
prakaraṇaṃ tu paurṇamāsyām, prakṛtānāmāgneyādīnāṃ anu- vaditārau paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyutau |
kutaḥ ? rūpāvaca- nāt |
ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakaṃ yāgaṃ yajate iti na sarve yāgā ucyante |
yaḥ paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakaḥ sa vidhī- yate |
na caitadevamavagacchāmaḥ kīdṛśamevaṃsaṃjñakasya yāgasya rūpamiti |
tena na kiñcit pratipadyamahe |
ato brūmo yatpūrvasya vicāratau anarthakāviti |
atha nu prakṛtānā- manuvāditāre, tataḥ saṃnihitauḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyuktā yāgā iti gamyate rūpam |
tatrāpyatratā vacastasya |
kathaṃ punarekavacanānto bahūnāṃ vācako bhaviṣyatīti yathucyate, samudāyaśabdatayā avakalpyate |
rūpavanto hi pūrva- prakṛtā yāgāḥ |
teṣāṃ ca prayayaśiṣṭaḥ samudāyo'pyasti |
tadapekṣo''yama rūpaśabdaḥ |
tasmādekavacanāntā na doṣaḥ |
bhavati hi bahunāmekavacanāntaḥ- śabdaḥ samudāyāpekṣo yathā yūthaṃ vanaṃ kulaṃ paripaṭhaditi |
yadā āgneyādīnāṃ samudāya- vacanāvetī, tadā darśapūrṇamāsaśabdenaivābhidhīyante |
tata eṣāṃ phalasaṃbandhaḥ, phalasaṃbandhihetu āghārādīni ārādupakārakāṇīti |
vā- samastān darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇayāgavidhīnudāhṛtya kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pradhānatvam, uta keṣāṃcideva iti bhāṣyakāreṇa vicāraḥ prastutaḥ |
tatrābhidhīyate 'aṅgapradhānacinteyaṃ caturthādhyāyāgocaraḥ |
kena nāma prasaṅgena prastutā bhedalakṣaṇe ? ||
abhyāsalakṣaṇābhedāntaramidānīṃ saṃkhyā- nimittaṃ medamavicārya kathaṃ kathaṃ lakṣaṇānaupayikyarthe cintyate ? ke cidāhuḥ, ayamapi lakṣaṇārtha eva 'anantaraṃ pradhānāpradhānāni parīkṣyante' iti (bhāṣya-) vacanāt (bhā. 2|2|1|1 pṛ. 371) |
tattu āyuktam |
tathaiva paryanuyujya vacanasya anyathaiva vyākhyānāt |
apūrva- bhedapratītyo hi sa tṛtīyasiddho'rthaḥ |
atropanyastaḥ ityuktam |
ayaṃ tu karmaṇāmaṅgāṅgibhāvo na kathaṃcit saṃdhyate |
mahatā prayatnena ayaṃ caturthe sādhayiṣyate 'darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ' ityatrādhikaraṇe |
sphuṭatvācca nānyathā tat netuṃ śakyate |
tasmādiha avicāraṇīyametat |
'ya evaṃ vidvān' ityevaṃ saṃyuktā prakṛtānuvādau, athavā apūrvakarmavidhī 'tatrete guṇavidhayaḥ' ityādi sarvaṃ (bhāṣyoktam) yathopanyastenādhikaraṇā- yena na saṃgacchate |
atha tu etadeva vicāryate, tataḥ pūrvaṃ nopayastavyam |
apica 'bhede ca dṛṣṭasāmarthyau sama- prādhānyasiddhaye |
kathaṃ śabdāntarābhyāsau hetutve- nopavarṇitau ||
' 'śabdāntarādamāvāsyācca medāvadyucyate, samapradhānatvamapi etāmyāmeva pratipādyate' ityapūrvā yuktiḥ |
na vā ādhikaraṇādyaśarīrasya viviktāḥ pakṣahetavo dṛśyante, yena tantreṇa vicāradvayamidaṃ prastutaṃ ityavastheyam |
tasmādevaṃ samarthayitavyam |
iha abhyāsalakṣaṇābhedā- tisrajñāpavādārthe adhikaraṇe ārabhyamāṇe yathodāhṛtānāṃ madhye dve evodāharaṇe 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimeto yajatiśabdau apūrvayoḥ karmaṇo- vidhāyakau, uta paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdābhyāṃ svāmidheya- kālaviśeṣayuktakarmapratipādakābhyāṃ viśeṣyābhyāṃ prakṛtāneva kāścit yāgān anuvadataḥ iti |
tatra itareṣāmāgneyādīnāṃ guṇāt, prayājādīnāmabhyāsāt, āghārādīnāṃ śabdāntara- tvāt siddhe mede adhikaraṇapakṣadvayaprayojanabhūtasamapradhāna-
bhāvājñābhāvaviṣayatvena upanyāso nādhikaraṇaśarīra- viṣayatvena |
nahi samapradhānatvamajñābhāvaśca adhi- karaṇapakṣau ityuktam |
tadiha paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyā- saṃyuktaravirdhātvatvam, tadabhidheyakarmabhedaḥ, samastāghārādīnāṃ samaprādhānyam, ityetat trayaṃ uttarottaraphalatvena avinābhāvasaṃbandhaāt ekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tathā tayoranuvādatvam, tadvācakakarmabhedaḥ, āgneyādīn prati āghārādīnāmabhedatvam, iti tenaiva prakāreṇa aparaḥ trikaḥ |
tritayasyatritayasya ca svāvinābhāvāt ekasiddhaiva itaradvayasiddharbhavati iti pakṣadvaye'pi yadeva sādhitam, tenaiva iṣṭasiddhiṃ matvā phalabhūtastutīyaḥ tṛtīyo''śa upanyastaḥ |
tatra cārtha- gṛhītāpi medābhedau vispaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ punarante darśitau |
kimarthaṃ punaradau vyavahitayoḥ samapradhānājñābhāvadvāreṇa medābhedayorupanyāsaḥ |
kutaḥ ? eṣā hi ācāryasya śailī iti ke cit (phalgudvārā upanyāso bhāṣyakṛtprakriyā iti) |
tathāhi pūrvādhikaraṇayorapi apūrvamevameva upanyastavān |
(svamatena liṅgadarśanasāreṇa evaṃ kṛtamiti pariharati-) athavā yat liṅgadarśanaṃ vakṣyati 'vikṛtau prayājādayo dṛśyante' iti (caturthasūtre), tat sākṣāt medanirākaraṇāya asamarthaṃ samapradhānabhāvaṃ nirākariṣyati |
tannirākaraṇe ca sati avinābhāvāt vidhibhedāvapi nirākṛtāveva bhavataḥ, iti tadupajīvanayā ityamupanyāsaḥ |
kevalamedopanyāse tu tadasaṃbhavameva syāt |
tatra dvedhā pūrvapakṣo bhaviṣyati |
ekaḥ samaprādhānya- dvāreṇa āgneyādīnāṃ karmavidhitve satyeva paurṇamāsyā- māvāsyāsaṃyukteyoḥ tadyatiriktakarmavidhividhānāt, aparaḥ punaḥ tayoreva karmavidhitvaṃ itareṣāṃ tu guṇavidhānārthaṃ ityevam |

iti |

yasmin chaṇe eko yāgaḥ ārabhya kriyamāṇaḥ samāptimanubhavati, tasminneva itare, ityavadhāraṇāt trikasyatrikasya tantreṇa prayogaḥ siddho bhavati |
autpa- ttikakālānurodhe tu medena aṅgaviyuktānāṃ ca prayogaḥ syāt, ityasti viśeṣaḥ |

( apara āha - ) śaṃnikṛṣṭasya- rūpakartavyaṃ ityevedā kṛtaḥ ? sarvatra vacanānusāraṇa upa- kārānupakārāśau vijñāyate |

nanu ca anyenaiva vākyena eṣa tantraprayogaḥ sidhyati 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena' ityādīnāṃ tatrāpi karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt iṣṭeḥ khasamudāyasyāṅgasahitāyāḥ kālaṃ prati upādānāt īdṛśī vivakṣā labhyate |
satyaṃ labhyate, na tu iṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ sidhyati |

atha samastanā- māgeyādīnāṃ kathañcit rūḍheḥ 'pravṛttatvādidheḥ some pravṛttiḥ' itivat grahaṇam, evamapi prayogavacanaikatvāt samudāya- dvayasyāpi paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ vā anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt, tatra sa eva utpattiśaṅkāvirodhaḥ |
tadanurodhena vyava- sthitavikalpāśrayaṇamiti cet, evamapi yathoktatyanu- rodhātyatyekānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ |
tathā ajñānāṃ medena paurṇamāsya- māvāsye prati upādānābhāvāt yatrakatraṇa ekatra pradeśe anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
tasmāt na ( ya iṣṭyā iti - ) eta- dvākyaṃ tābhyāṃ ( paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyābhyāṃ ) tulyā- rthamiti prakṛtau akṣiptikatvatvāt vikṛtīyeva svakāla- tāyai gacchati |
nanu anena tantraprayogaḥ sidhyet 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti deśasthānāpadeyatvātsāhitya- vivakṣopapatteḥ |
tatrocyate |

tena sarvairāsevyo grāhyo, na bahavaḥ samāḥ ||
' 'bhedenāpi hi prayujyamānānāmanya- deśagamanamātreṇa deśatantratvasiddhiḥ |
itya ataretara- yogavaśāt yadaiva ekaḥ samena yāgo yujyate, tadaiva itaro'pi iti tantratvamucyate |
tathā sati ṣaṇṇāmapi yugapadupādānāt tathaiva prayogasakteḥ sa eva virodhaḥ |
yadi punaḥ utpattikāvyanurodhena pravartate, tataḥ pratyekaṃ kālasaṃyuktānāṃ samaṃ prati sāhityaṃ saṃpādanīyaṃ iti bhraṣṭatve paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsu prayogaḥ samāptayet |
ajñānāṃ ca tāvat kālāt anukalpyamāṇāni prayoktavyāni iti yatrakacana antarāle kriyeran |
athavā pratipradhānādyatte- nyāyyatvādekaṃ pradhānaṃ sāṅgamapyajyate |
atha tu yāvatā utpattikāle virudhyate, tāvanmātra parihāya yogapadyena
samasaṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ ityavadhāryeta, tata ekasyāmeva paurṇa- māsyāmamāvāsyāṃ vā trikayoḥ prayujyamānayoḥ yasyakasya cit samīpe ajñānī prayujyeran |
athavā tadarthamāsā- ntarāle yatrakacana ahani |
sarvo hi asau pradhāna- kālaḥ, pradhānakālahavirbhāvaśca saṃbhāvayitavyo nātyanta- sāmīpyam, aśakyatvāt |
tasmāt naitenāpi abhi- pretaprayogasiddhiḥ |
anenaiva phalavākyamapi pratyuktam, phalasyāpi deśadeva anupādeyatvāt |
sarvān itare- taryuktān sāṅgāna prati tantratve siddhe na prayogatantratva- siddhiḥ, viprakṛṣṭakālaireva hi ekaṃ phalaṃ sādhyate |
atho- cyeta, phalaṃ bhavat bhāvyadeta: itthaṃ iti sāṅghāni pradhā- nāni yugapatphalabhavankāle'nuṣṭhātavyāni śrūyante, tataśca na viprakṛṣṭānīti |

utpattivākyenaiva pūrvavadeva pratyekaṃ prayogadiyojanā |

avati āgneyaguṇatve prayājasya tantropapadyate |
ato na sarvāṇi samapradhānāni |

bhāṣyam - naitadasti paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyuktau samudāyānvādāviti |
kintu apūrvayoḥ karmaṇorvidhātārī |
tathā na lakṣaṇaśabdo bhaviṣyati |
nana rūpaṃ nāsti |

paurṇamāsyāmāyeo'ṣṭā- kapālo bhavatīti |

ata āgneyā- dibhirguṇo vidhīyate iti |
vā - paurṇamāsīmityekatvaṃ prātipadikārthagatameva bhaviṣyati, na tallakṣitasamudāyagatam |

bhāṣyam— karmacodanā vā āgneyādayaḥ syuḥ |
kutaḥ ? guṇānāṃ yugapacchāsanāt |
ekenaiva vākyenātrāneko guṇo vidhātumiṣyate bhavatā |

kastarhi ? aṣṭākapālaḥ paurṇamāsyā abhisaṃbadhyate iti |
tatra tadā bhavatiterthaṃ |

upasarjanārthavidhirityatra svīkṛtam |

ataḥ anta- ralavākyasyaiva ... viśvādivākyānāṃ tu arthavādatvam |

upasarjanabhūtaśca śrute caitanna yujyate |

prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe vaiṣṇavādikarmānuṣṭhānam, siddhānte tu ekasyaiveti |
sūtraṃ tu antarāyākye karma codanā viśvādivākyānāmivaikenaiva karmaṇāprabhakta- tvāditi |

' iti (vā. pṛ. 490) |

bhāṣyam-- pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ prakṛtau śrūyamāṇaṃ vikṛtau ityuktam ( pūrvādhikaraṇe ) |

kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? tat sarvatra syāt carau paśau puroḍāśe ca |
kutaḥ ? aviśeṣāt |
na kaścit viśeṣaḥ āśrīyate |
tasmāt sarvatreti |
vā-- tat sarvārthamaviśeṣān |
( sūtramātraṃ paṭhitam, na vyākhyātam ) |
carau vā'rthakaṃ puroḍāśe'rthavipratiṣedhāt paśau na syāt |
bhāṣyam-- carau pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ viniyujyeta |
puro- ḍāśo tāvat peṣaṇamarthadeva prāpnoti |
naivānyathā puroḍāśo bhavati |
tadarthaṃ tāvat vacanam |
paśau ca na syāt |
hṛdayādiṣu piṣyamāṇeṣu teṣāmākāravināśaḥ syāt |
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ' hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati ' iti hṛdayādava- dhiṣyate |
tathā anyadapi avadānaṃ na yathāśrutādavadyate |
nanu śakyate piṣṭe'pi hṛdayādibhyo'vadātum |
neti brūmaḥ |
ākāra hṛdayādayo na māṃchāni |
uktametat |
ākṛtiḥ śabdārtha iti |

tasmāt carau pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyevam vacanam |
vā -- carau vā'rthakam |
yadi kaścidetat laukikapiṣṭopādānenāpi puroḍāśasiddhernaikāntana arthākṣa iti, taṃ prati ucyate |
artho nāma prākṛta upakāraḥ |

' utpādan- deśādavadyati ' iti ca śrūyate |

nanu ' adantako hi ' iti hetvaviśeṣāt paśupuroḍāśe'pi prāpteḥ |
dravyadānāni taccheṣāśca piṣṭvā dāsyante |
na ca prātipattipeṣaṇai bhaviṣyataḥ |

, prāptatvānna puroḍāśe dṛḍhyākāranāśāt|

' 19. bhāṭṭa— tat peṣaṇaṃ pūṣadevatye carau paśau puroḍāśe ca syāt, uta carāveveti cintāyām, aviśeṣādantakatveṣu sarvatra|
iti prāpte, puroḍāśe tāvat pākāt pūrvaṃ peṣaṇasya prāptādeva vidhānaṃ vyartham, taduttaraṃ tu puroḍāśapadavācyākṛti- vināśāpattiḥ|

ayedānīṃ saṃdihyate|
kiṃ ekadevatye pauṣṇe etat bhavati, uta dvidevatye'pīti|

tatra aindrāpauṣṇa udāharaṇam|
kiṃ prāptam ? ekadevatyasya peṣaṇamiti, kevalasaṃyogāt yathā caturdhā- karaṇe|

idānīṃ kimantya- sahite devatayā aindrāpauṣṇe carau peṣaṇaṃ bhavati, uta ekasminneva iti saṃdehe caturdhākaraṇe'pītyāyāt siddhāntenaiva tāvat upakramate|
pūṣā ityekasaṃyogaśravaṇāt tathābhūte etārthe syāditi|
dharmavipratiṣedhācca |
bhāṣyam— dvidevatye vipratiṣidhyeta dharmaḥ|
pūṣṇaḥ peṣaṇaṃ netarasya|
tatra yadi pūṣṇo bhāgaḥ piṣyeta, apiha itarasya syāt|
tatra niyamaḥ pāko bhavet|
pākanimittaśca caraśabdaḥ, sa vipratiṣidhyeta|
athāvirodhaṃ manyamānā aparasyāpi bhāge piṃṣyuḥ, bhāgasaṃmohaḥ syāt|
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? anyasya bhāgo'nyasmai avadīyate|
tathā ayathā- śrutaṃ kriyeta|
tasmādapi ekadevatye peṣaṇamiti|
vā— itaścaikadevatye|
kutaḥ ? 'piṣyādarthaṃ samastaṃ vā dvidevatye carau bhavān|
pūrvasmin pākavaiṣamyaṃ parasmin bhāgasaṃkaraḥ|
' arthapeṣaṇe hi piṣṭo'śaḥ śīghrataraṃ sidhyati, itarakṣīreṇa|
tatra piṣṭapākānantaramu- dvāsane sati itarasya āmatvaṃ bhavet|
tatākapratīkṣaṇāde'pi vā piṣṭasya vilayanāt acaratvaṃ syāt|
pākavaiṣamyena hi piṣṭakacarapi carurbhavati|
na caitadasmin pakṣe bhavati|
atha taṇḍulān pūrve prakṣipya paścāt piṣṭe nikṣipeta, tato yogapadyaṃ gamyamānaṃ bādhyeta (piṣṭataṇḍulabhāgayordvayorapi ekayagāsādhanatvena ekahaviṣtvāt kṛtsnasya ca haviṣpaḥ nikṣepasyāpi yogapadyamiha atideśāt gamyamānaṃ bādhyeta --su. pṛ. 1329)|
pūṣānurodhena tu aindrā'pi bhāge piṣyamāṇe bhāgasaṃkarāt anyadīye bhāge anyasmai dīyamāne vaiguṇyaṃ prāpnoti|
nanu caitat sarvaṃ dvideva- tyeṣu bhavato'pi samānam|
tathāhi, 'carau paśau puroḍāśe dīyamāne dvidevate|
pūrvaṃ haviṣ ekatvājjāyate bhāgasaṃkaraḥ|
' sa cāṅgīkṛtaḥ, miśrasya havipo miśradevatodeśena yugapaddāne virodhā- bhāvāt|
ucyate |
'yāgāpūrvaprayuktye dharme- pjevaṃ bhavedidam|
bhavataḥ peṣaṇaṃ tvetadevatādharmaṃ- saṃmatam|
' asmatpakṣe punaḥ pūṣadevatyayāgāparvaprayuktaṃ peṣaṇam|
na ca tat dvidevatye tathāvasthita ityapravṛttireva|
havirantareṣvapi ca dvidevatyeṣu evaṃ prakāratvameveti devatā guṇabhūtā|
na ca guṇānurodhena pradhānamāvartanīyamiti sakṛdānābhyupagamāt sarvasmin saha kriyamāṇe saṃkaradoṣā- nāśrayaṇam|
bhavatā punarasmadabhyupagamena dvidevatye peṣaṇaṃ vaktumaśakyatvāt avaśyaṃ devatānimittatvamabhyupagantavyam|
tataśca devatayoḥ prādhānyādekaikā svābhāgasaṃkīrṇaṃ prārthyate iti tathaiva dānamanujñeyam|
āditaścaiva bhāgaḥ peṣaṇārha ityavadhāritam|
tataśca pakṣadoṣaḥ syāt|
atha taṇḍulātmako'pi bhāgaḥ pākasāmyārthaṃ piṣyate|
tatra brūmaḥ|
yāvadantulannabhāgāvivekaṃ haviḥ, tāvat kiyān kasya bhāgaḥ|
ityanavadhānārthāt saṃkaradoṣo na jāyate|
kalpite tu viveke vacanādate punarekīkaraṇapatterasaṃkīrṇa- dānaṃ prāpnoti|
tatrānyasya bhāgāt anyasmai avadīyamāne vaiguṇyaṃ bhavati|
pātrabhedena paśyatīti cenna|
carumiti yāgaṃ prati upādīyamānatvena vivakṣitaikatvasaṃkhyeya prāptakṛta- medāśrayaṇe śāstrabādhaprasaṅgāt|
ato na kathañcidapi pratiṣiddhadharmakaṃ dvidevatye peṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti na kartavyam|
athavā, sadvitīyaye syāt devatānisittatvāt|
bhāṣyam— devatānimittametat peṣaṇaṃ śrūyate|
pūṣā piṣṭabhāgaḥ kartavya iti|
sa ca dvidevatye'pi bhāge piṣyamāṇe pratipadyamāḥ kuto bhavati|
na yathā caturdhā- karaṇe|
tatra hi tadvito nirapekṣya bhavati, na sa- dvitīyasya|
indrapīta iti samāso'pi nirapekṣasya, na sadvitīyasya|
iha tu pratiṣadhaśabdasya bhāgaśabdena saha avyayadāthau bahuvrīhiḥ samāsaḥ|
eṣo'pi samarthayoriva,
na tu atra dvidevatye kaścidekajātīyako doṣaḥ |
tasmādeka- devatye dvidevatye'pi vā carau asya bhāgaḥ peṣaṇya eva |
vā— saddhite'pi vā pūrṇaṃ syādeva peṣaṇam |
kutaḥ ? 'haviṣo yadi pauṣṇasya tathāgāñjasya vā bhavet |
anuktatvād dvidevatye na bhavet peṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
' puṣpasadbhāvanimittametat peṣaṇaṃ na ca tat viśeṣitavastuninimittam |
vyāsañjitatvācca [ vyāsañjita- tvācca ] devatatvasya dvidevatye puṣpaviśiṣṭatā na syāt, na tu pūṣā tadbhāgo vā nāstīti |
yathā manotāyāṃ vakṣyati (bhāṣyaṃ pṛ. 1939) 'tatrāgniḥ adevatā, na tu asamavetaḥ' iti |
tena asyāpi atra pūṣṇo devatatve samavāyamātreṇa upalakṣaṇatvāt dvayordevatenāpi laj- mānasya 'samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt' ityanena arthe pūṣṇo bhāga iti gamyate |
tasya peṣaṇe kriyamāṇe yadi tāvat kāṃsyabhojināyena amuṣye'pi ityevaṃ itarabhāgapeṣaṇa- mapi kriyate,
pauṣṇa peṣaṇaṃ

bhāṭṭa — yatra anyasahitaḥ pūṣā devatā yathā rāja- sūye 'aindrāpauṣṇaścaḥ' iti tatrāpi peṣaṇam, uta yatra kevala eva devatā tatraiva iti cintāyām, 'adantako hi saḥ' ityarthavādānusārāt peṣaṇasya pūṣasvarūpatvā- vagateḥ, tatsvarūpasya ca anyasahita'pi sattvāt yuktameva peṣaṇam |
ata eva 'somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapedemapiṣṭaṃ paśukāmaḥ' iti nemapadavācyārthapiṣṭatvānna'pi saṃ- gacchate |
yadi tu navamādhyāyanena pūṣarūpe ānarthakyāt apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā āvaśyakatvamāśādyeta, tadā- 'stu pūrvoktavidhayā pūṣapraviṣṭasaṃjñanayayāgānāmitareva tātparyagrāhikāyāḥ sattvāt sā'pi pūṣapade |
parantu artha- vādānusāreṇāt pūṣādhiṣṭhānakadevatāprayogātpūrvatvala- pāyā etalliṅgakārāt dvidevatve'pi peṣaṇamarhasya |
yathā caivaṃ sati pākasaṃpattistathā yatitvatyaṃ antarāyakaraṇena vā kramika- nikṣepeṇa vā pātrabhedena vā |
iti prāpte, ānarthakyapari- hārāya apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā āvaśyakatvāt, adhi- ṣṭhānadvāratvakalpanāt ca pūṣṇo devatātvopasthitimanta- reṇānupapatteḥ, tadupasthitau ca taddārakatvamātrakalpanāyaiva ānarthakyaparihārāt, dvidevatve ca caturdhākaraṇādyadhi- karaṇanyāyena kevalasya pūṣṇo devatātvābhāvāt, yatra kevala eva pūṣā tatraiva peṣaṇam |
na ca apūrvasādhanabhūta- devatātvasyaiva prakāratayā pūṣapadena tasya pūṣopari bhāne svarūpasaṃbandhasyaiva saṃsargavidhayā vicakṣaṇena paryāptairivakṣaṇāt, tasya ca dvidevatve'pi ekasmin pūṣṇa sattaiva tasyāpyadveyatvopapatteḥ kathaṃ na peṣaṇamiti vācyam |
nyāyasyaivavṛttidharmaprakāratayā ekamātravṛttisaṃba- ndhasya saṃsargalānuṣapatteḥ |

18. bhāṭṭa — darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'pūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo- 'dantako hi saḥ' iti śrutam |

mātrāvidhiḥ iti cintāyām, na tāvat bhāgaśabdalakṣita- yāgoddeśena peyaṇavidhiḥ, ekaprasaratābhaṅgāpatteḥ, upapadena viśeṣaṇe vākyabhedācca, phalaprayatnādravyopasarjanasya peyaṇasya yāgānvayānupapatteśca |
ata eva na pūṣpadameva śakyārthasya lakṣitapadadevatāyāgasya vodeṣyatāparam, pūṣṇāḥ agnimicaritakratusaṃbandhābhāvena kratūpasthitau pramāṇā- bhāvācca |

iti prāpte, prapiṣṭhābhāgapadena tāvat bhāgo bhajanīyaṃ sevyamasyeti vyutpattyā sevanāsaṃbhave'pi saṃbandha- mātraṃ devatvādipyavahārapramāṇakaṃ prapiṣṭapūṣṇoḥ pratīyate |

tatra ca viśeṣaṇamātravidhistaṃbhe viśiṣṭavidyādityasya anyāyatatvāt pramāṇābhāve na apūrvayāgāntarānumitiḥ |

yataḥ 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' itivatsamānādhikaraṇyenaiva nāmatve siddhe tadullekhena mādhikālavidhinā pravṛttinimittamātraṃ nirṇīyate iti nānupāpannam |

maivam, 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate, yad dhruvāyāmājyam' iti prakaraṇa- śrutyā'dravyasya dhruvāvākyāt dravyaṃ tāvadasti |
na ca ekena vākyena ājyasya dhruvāsaṃbandhavidhāne yāgasaṃbandha- vidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ ; 'yad dhruvāyāmājyam' ityasya dhruvāsaṃbandhamanūdya yāgasaṃbandhamātravidhānāt |

evaṃ tarhi eta- tkarmadvaye'pi aviśiṣṭam, 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta, amāvāsyāyāmāmāvāsyā yajeta' iti vākya- dvayena kālavidhānasyoktatvāt |
tena anayoreva phala- vākyena viniyogāt kathaṃ samaprādhānyamiti |

' samānaḥ kālasaṃyoga iti neṣṭāvadhāraṇā ||
' iti (vā. pṛ. 477) |

yataḥ pūrvaprasiddhaṃ hi svayaṃ phalavākyamupādatte |
na tu phala- saṃbandhaparaṃ vākyam |
upapadasyāpi vṛttyantareṇa arthāntara- padatvamāpādayitumutsahate |
tadihāpi kālavacano darśapūrṇa- māsaśabdo lakṣitalakṣaṇayā kālayoginau yāgān upasthāpa- yitumarhati |
tena upapadasyāprasiddhatvāt prasiddhārthayaji- sāmānādhikaraṇyena yajyarthatvameva nirṇīyate |
siddhānte tu samudāyānuvādatveva phalavākyasyopapadaprasiddhaprayojanatvāt yugapat samudāyasyaiva phalavidhānam |
na ceha tathā sama- stīti pūrvapakṣe'pi samaprādhānyameveti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhidhīyate |
bhavedevaṃ vidhyābhyāsataḥ karmabhedaḥ, yadi viddhāyaktyayugalasya kartṛyuktyacchabdasya evaṃśabdyogena anuvādakaṃ na bhavet |
yattu vedana- kartṛyogo yacchabdo na yāgakartṛyogotyucyata |

na ceha vedanarahitasya acetanasya yāgakartṛttva- mastīti yo vedanakartā sa yajeteti viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāt yāgakartṛviśeṣaṇameva yacchabdaḥ |
tatsahacaritaśca evaṃ- śabdo'pi tathā, tadanuvādakatvādvidhāyakatvameveti |
tadu- ktam -- 'kriyāpadekayogitve yacchabdo na ruje- dvidhiyam |
kartṛyuktaḥ sa evānyaprāpitā'nuvāda- kṛt ||
' iti (vā. pṛ. 488) |
kiñca rūpābhāvādāpi na yāgāvidhāyakatvam |

na ca māntravarṇikadevatāprāptiḥ, yājyānuvākyāmantrayoḥ ājyabhāgakramapaṭhitatvena tadarthalā- bhāvāt |
