' iti (vā. pṛ. 478) |
nāpi kāladvāreṇa lakṣaṇayā karmaparatvam, ājyabhāgayoreva paurṇamāsyā- vāskālayogena mantravyavasthāpakatayā mukhyārthopapattau kramabādhena lakṣaṇikatvasvīkārāsambhavāt |
na cājyabhāgayoḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyākālasya prāptatvāt na mantravyavasthā- pakatvaṃ vacanasyeti vācyam |
yataḥ siddhānte tāvat prayogadvayena sāṅgatyaiva paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyākālo labhya eva |
tathā pūrvapakṣe'pi sarveṣāṃ samprādhānyena sahacaritānāṃ madhye aṣṭānāṃ kālasaṃbandhasya śrutatvāt itareṣāmapi kālasaṃbandhe kalpyamāne prayogavidhivataḥ tatkālasyaiva buddhau vipariṇateḥ tatkālasaṃbandhameva kalpayati |
tatra paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyā- kālayoḥ vinigamanāpramāṇābhāvāt icchāvaśādanuṣṭhāne sati bhavati vyavasthā'thaitadvacanam |
yadā paurṇamāsyājyābhāgau tadā vāryantī anuṣṭhye, yadā amāvāsyāyāgau tadā vṛṣantī anuṣṭhye |
ato mantravarṇikadevatayā abhāvena arūpatvāt karmavidhitvam |
kiñca nāmavācchinnaṃ hi karma- dvayametat vighātavyam |
na ca pravṛttinimittābhāvena paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāpadayornāmadheyatvamasti |
nāpi kāla- vidhipare vākye vidhisāmānyābhāvakālasaṃbandhanirīkṣaṇena nāmadheyatvamiti vācyam |
utpattau hi nāmapravṛtti- nimittatvaṃ kālasya |
na ca kālavidhipare vākyadvaye siddhāntādyadyotapannaṃ karma pratīyate |
tena yathābhūtasya nāma- saṃbandho na tathābhūtasya kālasaṃbandhaḥ, yathābhūtasya kāla- saṃbandho na tathābhūtasya nāmasaṃbandha iti |
agnihotrādau tu yathābhūtasya utpattiḥ tathābhūtasyaiva 'yadyame ca prajā- pataye na sāyaṃ juhoti' ityutpattivākyagatahomasvarūpavā- gamāt vaiṣamyāditi nānupanyam |
nanvevaṃ tarhi āgneyādivākyaireva devatāmātrāvidhānāt rūpabhāvo bhavati |
maivam, prāpte karmaṇi dravyadevatārūpā- nekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
na ca saṃskāravākya- paryālocanena dravyaprāptau devatāvidhānāt vākyabheda iti vācyam |
dravyavidhānamantareṇa saṃskāratvāsaṃbhavāt |
anyathā 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' iti nyāyena pradhānakarmatvāpatteḥ |
kiñca bhavatu tāvat dravya- prāptiḥ, tathāpi āgneyapadapāttāgnidhāne aṣṭakapāla- padopāttāṣṭakatvavidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ |
tena yaduktaṃ tadvidhānaikapadopāttadevatāviśiṣṭadravyavidhānāt vākyabheda iti, tadapi nirastam |
aṣṭakapālapadopāttatvasaṃkhyā- vidhānasya āvaśyakatvena vākyabhedasya tadavasthatvāt |
tathā ca sūtram - 'codanā vā guṇānāṃ yugapacchā- codite hi tadarthatvātsatyadoṣopadiṣṭayet' |
iti |
nanu siddhānte ca ekena vākyena dravyadevatāsaṃbandha- kālayogānāṃ vidhāne vākyabhedaḥ samāna eva |
na sakala- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhāne bhāvārthataḥ amāvāt |
na caivaṃ sati viśeṣaṇānāṃvidhānam, viśiṣṭavidhānyā'nu- papattitvādvidhimivaiva viśeṣaṇavidhānāt |
taduktam- 'śrautavyāpāranānātve śabdānāmatigauravam |
eko- kṛtyasatitāṃ tu nārthākṣepo virudhyate |
prāpte karmaṇi nāneko vidhātuṃ śakyate guṇaḥ |
aprāpte tu vidhīyante bahavo'pyekayatnataḥ |
' iti (vā.- pṛ. 485) |
nanu yathā viśiṣṭavidhirviśeṣaṇavidhisāpekṣaḥ tathā viśeṣaṇavidhipi viśeṣyalābhāya viśiṣṭavidhisāpekṣa eva ityanyonyāśrayāt viśiṣṭavidhipi na saṃbhavati |
ucyate |
syādevaṃ yadi viśiṣṭavidhiḥ viśeṣaṇavidhiva- gamāpekṣapravṛttirbhavet |
kiṃ tarhi ? ākāṅkṣitasaṃnihita- yogyaviśeṣamātravagamāpekṣapravṛttiḥ |
tāni ca viśeṣaṇāni viśiṣṭavidhivakye eva padapratipāditāni, kintu vidhi- pratipāditā viśiṣṭapiyaṇī kartavyatā na viśeṣaṇānāṃ kartavyatāmānāsā paryavasyatīti viśeṣaṇakartavyatāpekṣāṃ sarvasiddhā eva viśeṣaṇavidhayaḥ śrutārthāpatyā kalpyante |
tena viśiṣṭavidhau viśeṣaṇavidhayaḥ pūrvasaṃbandhamātreṇaiva upayujyante |
yathā jīvato gṛhābhāve bahirbhāvaḥ |
yathā vā dravyadharyeyutpattau vyaktau vyavahāradarśanāt prathamaṃ vyaktyatvamavagamyate |
tatra ākṛtyarthatvaṃ prāganva- gatamapi sattāmātraprayogi paścāt tu ānanvayyami- cārābhyāṃ vyaktyavacchetvāt ākṛtyaivatvaṃ niścīyate, na cetaretarāśrayatvam, tathaihāpi |

' iti (vā. pṛ. 485) |
tataśca āgneyādivākyairviśiṣṭāpūrvabhāvanāvidhau na vākya- bhedaḥ |

' iti (vā. pṛ. 489) |
idaṃ tu iha vaktavyam |
kiṃ punaḥ samudāyānuvādasya prayojanam ? taducyate |
phalavākye hi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyām' iti vacanāt dvayoḥ karaṇatvamupa- jātam |
na ca tat karmasvarūpamapekṣam, teṣāṃ bahutvāt |
nāpi rājasūyavat phalāpekṣam, tathā sati 'rājasūyena' itivat ekavacanatvaprasaṅgāt |
na cotpattivākyagatakāladvayāpekṣam, tathāpi antaraṅgatvenaiva ekavacanatvaprasaṅgādeva |
yattu 'supāṃ supo bhavanti' iti bahuvacanatvane ekavacanatvamasmin vākye dvivacanamityuktam, agalyā hi arthasādhutvāsaṃbhavāt prayogasādhutvamātraṃ tathā āśritam |
iha tu vidvadvākya- yugalapāditāsamudāyādityaśravaṇena arthasādhutvasaṃbandhe sati na prayogasādhutvamātramāśrayaṇam |
tathāhi, trayāṇāmāgneyāgnī- ṣomīyopāṃśuyājānāṃ ekapaurṇamāsīkālasaṃbandhāt, tathā trayāṇāmagneye aindra dadhi aindra paya ityeṣāmākāmāvāsyā- kālasaṃbandhāt, trayāṇāṃyāgānāmekaikakālasaṃbandhānāṃ vidva- dvākyayugalena phalavākyāpekṣadvisiddhayarthaṃ samudāyānu- vādaḥ prayojanavaneveti |

tathaiva tadupādānāt dvitvasiddhyā''nayopi |
' iti (vā. pṛ. 479) |

ityucyate |

prabhṛtisiddhayarthameva adhyāpitatvāt kleśonāpi tadupādānaṃ na doṣāya |

prakaraṇaṃ tu paurṇamāsyāṃ rūpāvacanāt |
'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' 'tāvanatrāmīpomau ājyasyaiva nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' 'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' 'tābhyā- metamamīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāse prāyacchat' 'aindraṃ dadhyāmāvāsyāyām' 'aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyām' iti kāla- sayuktāni vākyāni śrūyante |
tathā 'āghārāmāghārayati' 'ājyabhāgau yajati' 'sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati' 'patnīsaṃ- yājān yajati' 'samidhayajurjuhoti' iti akālasaṃyuktāni vākyāni |
tatsannidhau ca 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti śrūyate |
kiṃ sarvā- pyetāni sampradhānāni, uta āgneyādīni payo'ntāni pradhānāni, ādhārādīni samidhayajurādīni ārādupa- kārakāṇi aṅgāni iti vicāraḥ |
tathā 'ya evaṃ vidvān' iti vidvadvākyadvayaṃ prakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāmanuvādakam, uta apūrvayoḥ karmaṇorvidhāyakam, itare ca guṇavidhayaḥ iti vicāraḥ |
tatra siddhāntāha - 'paurṇamāsyām' iti amā- vāsyāyā api upalakṣaṇam |
paurṇamāsīśabdeghaṭe amā- vāsyāśabdaghaṭite ca vidvadvākye prakaraṇasthameva āgne- yādikarmājātaṃ anucyate, na tu apūrvaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate |
rūpāvacanāt rūpasya yāgasvarūpasya dravyadevatāsya avacanāt anirūpaṇāt avijñānāt |
anuvādapade tu saṃnihitā āgneyādayo yāgāḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyuktāḥ iti
gamyate rūpam |
tasmāt samudāyaśabdādevāgneyādiyāga- tadarthatvāt guṇārthatvāt tasyatasya guṇasya vidheye punaḥpunaḥ samudāyau paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyādyāvau bodhyataḥ |
etāveva upadiśyeta ucyeta pratyayāt |
taccāniṣṭam |

kintu karmacodanā eva bodhyate svargakāmapadena |
tataśca phalasaṃbandhau aphalāni ityāha siddhāntī |
ādhārādīni ārādupakārakāṇyāhva iti siddhāntaḥ |
vyapadeśaśca tadvat |

'uāṇi ha vā etāni havīṃṣi amāvāsyāyāṃ 4 ||
saṃśriyante āgneyaṃ prathamam, aindre (dadhipayasī) uttare' āgneyādīnāṃ ādhārādīnāṃ ca samprādhānyābhāve iti trayāṇāṃ umatvāparaparyāyaprādhānyavyapadeśo'pi tadvat siddhānte
vikṛtisaṃnidhipaṭhitopamānāṃ tu svasaṃnidhipaṭhitatvaviśiṣṭa- vikṛtibhāvanākathambhāvākāṅkṣāprakaraṇasattve'pi na tat aṅgatvam, upahomebhyaḥ kalpopakārakatvena pūrvānvitaiḥ prākṛtāhaiḥ kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ śāntatvena upahoma- viniyogodbhāvyatvahitapūrva niruktaprakaraṇābhāvāt |
apitu saṃnidhipuruṣānavadhāt vikṛtyākāṅkṣāmutpādya tata evā- ṅgatvam |
na ca evamutpādyākāṅkṣāyāṃ prakaraṇalakṣaṇāti- vyāptiḥ, tasyā api sthānakalpaprakaraṇatvena lakṣyatvāt |
upahomeṣu prākaraṇikāṅgatvavyavahārāpattistu liṅgavini- yojanamantreṣu śrautāṅgatvāpattitvat klaptaniruktakathambhāvā- kāṅkṣāyā eva tadvyavahāraniyāmakatvena nirākāryā iti bodhyam |
navyāstu avagataphalatvadhvaṃsanihitavākyapramitapadārtha- vṛtti yat pūrvapramāṇānavagatājñātaviṣaye itikartavyatā- svaprakārakāpekṣam, tat prakaraṇam |
asti ca darśapūrṇa- māsādau prayājādiviṣaye tat |
samidhāgasya prakaraṇatā tanūnapādāṅgatvavāraṇāya avagataphalasaṃbandheti padārtha- viśeṣaṇam |
prayājādīnāṃ prakaraṇadaṃnihitajyotiṣṭomā- dyaṅgatvavāraṇāya saṃnihitavākyapramititi tadviśeṣaṇam |
aṅgasya pūrvapramāṇānavagatājñātatvetikartavyatāyāśca na prokṣa- ṇādīnāṃ śrutiliṅgābhyaḥ avagatamahīlādyabhāvānāṃ prakara- ṇāt daśādhyāye'pyāhaḥ |
'vāmadevayaṃ gāyati' ityādi pramāṇāntareṇa anavagatājñātasāmaviṣaye avagataphalasaṃba- ndhasya stotrasya svasādhanībhūtaṛgakṣaramivyathya apekṣā- sattvāt prakaraṇe aṅgatvasattve'pi tadādyarthatva itikarta- vyatātvena iti viśeṣaṇam |
tasya ṛgakṣarābhivyaktyartha sāmāpekṣāyāmapi siddhasāmāpekṣāyāṃ itikartavyatātvaprakāraka- svābhāvāt ityāhuḥ |
atra samidhāgadau tanūnapā- dāṅgatvasya, prokṣaṇādīnāṃ prakaraṇatā darśapūrṇamāsādyaṅgatva- ca ukkarītyā vāraṇasaṃbhavāt avagataphalasaṃbandheti, pūrva- pramāṇānavagatājñātatveti ca viśeṣaṇa sūtrasyāsaṃyuktatvarūpa- viśeṣaṇavat viniyogaprayojakaprakaraṇaśarīre prakaraṇavini- yojyaviṣayaviśeṣodhanārthameva |
astu vā tanūnapādādau śarīre avagatasaṃbandhatveti viśeṣaṇam |

yājñikāśca etameva pakṣaṃ svīkurvanti |
ante tu bādarāyaṇasteṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt |
bādarāyaṇastu ācāryaḥ ante nārihomānte upa- homān āha |
teṣāṃ nārihomānāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt pradhānaviṣayakaśabdaviṣayatvāt |
tathā ca pradhānottaraṃ nārihomāḥ tata upahomāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tathā cānyārthadarśanam |
nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu prakṛtiprāptā nārihomāḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyāḥ tataḥ tattannakṣatreṣṭhitā upahomāḥ iti siddhāntaṃ anyārthaḥ vākyaśeṣo'pi darśayati ' adhvarasya pūrvamayāgeḥ upādhi hyetat karma yadādikam ' iti |
abhricayane ṣaḍ dīkṣā- ''hutayaḥ adhvarasa somasya karmabhūtāḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyāḥ, atha agreḥ saṃbandhanyaḥ ' ākṛtirmagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā ' ityādayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
yat āgnīkaṃ agni saṃbandhi karma tat upādhi aupādhikaṃ abhricayane nimitte sati kriyate iti vākya- śeṣārthaḥ |
atra pūrve samāmnātasya pūrvamanuṣṭhānamityuktam |
tathā ca nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu codakaprāptāt pūrvapaṭhitamiva nārihomātmakaṃ karma pūrvaṃ kartavyamiti jñāyate |

3|6|12 ) ityadhikaraṇe dviruktatvadoṣāpattiḥ kālavaiṣamyaṃ ceti siddhānta- hetudvayamuktam |
tat anyonyavyabhicārāt ' samadaśo vai prajāpatirvyadhe'nyāyataḥ ' iti tadadhikaraṇānte eva vārtikakṛdukte pratyudāharaṇe prākṛtadharmātkṣaṇanapekṣatvāt prāptikālavaiṣamyādiṣyupadeśātideśābhyāṃ dviru- ktāprasaṅgaḥ astyeva |
tathā phalacamase somasāmānavidhye ucyamāne vikṛtitvasya ubhayavādisiddhatvena dviruktatvā- vanāyogāt, nityavidheḥ prathamaṃ pravṛtteḥ, naimittikeṣṭivat paścāt pravṛtteḥ prāptikālavaiṣamyastyeva |
tena 'naimitti- kamatulyatvādasamānavidhānaṃ syāt ' iti somadharmasāmāna- vidhyādhikaraṇe ( 3|6|136 ) 'apica naimittikaḥ
phalacamasaḥ na somadharmān grahīṣyati tatra dharmāḥ sādhāraṇāḥ santo dviruktā ityucceran ' iti granthena sāmānavidhye dviruktatāprasaṅgābhidhānaṃ bhāṣyakārīyaṃ upekṣyameveti |
nanu 'sasadaśo vai prajāpatiḥ' ityatra dviruktatvaprasaṅge sati sāmānavidhyāyogāt kathaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ vārtika- kṛtā uktam |
ucyate |

bhāṣyam-- ( saṃvandhagranthaḥ ) prathame'dhyāye pramāṇa-lakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam |
tatra vidhivaidapramāṇatvamatyaḥ tattvato nirṇītāḥ |
guṇavidhiniṣedhaṃ parīkṣatam |
saṃdigdhānā-marthānāṃ vākyaśeṣādvādhyavasānamuktam |
tatra prasasta-vyam |
anantaraṃ pradhānāpradhānāni parīkṣyante, bhinnanya-bhiyāni ceti |
eṣā evārtho varṇanīyo nānyaḥ |
eṣa eva cādhyāyasaṃvandhaḥ |
vā-- saṃvandhaṃ tāvat lakṣaṇadvayasya karoti |
tatra ‘prame'dhyāye pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam’ ityuktam ( bhāṣye ) |
tat kutaḥ ? naiva hi prathame'dhyāye sūtrakāreṇa kiñcana lakṣaṇe pramāṇādeḥ svarūpamupavarṇitam |
tatrāma lakṣaṇamucyate, yena tadvyatiriktatveḥ tasya svarūpaṃ vyāvṛttākāraṃ nirūpyate |
na ceha pramāṇādīnāṃ lakṣaṇa-muktam |
anumānādīni tāvat naiva sūtrāṇi |
pratyakṣa-mapi dharma prati animittatvena upanyastam, na lakṣaṇatvena iti vyākhyātam |
na ca śabdo'pi kaścit dharmapramāṇa-bhūto lakṣitaḥ, asminevādhikaraṇe tasya lakṣaṇatvāt |
yadi ca vṛttikāreṇa sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pradarśitam, na tada adhyāyārthatvena upasaṃhartuṃ yuktam, sūtrādhyāyārthādhyāyārtha-madhyāyamapyupalena samāsaḥ |
sudhā |
) kathaṃ ca samasta-lakṣaṇavyatirikte evāye sūtrāṇi kṣīyan |
athiva vṛttikāreṇa yo'pi uktaḥ (pramāṇa) ghaṭakaḥ pratyakṣapūrvakaḥ aparīkṣyatayā, so'pi naiva lakṣaṇagocaraḥ |
lakṣaṇasiddhā-rthāni hi tāni aparīkṣyatvenoktāni, na prathamādhyāya-viṣayatvena upasaṃhāramarhanti |
tasmāt yat prathamādhyāye vṛttam, tadālocya etadadhyāyaṃ neyam |
tatra pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ tāvat codanālakṣaṇaśraya (śravaṇam iti yuktam ) |
vidyāditatvanirṇatiḥ pramāṇenaiva sthitā |
samasto hi prathamaḥ pādaḥ : codanāsūtraparikaraḥ |
tatra ca dharmasya codanā-lakṣaṇamuktam |
ataḥ avacāritālakṣaṇaśabdasahacaryāt pramāṇaśabdaḥ ‘pratipādyate’ ityevaṃ vyutpādya dharmaviṣayaḥ eva vyākhyāyeyaḥ |
satyapi prameyamātravācitve asmin śāstre jijñāsyatvena dharmaḥ prameyaḥ prakāntaḥ; iti sa eva gṛhyate |
( pūrvaṃ pramāṇaśabdasya karmavyutpattiḥ- ) athavā karaṇeva pramāṇam, tasyaiva lakṣaṇamuktam |
yadyapi ca sarvapramāṇatāṃ tanoktam, tathāpi dharmapramāṇasya codanātvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ityetāvadeva uktaṃ manyate |
na cāvaśyaṃ sarvamainaiva lakṣite lakṣaṇatvam, viśeṣarūpāṇāmanyena sarvalakṣaṇabhāvāprasaṅgāt |
athapi aucityakasūtreṇa viśeṣo'-pyuka eva yena āgamaviśeṣo gamyate |
athavā upanyastasya codanātmakasya pramāṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇya-kāraṇamityupasaṃhāraḥ |
tathā yadyapi ‘vicitedaṃ rūpam, idamarthavādasya, idaṃ mantrasya’ ityevaṃ noktam, tathāpi dharma prati upayogibhānāt tattvaṃ nirṇītam |

vakṣyamāṇamanusaṃkīrtyate, pradarśitamucyamānaṃ sukhaṃ grāhayiṣyate iti, śrutuśca buddhiḥ samādhīyate |
tadetannākarmalakṣaṇamityayāmācakṣate, etat tātparyaṃ ato'nyupadotpātaprasakkānuprasaktaṃ ceti |
vā-- 'ṣaḍvidhaḥ karmabhedaḥ' iti sādhanabhedopa- cārāt |
vakṣyamāṇasūtrakramānurodhānāmarthe saṃkhyāntare paṭhitavye sat anādisattve paṭhitam |
itikaraṇau hetvartheḥ |
ṣaḍvidhaḥ karmabhedaḥ etaiḥ kāraṇairiti yāvat |
athavā karaṇe bhedaśabdaṃ vyutpādya sāmānādhikaraṇyenaiva śabdāntarādīni vyākhyāsyeti |
saṃjñāśabdāntarayoḥ saṃkhyā- guṇayośca adhīnatvaṃ svasthāne vakṣyāmaḥ |
sarvadā caiṣāṃ tadbhedapratipādanamātraṃ tātparyaṃ |
anyadupoddhātaprasakkānu- prasaktatvādinā |
tatra 'cintāṃ prakṛtasiddhayarthāsupo- ddhātaṃ pracakṣate |
prasakkānuprasakkādi prastutādupa- jāyate ||
' yathā idamadhikaraṇaṃ prakṛtānuniṣpādyapūrva- bhedānumārasiddhayarthaṃ upoddhātatvena bhaviṣyati |
(anu- sarati iti kartari ghañ vyutpādya prakṛtau yaḥ anuniṣpādya- pūrvabhedaḥ medānusārī karmabhedaḥ, tassidarthamiti yojyam |
) katarassāt padāt phalena saṃbadhyamānāt apūrvabhedābhedau anugantavyau iti |
(anena ca 'nāmārthasya phalabhāvanā- karaṇatvaṃ dhātvarthasya vā' ityadhikaraṇārthaḥ sūcitaḥ |
) bhāṣyam-- (pratipadādhikaraṇam) tatra prathamaṃ tāvadidaṃ cintyate |
prathame'dhyāye idamukam 'codanā- lakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ' iti |
codanā ca kriyāyā abhi- dhāyakaṃ vākyam |
vākye ca padānārthāḥ |
tatra kiṃ padenapadena dharmaḥ, uta sarvaireka eveti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? pratipadaṃ dharma iti |
evaṃ prāpte, ucyate |
yadā ekassātpūrvam, tadā anyat tadarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, evama- līyasī aṣṭamānumānaprasaktyaiva bhaviṣyati |
tasmā- dekamapūrvam |
vā-- yadā niravayavaṃ vākyavākyārthau syātām, 'tataḥ kiṃ pratipadaṃ dharmaḥ ?' ityādiḥ asaṃbaddha eva vicāraḥ syāt |
ata āha-- (bhāṣyaṃ) 'vākye ca padānārthāḥ' iti |
atrāpi codyate |
'codanā- lakṣaṇatve vākyārtho'vasthito yadā |
dharmaḥ prati- padaṃ vācyaḥḥ kathamāśaṅkyate tadā ||
' yadi hi dharmasvarūpamabhidhīyeta, tataḥ 'kiṃ padenapadena' ucyate iti vicāro yujyate, lākṣaṇikaṃ tvayuktaḥ |
taducyate
'dharmatvaṃ phalasaṃbandhāt padārthasyaiva yujyate |
tatki- meksya sarveṣāmiti yuktā vicāraṇā ||
' na cātra yo dharmaḥ sa kiṃ padenapadenocyate ityevaṃ vicāryate |
kiṃ tarhi ? yaḥ padenapadenocyate, sa kiṃ phalasaṃbandhottarakālaṃ vākyārthatvena gamyamāno dharmo bhavati, athetapadārthāt- gṛhītaḥ |
ekaḥ padārtha iti |
tathā ca sarverekasya dharmatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati |
sākṣāt phalasādhanamātrasya dharmatvā- dyupagamāt |
na tu sarveṣāmekaḥ kaściddharmo'sti, yaḥ sarvai- reka ityevāmāśrayeta |
yacca phalapadena saha saṃbadhyate tasyārtha dharmapūrvasādhanaṃ ca manyante |
tena kiṃ sarvāṇi padāni phalena saṃbadhyante kiṃvā ekamiti vicāraḥ |
kiṃ prāptam ? pratipadamiti |
kutaḥ ? 'aikarūpyeṇa saṃbandhaḥ pradhānena ca sidhyati |
tasmāt phalapadenaiva sarvaṃ saṃbadhyate padam ||
' yadi hi viśeṣo gamyeta 'idaṃ phala- saṃbandhayogaṃ idaṃ na' iti, tataḥ kiñcideva saṃbadhyeta |
anavagamyamāne tu sarvāṇi padāni phalena saṃbadhyante |
yadi ca ekaṃ phalasaṃbandham itarāṇi ca tatsaṃbandhīni iti kalpyate tato vājapeyādhikaraṇanyāyena ekasya phala prati upādānavidhānaguṇābhāvāt itarat pratyudeśānuvādaprādhānyāt vairūpyanimittavākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ tu phalaṃ prati upādīmānānāṃ aikarūpyāt tantrasaṃbandhopapattiḥ |
sarvaśca sati saṃbheve guṇamatitadvya pradhānenaiva nityaṃ saṃbadhyate |
tasmāt sarveṣāṃ phalasaṃbandhāt dharmatvam |
tatra kiṃ sannivat pratyekaṃ kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ sādhayati, atha darśāpūrṇamāsavatasaha |
tathā kiṃ vikalpena samuccayena vā ityādi yatheṣṭaṃ kalpanī- yam |
tatra phalabhūmagarīyastvāt ekaśabdopādānābhāvāt sannivat pratyekaṃ sādhanaśaktatvagamāt sarvebhyaḥ pṛthak phala- miti pakṣaḥ |
athavā aruṇā''dinyāyena ekavākyo- pādānāt saṃhatānāṃ phalam |
athavā ekanirākāṅkṣatvāt na tadānīmeva itarasaṃbandhopapattiḥ, tasmāt vikalpa iti |
atrābhidhīyate 'phalena yasya saṃbandhastato'pūrva prakalpyate |
tadalpatopapattau ca na yuktā bahu- kalpanā ||
' yadi hi phalasaṃbandhamātrārthasāvyeva vākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ kadācidapi sarvāṇi phalena saṃbadhyeran |
iha tu tāvanmātreṇa asiddheḥ apūrvamanyat kalpayitavyam |
tacca anupapattipramāṇakam |
tatra ekāpūrvakalpanāyā upapanne nādṛṣṭāntarakalpanāpramāṇamasti |
yo hi anekāni apūrvāṇi kalpayati, kalpayatyasau ekam |
tacet kalpitam, artha- vattvād vākyasya kṣīṇā anyathā'nupapattiḥ |
nāpūrvāntarasya pramāṇaṃ bhavati |
tasmādekameva phalasaṃbandhaṃ, tasmācca apūrvaṃ itarat phaladupakāri ityevavyadīvyate |
na cātra virodho bhaviṣyati, nāmadheyatvena parihārāt, agnyā vā 'daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' itivat matvarthalakṣaṇayā''- śrayaṇāt arthākṣiptasādhyāṃśadvāreṇa vā dhātvartheḥ ātmīya- karaṇagrahasiddheḥ |
evaṃ sthite kataradekaṃ saṃtrayatāmiti sarvathā anekā- dṛṣṭakalpanāparihārāt aniyamaprāptau ucyate 'pradhānaṃ phalasaṃbandhi tatsaṃbandhyuṣyiṣyate |
pradhānāṅgatva- mekasya na caikatvākalpyate ||
' na hi ekasmin vākye tadeva kadācit phalasaṃbandhāt pradhānam, kadācit phala- vadupakārāt aṅgaṃ yujyate, niyatarūpatvād dvāntibhāvasya |
tasmāt niyogeneva ākhyātapadāt nāmapadādvā apūrva- pratītiḥ |
śā-- yāvatkiñcit ahārthaṃ vidhānaṃ kalpyaṃ puru- ṣārthaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā dravyopapadaṃ vā nāmopapadaṃ vā guṇopapadaṃ vā-- tā tat sarvamudāharaṇam |
(prābhākaramatamupa- nyasya nirasyati--) ke cittu adhikāracodanā evo- dāharanti |
tāsu ca sarvāsu viruddhatrikadvayāpatyā nāme- vopapadam |
ato nāmopapadānyevodāharaṇaṃ ityāhuḥ |
tada- yuktam |
yadyapi tāvadadhikāracodanā evodā- haraṇam, tathāpi tāsu sarvāsu na nāmaivopapadam |
yadeva hi yaugika-vākyabheda-tatpratya-tadvyapadeśayuktam, tadeva nāmadheyam, itaracca adhikāravāgatamapi guṇārthameva |
yathā 'yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti sa cahuhotāraṃ juhu- yāt' iti cahuhotraśabdo mantravacanaḥ, na nāmadheyam |
tathā 'yathenamārtvijayāt sutaṃ santāṃ nihareran āmīgre juhuyāt daśahotāraṃ caturgṛhītenājyena' iti naimittikā- dhikāragataṃ ājyam na nāmadheyam |
na ca viruddhatrika- dvayāpattiḥ, matvarthalakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭavidhisaṃbhavāt |

upamānaṃ tu sādṛśyaviṣayatvāt anādaśaṅnīyameva |

hati 'jani- kartuḥ prakṛtiḥ' (pā0 1|4|30) iti sūtram |
atra janiśabdena jananameva vivakṣitam |
tenāyamarthaḥ, jananasya kartā jāyamānaḥ tasya yā prakṛtiḥ utpādakaḥ tasya apādānasaṃjñā bhavati |
na ca janiśabdena jagatyena jananamevamabhidhīyate, 'itikṛtipā dhātunirdeśe' iti svaya- meva pratiṣiddhatvāt |
tathā janikarturiti samāso'pyanu- papannaḥ; 'tujakābhyāṃ kartari' (pā0 2|2|15) iti tujantasya kartṛśabdasya svayameva ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhāt |
tathā akrapratyayāntasyāpi anena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhāt 'tatprayojako hetuśca' (pā0 1|4|55) ityatra sūtre tasya prayojaka iti tacchabdena saha akrapratyayāntasya prayojakaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi anupapannaḥ |
evamarthaviṣayānavadhāraṇatvādi na pramāṇam |
tathāhi, 'bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' ' ityatra kiṃ dhātuśabdapravṛttinimittam ? na tāvat guṇapāṭhaḥ; 'bhū sattāyām' ityatra 'sattā'śabda- syāpi dhātutvaprasaṅgāt |
nāpi kriyāvacanatvam, 'bhū' ityasyāpi adhātutvāpatteḥ |
ata eva na militayorapi dhātuśabdapravṛttinimittatvam, 'bhū sattāyām' ityeva kriyāvacanatvābhāvāt |
tasmādarthaniścayādapi aprāmāṇyam |
evaṃ kārakuśāsanamapi asaṃbaddhameva |
tathāhi, 'svatantraḥ kartā' iti kartṛlakṣaṇam |
atra ca svātantryameva na jñāyate |
yadi icchāprayatnādhāratvaṃ svātantryam, tarhi 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' 'sthālī pacati' ityatra akartṛlatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha dhātupātnyāpāratvaṃ kartṛtvam, tarhi pacatītyatra pacidhātunā sthālīsaṃmārjanopakramasya sikathapariṇamaparyantasya vyāpāra- niścayasya upapattatvāt sarvakārakāṇāmapi kartṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ karmādayo'pi adhikaraṇaparyantāḥ sarve eva durnirū- pyatvā ityuktamapi vārtike vistarabhayāt nocyate |

atha gaurityemādayaḥ śabdāḥ kimākṛtaḥ pramāṇam, uta vyakteḥ iti saṃdehe ucyate |

atra prabhākareṇa ya eva laukikāḥ te eva vaidikāḥ uta anye ityasyāpi vicārasya ākṛtirūpodyavātāmabhyupagatyāpi sākṣāt saṃgati- lobhāt aprāmāṇyena pūrvapakṣamuktvā pṛthak saṃgatirdarśitā |

asya ca vicārasya niṣprayojanatvamāśaṅkaya tatprayojanatvañca idamupoddhātena vicāryate kiṃ ye eva laukikāḥ śabdāḥ te eva vaidikāḥ, te evaiṣāmarthāḥ, uta anye iti |
tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo- 'bhisaṃdhiḥ — 'atha śabdānuśāsanam' ityuktvā 'keṣāṃ śabdānām, laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca' ityabhiyuktānā- meva śabdavidāṃ (mahābhāṣyākārāṇāṃ) vyapadeśabheda- darśanāt medastāvadagamyate |

na kriyā syāditi cedarthāntare vidhānaṃ, na dravyamiti cet |

atra ca vākyatrayaṃ 'na kriyā syāditi cet' ityekam, 'arthāntare vidhānaṃ syāditi cet' iti dvitīyam, 'na syāt dravyamiti cet' iti tṛtīyam |
vastutastu asmin sūtre ye pūrvapakṣahetavaḥ uktāḥ te pūrvaṃ sūtrerevoktāḥ iti punaranuvādo vyarthaḥ iti sūtramevedaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati |

vyaktyanabhi- dhāne'pi na prayogasya vibhāgaḥ nānāpyate |

na caitāvatā tannyāyaviṣayatvaṃ bhavati |

sa tu puroḍāśārthamevotpannaṃ upāttaṃ pālitaṃ ca kapālaṃ sādhanatvena gṛhṇāti |
[3] kaścit utpatteraprayojakaḥ , upādānapālanayostu prayojakaḥ , yathā- akṣāmyajñanaṃ na pāṃsunāmutpatteḥ prayojakam, khata eva tulyatvā siddhānāṃ teṣāṃ padagrahaṇarūpopādānasya prayojakaṃ pālanasya ca |
evaṃ prātardohyāgo 'pi aśītapītotpatteravya ūdhaḥsthitadugdhasya dohanarūpamupādānaṃ pālanaṃ ca prayuṅkte |
vājinayāgo'pi vājinotpatteḥ aprayojakaḥ tasyā āmi- kṣārthadadhyānayanādhīnatvāt , vājinopādānapālanayostu prayojaka eva |
[4] kaścit utpattereva prayojaka nopādānapālanayoḥ, yathā- āmiṣā vājinotpatteḥ prayo- jikā, nopādānapālanayoḥ |
evaṃ svargādiphalaṃ yāgotpatte- reva prayojakam, na yāgopādānapālanayoḥ |
utpattivyati- riktayāgopādānāsaṃbhavāt , kṣaṇikasya ca pālanasaṃbhavāt |
[5] kaścit utpattyupādānayoreva prayojakaḥ pālanamātrasya tu prayojakaḥ, yathā- sviṣṭakṛdāgādiḥ śeṣasya |
[6] kaścit upādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , notpattipālanayoḥ : yathā- grāvaṇi saptamapadanidhāne akṣāmyajñanaṃ asaṃskṛta- pāṃsupādānasyaiva prayojakam, na pāṃsutpattipālanayoḥ |
evaṃ carau tuṣopavāpo hastopādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , na tadutpatteḥ pālanasya vā |
evaṃ āgneyādigāgo devatāyāḥ uddeśātmakapādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , na devatotpatteḥ tatpāla- nasya vā |
[7] kaścit utpattipālanayoreva prayojakaḥ, na tūpādānasya, yathā- svargādiphalaṃ apūrvasyotpatteḥ prayojakaṃ pālanasyāpi dharmanāśakakarmanāśajalpasyādau
hi kṛte svargātpatteḥ, na tu utpattiyatiriktaṃ kiñcidasti apūrvasyopādānam, yat svargādinā phalena prayujyate |
[8] kaścit utpattyupādānayoreva prayojakaḥ , na pāla- nasya, yathā- agnīṣomīyasya vikāre nirupadadhau asati dīkṣite maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍadānaṃ daṇḍotpatyupādānayoḥ prayojakam, na tapālanasya pūrvavidyamānatvāt tasyeti |
evaṃ prayojakaḥ ādyabhedāt tṛtīyādibhedānāṃ ca gaṇanayā saptavidhaḥ |

) atirātravākye'pi yadi tadīya- kṛtyabhāvapūraṇavelāyāṃ etadupyante, tataḥ śeṣo bhavet|
na tu tathoktam, saṃsthānāṃ asamānavidhānatvāt, avāntara- prakaraṇe ca pratiṣedhāśravaṇāt|

sa tu (pratiṣedhaḥ) prāptimātrāpekṣatvāt upadeśamatideśaṃ vā anādṛtya ubhayatrāpi pravartate|
(prakṛtimātraviṣayatva- manujānāti-) śakyaṃ tu iha (api) vaktuṃ 'prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt' iti|

asti ceha arthabhedaḥ, prakṛtau vaikalpiktvāt atirātre ca codakaprāptasya nityapratiṣedhāt|
na etat (dviruktatvāpi) asti|
vakṣyati hi etat 'prati- ṣedhaḥ pradeśe, anārabhyavidhāne ca prāptapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt' (10|8|111) iti|
(sūryārthamupa- pādayati-) yasya śākhāhāte prāptiḥ nāsti, tasya prāptiṃ anamyanujñāya pratiṣedhāsaṃbhavāt avaśyaṃ pratiṣedhenaiva tadiṣyo'pi vidhiḥ aṅgīkartavyaḥ|
sa cet aṅgīkṛtaḥ, śākhatvāviśeṣāt tulyavat (vidhiviśeṣebhyoḥ) |
ataḥ sarvathā atirātre vikalpena bhavitavyam|
tasmāt dviruktatvāt upadeśātideśayośca prāptikālevaiṣamyāt prakṛtyarthataiva varaṃ iti|
nanu evaṃ sati 'agniṣṭome pra- ṇakti' ityanenaiva prakṛtitveḥ siddhatvāt anārabhyavādaḥ anarthakaḥ prāpnoti|
naiṣa doṣaḥ|
tena utpattiḥ, anena viniyogaḥ: ityevaṃ vyāpārabhedāt|
athavā anārabhyavādaḥ agniṣṭomavyatiriktaviṣayo bhaviṣyati|
nanu agniṣṭoma- vākyena upasaṃhriyate|
na śakyametat upasaṃhartum|
tannāma viśeṣavacanena upasaṃhriyate, yatra kṛtyupayoga asamarthaṃ kathañcit parokṣavṛttyā saṃyujyate, yathā sāsadasyam|
ataśca vikṛtyo bhaviṣyati tathā sati ca 'na prathamayajñe' ityanārabhyavādataḥ upapadyate iti atirātraprayamāhāre
niyamaprayogaḥ: agniṣṭome ca kevalavidhisaṃsparśāt nityaṃ prayogaḥ|
na hi tadvākyaśeṣo'pi ayaṃ bhavatītyuktam|
(ekadeśīya anārabhyavādasya vikṛtyarthatvaṃ nirasyati-) etāvatu iha avadhārayituṃ śakyam, nāyamanābhyavādaḥ prakṛtyanvaya gacchati|
yadi gacchet, tataḥ iṣṭipaśu- bandhānapi gacchet|
na ca gantumarhati, 'purastādupa- sadām' iti sthānaniyamasya tatrānupapatteḥ|
ato yatra upasadaḥ, tatra gacchati|
tataśca prāptikālavaiṣamyāt prakṛtau tāvat tāḥ (upasadaḥ) santi, iti antareṇāpi vacanaṃ gacchet, kimuta yadā vispaṣṭameva vacanam|
sphuṭasāmānyasaṃbandhasyāpi ca evamādeḥ upasaṃhāraḥ iti vyākhyātaṃ caturthādhikaraṇe (3|1|16 iti tu ṭippaṇyā- muktam) tasmāt utsyativiniyogābhyāmeva apunarukta- tvam|
evaṃ sati yeṣāṃ prakaraṇe eva pravartyapāṭhaḥ, taiḥ saha saṃgatārthatā bhaviṣyati|
(ekadeśyukaṃ dūṣayati-) yadi tarhi dvayorapi ekavākyatvena 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' ityayamartho niṣpannaḥ, tataḥ 'na prathamayajñe' ityetasya aprathamayajñe agniṣṭome ityevaṃ pravartamānasya na kaścit virodhaḥ iti pūrvadāsāt nityameva akaraṇeva bhavitavyam|
agniṣṭomavākyaṃ vikalpasiddhayai varṇayitumāha- (ataḥ) evaṃ varṇanīyam|
anārabhyavādasya prakṛtyarthatayā siddhayāṃ 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' ityetasya anyaprayojanatvāt pratiṣiddhapratiprasavārthatā gamyate|
nanu naivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ityuktam|
agniṣṭomayuktāvakyārthatvatvāt pratiṣedhaḥ iti brūmaḥ|
na hi anena saha paryudāsaḥ: avaklapate iti darśi- tam|
na ca anārabhyavādaḥ anagniṣṭomārthaḥ, yataḥ : tadvi- ṣayaḥ paryudāsaḥ avaklapate|
tena dvayorapi (paryudāsa- agniṣṭomavākyayoḥ) agniṣṭomaviṣayatvam|
ataśca yadyapi ayaṃ paryudāsaḥ, tathāpi ubhayoḥ sāmarthyāt vikalpenaiva bhavitavyam|
kutaḥ? 'nityaṃ hi kriyamāṇe'smin paryudāso vṛthā bhavet|
nityamakriyamāṇe vā puna- rvidhinirarthakaḥ|
' tataśca yasmādiktvāt cimyaddhiḥ paryudāsa āśrīyete, sa tasmin satyapi āgataḥ, iti varaṃ śabdasvaralasyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ eva āśritaḥ|
tena prathamāhāre agniṣṭome vikalpaḥ|
tatrāpi yadā keṣāṃ
cit idaṃśaṃ vacanaṃ 'kāmaṃ tu yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ syāt, tasya pravṛhyāt' iti, tadā pratiprasavavacanasya vikalpa- kāriṇaḥ kartṛviśeṣagāmitvāt tadviṣayaḥ eva vikalpaḥ, anyeṣāṃ nityamevābhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaḥ aśrotriyasya karmaṇi pravṛttiḥ, yena tat viśeṣaṇatvena śrūyate? satyaṃ prāptasya punarvacanaṃ tāvanmātraphalaṃ anarthakaṃ iti sāmarthyāt prakarṣagatirvijñāyate|
yathā 'abhi rūpāya kanyā deyā' ityatra abhi rūpatarāya iti gamyate|

vikṛtyantareṣu prathama- prayogānupapatteḥ nityameva karaṇam|
nanu tatrāpi 'na prathamayajñe' itideśāt agniṣṭomasvarūpasya ca prati- prasavanimittasya abhāvāt prathamaprayoge abhāva eva prāpnoti|

atirātraprayamāhāre tu sarveṣāmeva aprayogaḥ|

vi-- 'na prajñayādāyādaye krato so'nuṣṭhitāyuta|
pratiṣedhaḥ, kratau yukta uktā hyasyathā, pravṛṇa- ktyupasadyaḥ prāpti vākyāt kratau vidheḥ|
ādya- prayoge prāthamyāniṣedhaḥ kacideva saḥ|
' kacit anū- cānatiriktakṛte agniṣṭomaprathamaprayoge|
bhāṭṭa- anārabhyādhītaḥ pravargyaḥ: 'yavapravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti' iti śrutaḥ|
tasya ca 'purastādupasadāṃ pravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti' iti jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ:|
ayamabhicaritakratu- saṃbandhasahakṛtadviruktatvanyāyena tadupasthiteḥ|
na ca upasada- jñatvameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam|
upasadasya purastā- tkālapratiyogitvena svāthopasthāpakasya uddeśyasamarpakatvā- bhāvāt|
upasthitatvāt tadvācakapadāntarakalpanāyā uddeśya- tvāṅgīkāre tu upasadāṃ phalavattvajñānārthe jyotiṣṭomopasthite- rāvaśyakatvāt lāghavena tadarthatvopapatteḥ|
kauṣītaki- brāhmaṇe prakaraṇe eva pravargyāmnāyaḥ|
tatra ca 'na prathamayajñe pravañjyāt' iti śrutam|
prathama- yajñapadena sarvasaṃsthasya: sarvāvaśyaka jyotiṣṭomaḥ abhidhīyate, uta tadīyaprathamaprayogamātramiti cintāyām, prathamayajña- śabdo jyotiṣṭomanāmaiva 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajñotiṣṭomaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt, tasya prathamaṃ prayujyamānatvena pravṛttimittatvāt|
yadyapi ca anya- saṃsthānāṃ anyapadenābhidhānāt tāsu jyotiṣṭomatvakāla- tvavidhānāt sarvasaṃsthājyotiṣṭomasya prathamaṃ prayujyamāna- tvam, tathāpi jyotiṣṭomatvasāmānādhikaraṇyena tāvat tadastīti pravṛttinimittatvāt|
tato vākyāt prakara- ṇācca jyotiṣṭomatvāvacchedena ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ paryudāso vā yajñe 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' iti vacanaṃ tat paryudāsa- pratiprasavārtham|
tadapi ca 'kāmaṃ tu yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ syāt tasya pravañjyāt' ityanena upasaṃhriyate|
tena anūcānasya śrotriyasya agniṣṭomasaṃsthākajyotiṣṭome nityaṃ karaṇam, anyajyotiṣṭome nityamakaraṇam, vikṛtiṣu ca nityaṃ karaṇam|
iti prāpte, pratyakṣākasyaiva arthabodhopapattau atiriktakalpanāyā pramāṇābhāvāt, prathamaśabdasya ca apravṛttapravartanaviṣayatvāt āyaprayogaparatvāvagateḥ|
yajñaśabdasya ca lakṣaṇayā prayogaparatvam, prakaraṇāt jyoti- ṣṭomaprayajñaparatvameva vā aṅgīkṛtya prathamayajñapadena jyoti- ṣṭomasya, pāñcamikanyāyāt|
'prathamaṃ yajamāno'ti- rātreṇa yajeta' iti vacanādatirātrasaṃsthākasya ca|

tatra vicāryate, 'tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti kiṃ ayaṃ karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ, 'brahmasāmyālabhante' iti karmāntaracodanā, athavā pūrvaḥ paryagnikaraṇat pareṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ pratiṣedhārthaḥ, uttaraśca teṣāmeva kālāntare prati- prasavārtha iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? karmotsargaḥ |
karmaśeṣapratiṣedha ityarthaḥ |
śrutisāmānyāt āraṇyavat |
yathā 'paryagni- kṛtānyutsṛjanti' ityasya karmaśeṣapratiṣedha ityuktam 'śeṣapratiṣedho vā'rthābhāvādidāntavat' (9|4|13| 52) iti |
tathā śrutyā tulyaṃ śrutiḥ |
kimanayo- stutyatvam ? tatra karmāṇi coditāni 'vasantāya kapi- ñjalānalabheta' iti |
teṣu sarveṣu prākṛtā guṇāḥ prāptāḥ |
teṣu prāpteṣu paryagnikaraṇaṃ guṇakāṇḍaṃ punaḥ śrutam 'paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti |
nirguṇaṃ punarvacanamitarapari- saṃkhyāpakaṃ bhavatīti karmaśeṣasya pratiṣedhakaṃ vijñāyate |
evamevāpi 'prājāpatyānālabheta' iti coditānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathaiva sarvaśeṣu pratiṣedhaṃ paryagnikaraṇasya guṇakāṇḍasya nirguṇaṃ punarvacanaṃ karmaśeṣasya nivartakam |
yasāccaivaṃ tasmāt 'brahmasāmyālabhante' iti karmāntaracodanā syāt |
pūrvāpiśeṣyā brahmasāmyālabhante saptadaśa prājāpatyāniti |
ṭup- 'paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti paryagnikaraṇa- ntājñarītirvidhīyate |
tathaite prājāpatyā nirākāṅkṣīkriyante gṛhamedhīyavat |
'brahmasāmyālabhante' iti karmāntaram |
tatra yadeva dravyadevataṃ pūrvaiṣu yāgeṣu tadevanānupajyate |
saṃskārapratiṣedho vā vākyaikatve ṛtusāmānyāt ||
bhāṣyam-- na vā karmaśeṣapratiṣedha iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? saṃskārāṇāṃ prāptāvasarāṇāṃ tasmādavasarāta pratiṣidhya brahmasāmni pratiprasavaḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? vākyaikatve ṛtusāmānyāt |
ekamidaṃ vākyam 'tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjati' 'brahmasāmyālabhate' iti |
kathaṃ jñāyate ? ālabhata iti dravyadevatāsyāvaṇāt |
samāne ca kratau vākyaikatvaṃ bhavati |
tadā hi kevala ālabhyo vaktavyaḥ; dravyadevatoktatvāt |
atha vākyabhedaḥ syāt, tataḥ pūrveṇa karmaśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyeta, pareṇa karmāntaraṃ codyeta |
tatra dravyadevataṃ vaktavyam |
yattu pūrvoktaṃ saṃbhansta iti |
tattathaiva kṛtārthatvādinaha na saṃbhanyate |
tasmādekaṃ vākyam |
nanvekasmin kratau pūrveṇa saṃskārāḥ pratiṣidhyante, pareṇa vidhīyante ityarthamedāt vākyabheda eva bhavati |
na hi 'brahmasāmyālabhate' ityukte arthādeva paryagnikaraṇāntaṃ utsargaḥ siddhaḥ |
sa na vidhīyate |
tamanucca ālabhyaḥ kevala utkṛṣyateti nāsti ṛtusāmānye vākyabhedaḥ |
ṭup-- yathāsaraṃ prāptāḥ (paryagnikaraṇakālaḥ ālabhyamānasya) |
saṃskārāḥ asmin kāle na kartavyaḥ (kintu brahmasāmni) ityevamādi vākye upadiśyamāne aṅgītividhānaṃ na gṛhṇīmaḥ |
(tathā sati mithaḥ karmadvaye asya saṃbandhābhāvāt ) vākyabhedāt (tataśca karmabhedaḥ ; karmabhedādatyantamabhedaḥ iti) aṣṭakalpanāmāya |

tatra pūrvavākyena 'paryagnikṛtārān utsṛjati', 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālītvamutsṛjati' itivat paryagnikaraṇā-ntāṅgītividhānāt gṛhamedhīyādyavanāpūrvatvātpañcau uttarājñānāmakartavyatvāvagateḥ : 'brahmasāmyālabhate' iti 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' itivat karmāntaravidhiḥ |

bhāṣyam— asti jyotiṣṭome paśurbhīpomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣato yadagnīpomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatredaṃ samāmananti, 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sarvānuvacaneṣu sarveṣveṣu ca maitrāvaruṇaḥ syāt uta yatrānuvacane praiṣaḥ iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? sarvānuvacaneṣu aśeṣatvāt |
na hi kaścit viśeṣa āśrīyate, asminnanuvacane maitrāvaruṇaḥ asminneti |
tasmāt sarvānuvacaneṣu sarveṣveṣu ca maitrāvaruṇaḥ syāt |
vā— upadeśāt siddhe samākhyābādhe samastaikadeśaviṣayatvena vicāraḥ |
jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe eva etat śrūyate 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
pradarśanāyyaṃ tu agnīpomīye ityuktam |
tatra sarvapraiṣāṇāmācāryatvaṃ sarvānuvacanānāṃ ca hautrasamākhyānam |
tat kim tenopadeśena samastaviṣayaḥ ? samākhyāyorbādhaḥ, uta kaścideveti |
kiṃ prāptam ? praiṣānuvacanena maitrāvaruṇopādānāt uddiśyamānasyaiva śabdapratipāditasāhityavivakṣā-nupapatteḥ śrayamāṇaśca śabdaḥ samuccayamātraṃ pratipādayati netaretarayogasamāhārau, nityaṃ samāsamagatatvāt |
na ceha anvācayalakṣaṇaṃ ubhayostulyatvāt upapadyate, iti samuccayaḥ |
sa ca pṛthagapi sarveṣu anuṣṭhīyamāneṣu saṃbhavatyeva iti sāmānyavacanāt sarvapraiṣatvam |
puronuvākyādhikāro vā praiṣasannidhānāt |
bhāṣyam— puronuvākyā vā maitrāvaruṇaḥ anubrūyāt |
kutaḥ ? yatra praiṣānuvākyā ca sahocyete tatra maitrāvaruṇaḥ |
yatra kelānuvākyā, na tatra maitrāvaruṇaḥ |
yatra vā kevalaḥ praiṣaḥ tatrāpi na |
yatrame samuccīyate tatra sa bhavet |
tathāhi samuccitayoḥ taṃ samāmananti, 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
ca-śabdāt samuccitayorgamyate |
vā— na sarvapraiṣānuvacaneṣu aṣṭau bhavet |
ka tarhi ? puronuvākyāsu |
praiṣāntāni anuvacanāni puronuvākyāḥ |
tāśca prakṛtya etadvacanaṃ pravṛttaṃ 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ ?' iti |
tāśca tādṛśyo hautre eva paṭhitāḥ iti tasyaiva kevalasya prāpnuvanti |
yastu tāsāmante yaja iti śabdaḥ sa iṣṭaprakṛtiṣu tāvat agneṣu atideśena adhvaryoḥ prāpnoti |
somayāgeṣvapi 'praiṣeṣu ca prādhākārāt' (8|1|0|29) ityevaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyaiva |
athavā preṣakasya ubhaya kartṛtayā vakṣyamāṇanyāyena preṣyatvaṃ maitrāvaruṇa-varuṇasya kalpayitvā hotureva prāpnoti |
tathā adhvaryoḥ 'preṣya' iti praiṣāntarāmnānāt 'yaja' ityeṣa nivarta-mānaḥ pratiprasthātuḥ prāpnoti |
śeṣāṇi tu praiṣānuvacanāni nivartakatvaviśeṣatvāt nirākāṅkṣatvena iti na teṣu maitrāvaruṇavidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
puronuvākyānāṃ punaḥ ubhayāṃśapātitvāt ekapadārthatvena ca nānākartṛtvānāpatteḥ hoturarthośca pracayamānānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāt saṃnidhānācca yukto maitrāvaruṇavidhiḥ |
evaṃ caśabdo'pi sahaprayogā-dapi prakṛtyarthaḥ samarthito bhavati, praiṣasannidhānāt |
na ca 'preṣya' ityādayo'pi praiṣāḥ tasyaiva ātma-viṣayāḥ saṃbhavanti |
prātaranuvāke ca hoturuddeśanāt |
bhāṣyam— itaśca paśyāma na sarvānuvacaneṣu maitrā-varuṇaḥ iti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ prātaranuvāke hotardarśayati |
katham ? yatra hotṛḥ prātaranuvākamanubhavata upaśṛṇuyāt tadādhvaryūgṛhṇīyāt iti |
tasmāt sarvānuvacaneṣu maitrāvaruṇa iti |

aya jātivacanatvam, tadā uhena 'ghṛtamāsādaya' iti prayogaḥ |
siddhānte tu yaugikatvena vācyaliṅgatvāt ghṛtasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvena 'prokṣaṇamāsādaya' iti prayogaḥ |

evaṃ 'maitrāta- vīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityatrāpi 'māsaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityitat yajaśravaṇāt maitrāvīyā- nāmastatvarantatvābhāvāt pūrvasiddhasya sthānasthitatvedhā- tavīyopasthāpakatvameva |

phalasaṃskārayorapi svabhāvasiddha anupādeyatvaṃ brūmaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? samabhivyāhāryāpekṣameva |

tat deśakālanimittāmeva paraṃ svabhāvasiddham |
phalasaṃskārayostu na samabhivyā- hṛtakriyārthamupādeyatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ? kriyāyā eva tadartha- mutpādanamiti tadapekṣamanupādeyatvameva |

yato hyanumānadvāreṇa dravyadevatāsaṃbandhasya yāgapratipādakatvam |
na caikastaiva yajipadasya pūrvopasthāpane phale viniyoge caikadā karaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti phalasamabhivyāhṛta karmaṇaḥ śrutasyevānumitasyāpi agnihotrāditvat anupādeyaṃ pratyu- pādāna.śabdābhyāṃ karmāntarameva iti |

ucyate |

vi--- 'phalaṃ vidheyaṃ no vā, SSyo bhāvanāśa- stato'nyavat |
na bhāgyāṃśo vidheyaḥ syāt rāgāt tatra pravartanā ||
bhāṭṭa--- yadvā nānena lakṣaṇakaraṇam |
api tu phala- syāpītarāvat bhāvanāviśeṣaṇatvādidheyatvam |
na hanyā- śayogapi viśeṣaṇatvātiriktaṃ vidheyatvam |
yadi tu viśiṣṭa- bhāvanāvidhī arthāditādaśayorvidhīyate tata phalasyāpya- viśiṣṭam |
iti prāpte, viśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhāne ārthika- viśeṣaṇavidherāvaśyakatvāt, tasya ca yadaṃśe aprāpti- stadaṃśe eva kalpanāt, phalasya ca rāgāptatvena tatkalpane pramāṇābhāvādidheyatvam |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe śyenaphala- syābhicārasya vidheyatvātpiṣṭeyatvam |
siddhānte tu rāgaprāptatvāt 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhaviṣayatvam |
na ca hiṃsāśabdasya maraṇānukūlavyāpāravācitvāt, tasya ca vairimāraṇavyābhicāraphalakatvenarūpasya vihitatvāt kathaṃ niṣedhaviṣayatvamiti vācyam |
'abhicaran yajeta' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyatayā śyenasamānakartṛkatvāvateḥ : abhi- cārapadasya maraṇānukūlyenakartṛniṣedhanādādidurupapāyāra- vācitvāgatasyaiva śyenaphalatvāvācāyāt, rāgaprāptasya iti cāvaśyaṃ śyenana vivadanāttu- taccitena vairimāraṇam, na tu śyenanaiva sākṣāditi dhyeyam |
yattu vairiniṣṭho maraṇākūlavyāpāra evābhicāra- padārthaḥ, tatra ca yajamānasya prayojakakartṛttvamiti tasya niṣedhaviṣayatve'pi yajamānasya pāpatvamiti kena ciduktam, tacca śyenasyaiva prayojakavyāpāratvāt, tasya ca vihitatvāt tatkartṛttvena yajamāne pāpatvanupapatte- kṣitam |
yatra tu 'vairimāraṇako yajeta' iti śrutam, tatra vairimāraṇānukūlakartṛlaukikavyāpārābhāve'pi vairi- maraṇoparādanicchittatvādeva pāpamiti dhyeyam |

svidyat: pratipāditatvāt atrāpyekādaśānāṃ avayavānāṃ 'nyagrodhe: svidyakṛtaṃ yajati' ityādiṣu vyaṅgyādi |

nāpi prayojanārthāpadāna- iti pūrvapakṣayitvā, yāgasaṃbandhāpekṣasya trilasya aṅgai: nāntarīyakopādāna iti pratipattyapekṣābhāvānna pratipatti- saha samāsāsambhavādekādaśāt madhye trayāṇāṃ avāntara- saṃvandho ghaṭate |
vyaṅgyasya tu paśuyāgārthopapattaśca nāntarīya- sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ nirdhārayitumasamarthena yāgaśeṣāṇāmupādā- kopādānasya ākīrṇakaraṇatvena pratipattyapekṣāyā vacanābhāve nam |
kiṃ tarhi ? 'doṣṇo dakṣiṇasya pūrvādhārddhamadhye sama- puruṣabhedāccātra kācit pratipattirbhavet |
vacanasadbhāve vayati, guḍasya madhyataḥ, śroṇyā jaghanataḥ' ityekenāpyu- tu yathāvacanameva pratipattirbhavati |
tena yāgīyadravyasaṃskāra- deśena saṃbandhāt trīṇyavadhāritāni |
tairaiva viśeṣai: svidya- bhakṣaṇasaṃbandhānyathānupapattyā phalacamasasya somavat avaśyaṃ kṛyāga: kartavya iti siddhāntitam |
tena yathā śarairvigrahā- yāgasādhanatvaṃ kalpanīyam |
tatrāpi 'sa yadi somaṃ trima- vikāra:, tathā ihāpi ijyāśeṣāṇāmanijyāśerai: vikāra kṣayiṣyeta ' iti yajamānasaṃbandhibhakṣaṇakīrtanāt yāvat ( 10|1|311 ) iti |
ato'śrāpyanyathāśeṣeṇa phala- vyaṅgyeḍanupayujyamāno yajamānabhakṣaṇasaṃskāra: pratipadyeta, camasenejyāśeṣasya somasya vikāro na cirotsṛṣṭe |
evaṃ tāvataiva yajñabhāganārthapatyā saṃtratva iti yajamānacamasa ca sati utpattiṣṭa: soma: pradhānakarmaṇi yāge bādhito eva somaṃ vikaroti, na grahaṇamasāntareṇeti sthitam |
na bhaviṣyati |
'na somam' iti arthaprāptabhakṣaṇagata- naimittikatvādviśeṣasomaprāpto'pi na doṣa: |
evaṃ ca somanighṛttyanuvādena bādhāt atrāpyupapadyate iti |
sati krayābhivādisaṃskṛtanaitavya yajamānasya pāde prati- pādanīyam |
evaṃ 'yadi somaṃ na vindet pūtīkānabhiṣuṇu- ye tvādupakārakaṃ phalacamasasādhanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhīyata yāt ' ityatrāpi somābhāve somasaṃbandhino'mipavasvarūpa- iti pūrvapakṣayanti, taiśca pūrvapakṣavārtikākṣarāṇi anākali- saṃskārasya pūtīkeṣu darśanāt pūtīkānāṃ yāgasādhanatvamete- tāni |
na cāyaṃ pakṣo yuktasyāpi saṃgacchate, anekadoṣa- naiva nyāyenāvagantavyam |
duṣṭatvāt |
tathāhi, phalacamasantaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ pracchedāti viniyogabhaṅgi (?) na bhakṣaṇaṃ kuryāditi |
tathā soma- prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe yajamānasya camase'pi bhakṣaṇasya phalacamasenātulyakāryatvena anivartitatvāt somametanna yaṣṭavyam |
bhakṣaṇamātraṃ tu phalacamasasya |
siddhānte somiti nāyamarthaprāptānuvāda:, niṣedhaparatve ca vākya- tu phalacamaseneva yaṣṭavyam |
sūtraṃ tu ijyāyāṃ phalacamasena bheda: |
vihitasomabhakṣaṇapratiṣedhācca aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpā- somasya vikāreṇa bhakṣaṇamātra saṃskārasya bhakṣaṇarūpasya patti: |
tathā aṣṭadoṣakalpanādoṣa evāpyamihitā: |
tadarthatvāt yāgasādhanadravyatvāt iti |
tautā |

iti |

tena phalacamasaḥ saṃskārabhūtaṃ bhakṣamapasarpanneva śakyo niyoktum, ' yadi kaścidupayogaṃ gacchati, tato bhakṣaṇena saṃkriyase nānyathā ' iti |
sa copayujyamānatvaṃ prārthya- mānaḥ prakaraṇāt yāgopayogitvaṃ pratipadyate |
tatrāpi yāvat anupujyamāno yajamānabhakṣaṇasaṃskārārthatvaṃ na pratipadyate, tāvattaiva yaśabhāgena arthāpattyā saṃbadhyate ityava- dhāraṇāt yajamānacamasābhyāsenaikena saṃbadhyate |
nahi yahacamasāntareṣu anupayujyamānasyāsya yajamāna- bhakṣatvaṃ anupapannam |
ataḥ somo'pi anugṛhīṣyate |
yadvā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇena saṃśraddho'yaṃ bhakṣaṇaśabdaḥ uccārya- māṇaḥ prakṛtaṃ somamakṣameva avalambate |
sa ca yāgo- payuktadravyaśeṣasaṃskāratvena praśastaḥ iti phalacamasami- tādaśameva saṃskṛtaṃ śaknoti |
na tu asau idānīṃ anya- prayojanaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum |
na ca tasya karmā ntare kiñcit śabdāntarādadhikāramasti |
api ca ' sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet ' iti svavākyopāttenaiva somabhakṣaṇena sambandho vijñāyate |
anyathā hi tadupādānaṃ vyarthameva syāt |
na ca ' na somam ' ityanuvādāt avakalpate |
yadi bhakṣāntaramevamevāt ārāt upakārakaṃ coyeta, tataḥ samānakāryatvābhāvāt naiva somaṃ nivartayet |
ani- vartite ca tasmin na pratiṣedhenānuvādaḥ syāt |
na ca vidhiryuktaḥ, vākyabheda-anekādṛṣṭakalpanāprasaṅgāt |
asaṃśraddhaṃ ca vākyaṃ bhavet |
yadi somaṃ bhakṣaṇe saṃskṛtaṃ micchet, tataḥ phalacamasabhākṣaṇaṃ ārādupakārakaṃ kuryāt, phalacamasaṃ vā saṃskuryāt iti |
yadā tu ayamartho gṛhyate ' yena bhakṣaṇena yathābhūtaṃ somaṃ saṃskṛtamicchet, tena tathābhūtameva phalacamasaṃ saṃskuryāt ' iti, tadā arthāpattyā yajamānacamasābhyāsāt asaṃbandhaḥ kuto bhavati |

bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva ' yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet, sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet, nyagrodhastiminīrāhṛtya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhnyunmṛjya tasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet, na somam ' iti śrutam |

āyastu nimittatvapara eva |
stiminīḥ aṅkurān phalāni ca |
tatastasya phalacamasapadamadheyasya kiṃ bhakṣaṇa- mātram, kiṃvā yāgo'pīti cintāyām, nimittatvena apekṣitvasya yāgasya phalacamasānvitatvānupapatteḥ |
tacchabda- parāmṛṣṭasya ca tasya bhakṣānvayaśravaṇāt prāptāyāgānuvādena anekapepaṇādiguṇopaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedāpatteśca anekaguṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ bhakṣāntarameva phalacamasakaraṇakaṃ vidhīyate |
phala- camasasya viniyogābhāvena saṃskārātyanupapatteḥ satkunāyena viniyogabhaṅgasya āvaśyakatvāt |
tadapi ārādupakāraka- mapi yajamānasomabhakṣyasya bhakṣakam, ' na somam ' ityanu- vādabalāt, ' na girā giriti brūyāt ' itivat eka- kāryakāritvābhāve'pi bādhakasvarūpāyā eva sthānāpattervī- kārāt |
astu vā ayaṃ svatantra eva tanniṣedhaḥ |
iti prāpte, yadyapi bhakṣāntaramidam, tathāpi tasya na ārā- dupakārakatvam, ' tam ' iti dvitīyānirdeśena phalacamasa- saṃskārārthatvapratīteḥ |
anupayukttasya ca saṃskārāyoge'pi ' adhvaryuṃ vṛṇīte ' ityādivat viniyogakalpanā |
tatrāpi ' sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet ' ityādyanuvādatvāt yaja- mānakartṛkasomabhakṣasya ca tāvataivopāttaṃ sarvatra somabhakṣaṇena sarvārthatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt yajamānacamasāgyāmāsa- sādhanatvameva phalacamasasya kalpyate iti na kācidanupa- pattiḥ |
vastutastu, bhakṣāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt somabhakṣa eva yajamānakartṛkaḥ |
peṣaṇadadhyunmṛjyottarakāladvayaviśiṣṭaḥ phalacamasasaṃskāratvena viniyujyate |
' rājā rājasūyena ' prayogavidhānāt atrākyabhedaḥ |

naimittikatvācca tatra nityoma- bādhakatvam |
evaṃ ca sthānāpatyaiva phalacamase itarasoma- saṃskāravat yajamānabhakṣasyāpi prāptisaṃbhave pūrvapravṛttyā tadvidhvaikaraṇaṃ guṇadvayavidhānārtham, phalacamasasya yāga- sādhanatvasiddhaye ceti draṣṭavyam |

‘agrerahamujjitimanujjeyam’ ityādiśca agnyādiprakāśako mantraḥ śrutaḥ |
tayośca svargatvādi- tvādidaiva svargānvayoḥ liṅkakatvaśrutau uddeśyatā upa- sthitatvāt, na tu apūrvasaṃbandhatvena mukhye evārthe vini- yogasya autsargikatvāt : sādhitatvena tena rūpeṇa svargādi- padeḥ anabhidhānāt |
na ca svargādirūpe ānarthakyam, sākṣāt phala rūpasya tasya aniścitopāyatvāviśeṣaṇa tada- rthatve vaiyarthyābhāvāt |
mantrajapaprakāśanavyatirekena itarā- ṅgyukapradhānamātradeva utpattisiddheḥ ānarthakyaṃ apūrve- 'pi tulyam |

iti tu svarge'pi tulyam |
evaṃ devatāyāmapi mantrārthavādeti- hāsādivāt satyapi apūrve tajjanitadevatāprasādadeva phalotpattiḥ prasādasya ca mantrajapaprakāśanavyati- rekeṇa utpattau pramāṇābhāvāt tadarthatvam |

iti prāpte, na tāvat sarvagāmeva avaghātādīnāṃ apūrvārthatvamapahāya svargārthatvaṃ śaṅkituṃ śakyam, brīhyādipadena pratyāsannatayā tepāmathādhikaraṇa-yāyena āgneyādyutpatyapūrvasādhanatvasya lakṣaṇāt |

ani- vāritasāmarthyaprāptaṃ kimiti bādhyate |
' api ca 'mukhya: pratyāyyate kasmādgauṇe'pyarthe vivakṣite |
anyathā'nupapattyā cenna dhyānādyupapattita: |

yuktasteṣāmutakarṣa: |

vā-- anaudite pūṣādau, darśapūrṇamāsayormantrānna viniyujyante, yuktameva tat |

' tasmādubhayatra (mukhye gauṇe ca) viniyoga: |
iti prāpte, abhīyate |

āvirbhavati, mukhye tu śabdādevāvirvarita tat |
tātparyaṃ ca khato mukhye, gauṇārthaparatā puna: |
pramāṇāntaravijñeyā tadbhāvātra sidhyati |
' soma-- prayojanam- mantrāṇāṃ gauṇe'pi viniyoge prākṛtānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā vaikṛtadravyadevatā- ''diprakāśakatvasaṃbhavāt uhāsasiddhi:; siddhānte tu mukhyā- rthatvāya uhasiddhiditi |
sūtrārthastu - yat : kāraṇāt arthābhidhānasaṃyogāt arthābhidhānalakṣaṇadarsayogāt mantreṣu kratuśeṣatvaṃ syāt |
tasmāt utpattisaṃyoga: autpattikena mukhyārthenaiva saṃyoga: syāt, tenārthena nityasaṃyogāt iti |
vi-- 'deyopasadanārhaditāmīgimulgaiyoṇayo: |
ta- liṅgamarthyayormantraṃ niyukte mukhya eva vā |
, śabdārtha- tvād dvyostatra yujyate viniyojanam |
prathamagatatvena mukhye tad viniyampate |
bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ śrutūpayogivicāre vṛtte adhunā liṅgo- payogivicāra: prastūyate |
tatra liṅgaṃ nāma ajñatvaghaṭakī- bhūtaparodeyatvakṛtikārakavācakapadakalpanākulā klapta- suvanitvā dravyadvayapadakalpanā''nukūlā |
evaṃ mantreṣu svārthe- vṛṣṭyuddeśyatāvācipadakalpanā''nukūlā svavṛttikārakatvādi- padakalpanā''nukūla ca yogyatā liṅgam |
sā ca padarūpa- śrutikalpakatvāt taddvārā tadarthaviniyoge pramāṇam |
tatra vastusāmarthyarūpasya liṅgasya viśeṣavicārāsaṃbhavāt mantra- sāmarthyarūpasya ki śakye evārthe viniyojakatvam, uta jaghanyavṛttipratipādye''pi saṃdehe, ṛtūpakaraṇamātramantrasya 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityādimukhye iva jaghanye'pi utsa- rājyādau smārakākāṅkṣādirūpasāmarthyaviśeṣatvāt tatsā- dhāraṇyena viniyoga: |
'yathī: praveśaya' ityādi- vadākāṅkṣā''dirūpatāpatyagrāhakasattve mukhyārthābādhasya akiñcitkaratvāt |
iti prāpte, śakyasaṃbandhagrahasāpekṣatvena jaghanyārthapratītirvilambitātvāta jaghanyārthapratītimukhyārthaviniyogena caritārthasya mantrāde: jaghanyārthaviniyogo'nupapatte: |
ata eva tatsmārakākāṅkṣayā dhyānādyupāyāntareṇaiva nivṛtti: |
ata etra yatra prakaraṇe mukhyārthopayogo na klapta:, tatra mantrāmnāyabaladeva tatkalpanā |
yatra tu virodhaguṇānāntarāvarodha: prakaraṇe, tatra sāmānyasaṃbandha- bodhakapramāṇasattve utkarṣa: yathā darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇamāta- pūpānānmantramantrāde: ; yāgānumantraṇamākhyāyā eva sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakatvāt |
utkarṣasyāpyasaṃbhave prakaraṇe eva jaghanyārthe viniyoga: yathā manotā''dau |

bhāṣyam-- uktāni viniyogakāraṇāni śrutiḥ liṅgaṃ vākyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sthānaṃ samākhyānamiti |
teṣāṃ samavāye kiṃ valīya iti cintyate |
ekārthavṛttitvāt vāco yugapada- saṃnatvāt dvayordvayoḥ saṃpradhāraṇā |
śrutibalāvalavicāraḥ-- tatra śrutiliṅgayoḥ kiṃ śrutirbalīyasī, āhosvit liṅgamiti |
kiṃ punaratrodāharaṇam ? 'aindyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti |
atra cintyate |
kimindrasya gārhapatyasya vopasthānaṃ kartavyamitiniyamaḥ uta gārhapatyasyaiveti |
yadi tulyabale ete kāraṇe, tato vikalpaḥ |
atha śrutirbalīyasī, gārhapatya evopastheyaḥ |
kiṃ punaratra śrutiḥ ? kiṃ liṅgam ? śrutirgārhapatyaśabdaśravaṇam |
liṅgaṃ punaḥ 'kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe' iti indraśabdasya viśiṣṭadevatābhidhānasāmarthyam |
atha kiṃ vākyaṃ nāma ? saṃhṛtya arthamabhidadhāti padāni vākyam |
yathaiva- midamapi vākyam 'aindyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti, idamapi 'kadā cana starīrasi' iti |
ubhayatrāpi saṃhṛtya
arthamabhidadhati padāni |
tena vākyasya vākyasya caiṣā saṃpradhāraṇā, na śrutiliṅgayoḥ |
yadi vā, śrutiliṅga- vākyāni vivektavyāni, idaṃ śrutivākyayorantaram, idaṃ liṅgavākyayoriti |
tadabhidhīyate, yattāvacchabdasyārtha- mabhidhātuṃ sāmarthyam, talliṅgam |
yadarthasyābhidhānaṃ śabdasya śravaṇāmātrādevāvagamyate, sa śrutyā'vagamyate |
śravaṇaṃ śrutiḥ |
ekārthamekaṃ padaṃ vākyamityuktameva |
tadetat sarva- ṣveva vākyeṣu samavetaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ ca dṛśyate |
iha tāvat, 'kadā cana starīrasi' ityanena mantreṇa indra upasthātavya iti naitat kasya cicchabdasya śravaṇādevāvagamyate |
nāpi śabdāntarasya samīpe uccāritasya sāmarthyamasti, yenaitadava- gamyeta |
etasyāṃ khalu ṛci indraśabdo vidyate, yo viśiṣṭaṃ devatāmavagamayituṃ śaknoti |
tayā cāgamayitvā prayojana- mastīti |
tenendropasthāne indraśabdaḥ prayujyate |
tadekavākya- tvācca aviśiṣṭhāni padāni |
na tvevamasmābhiḥ kasya cicchabdasya sāmarthyārhaṇapatyasyopasthānaṃ bhavati |
śravaṇādeva tu gārhapatyaśabdasya vayamapi pratīmaḥ, na liṅgāt |
yadi tu liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, indra upasthātavyaḥ |
yadi gārhapatyaśab- dam, tato gārhapatyaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi liṅgavākye virudhyamāne iha saṃpradhārye, na śrutiliṅge |
indraśabdasya viśiṣṭadevatā- bhidhānasāmarthyādindropasthānam, yadi liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ; atha nu vākyam, gārhapatya upastheyaḥ |
vākyaṃ hyetat, 'aindyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate iti |
naitadevam |
yadyapi eta- dvākyam, śrutirapi antarāsti, yā tvatra śrutiḥ, sā liṅgena virudhyate, na yadākyam |
katham ? balīyasyapi hi liṅge, aindyopatiṣṭhate ityetadarthāpatterapi saha ekavākyatvāmu- paityeva |
yadi hi nopayeyāt tato liṅgena virudhyeta |
yastu gārhapatyaśravaṇādevārthaḥ pratīyate, sa liṅgena balīyasi pari- tyakto bhavati |
nāsau upasthāne saṃbadhyate |
tathā hīndra- gārhapatyaśabdo'bhivadedisamīpam |
atha nu śrutiḥ : pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tato liṅgenāvāgata indropasthānaṃ bādhyate |
tasmāt śrutiliṅgayoreva virodhaḥ, na liṅgavākyayoriti |
athavā nātraikavākyatvāt indrādhyānāṃ gārhapatyādhyānāṃ vopasthānasya |
kutastarhi ? indraśabdavattvāt mantrasya indra- prādhānyam, dvitīyāvibhaktiśravaṇāt gārhapatyādhānyam |
tasmāt śrutiliṅgayorvirodhaḥ |
vā-- ( asmin adhikaraṇe vārtikātpūrvaṃ bhāṣyādyanusāreṇa manāka parivartatā ityeveyam |
) idānīṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi śrutyādīnāṃ balāvalaṃ vicāryate |

tatra kecidāhuravirodhagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti |
kutaḥ ? 'krīṇātyaruṇayetyatra samavāye hi satyāpi |
virodhābhāvato naiva cintyanti balāvalam |
' eka eva haraṇādiḥ śeṣaḥ śrutyādiprakriyāsaṃbandhī, vākyena tadviśeṣasya krayasya, prakaraṇena jyotiṣṭomikasya |
satyapi vācanikaprakaraṇasamavāye parasparānugrahanimittatvād- virodha iti balāvalavicāro na bhavati, nirviśeṣasāmānyā- nupapatteḥ |
krayasvarūpamātrayuktatve cānarthakatvāt apekṣite hi śrutivākyābhyāṃ vākyaprakaraṇe |
tasmāt kartavyaṃ virodha- grahaṇamiti |
na vā kartavyam |
kutaḥ ? 'samānaviṣayatvaṃ hi samavāye'bhidhīyate |
na caikārthye pramāṇānāṃ śeṣāṇāmavagamyate |
' aruṇādī tāvat naiva pramāṇa- samavāyo'sti |
nahyekatra saṃbhavamātraṃ samavāyaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? viṣayaikatvam |
iha cāruṇyāḥ krayasaṃbandhaḥ śrutyā |
tasya tu śrutikalpitakriyākārakasaṃbandhasya bhūyo'pyapekṣā- vaśena krayaviṣayatvam |
tāvatā ca prayojanānavāpteḥ apekṣāntare sati apūrvasaṃbandhavataḥ krayasya jyotiṣṭomārtha- tvamiti viṣayānānātvam |
ataśca sarveṣāṃ viniyogaja- katvamāviruddham |
na cātra viprakṛṣṭagrahaṇe saṃnikṛṣṭasya bādho dṛśyate |

samānapratyaya- śrutyā balīyasyā kriyākṛtā |

śeṣaśeṣibhāvaśca pratyekaṃ viviccyodāhartavyaḥ |

viparīto'pi ceha bādho bhavati |
pūrvapūrvamapi hyānumānikaṃ paraṃpara- ṇāpi pratyakṣeṣaṇa prāpyate |
yathā kṛṣṇeleṣu sāmarthyenāvāptaḥ |

yathā smṛtivaidikaliṅga- virodhe |

pauroḍāśi- kamiti samākhyāte darśapūrṇamāsakāṇḍe paṭhito mantraḥ sādhāraṇe prakaraṇe vartamānaḥ krameṇa cānumīlitaliṅgena aviniyujyamānaḥ puroḍāśasyaiva prāthamyāt prāpnu- van, śrutyā sāṃnāyyasyāsājñātvena vidhīyate 'iṣe tvā śākhāṃ chinatti' iti |

evaṃ tāvadekasya śeṣasya anekaṃ śeṣaṃ prati nīya- mānasya virodha udāhṛtaḥ |

tadyathā śrutiliṅgayorvirodhe 'aindrā gārhapatya- mupatiṣṭhate' iti mantrakaraṇarūpāpattividhāne kṛte liṅgāt kasmiṃścidāgneye mantra śeṣatvena prāpnuvati śrutyaindrī vini- yujyate |
tadavaruddhe copasthāne netarasyākāṅkṣā vidyate |

(pṛ. 838) |
śā- nanu liṅgavākyayoreva (atra) virodhaḥ, na śrutiliṅgayoḥ |
atrābhidhīyate— 'satyaṃ vākya- virodho'sti śrutiścāpi virudhyate |
sahite hi virudhyete, na tu liṅgena kevale ||
' iti śrutiliṅgayoreva virodhaḥ |
'tatra svataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ liṅgādeḥ śrutivanmatam |
sāmarthyālocanādeva tādarthye hi pratīyate |
na tu gārhapatyārthatā śrutyetyu- stulyakakṣatā |
tena dvayopasthānāt vikalpena bhavi- ṣyati ||
samuccaya eva mantraḥ prayujyeta dvayorapi |
pratipradhānamāvṛttirguṇenāpi na virudhyate ||
yadyapi syād baliyastvaṃ śruterliṅgāta, tathāpi tu |
avi- rodhādvādhaḥ syāt saṃbhavī hi samuccayaḥ ||
yadvā sāmarthyarūpatvāt liṅgaṃ syāt prabalaṃ śruteḥ |
vastu- śaktyanusārī hi sarvaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate ||
, atrā- bhidhīyate satyaṃ yadyalantasamakakṣatā |
gārhapatye tu sāmarthyaṃ gauṇaṃ mantrasya vidyate ||
guṇādvā'pya- midhānaṃ syādityatraitaddhi sādhitam |
tanna tāvad balīyastvaṃ liṅgasya na ca tulyatā ||
viniyogaḥ śruteḥ pārthe (samīpe) liṅgasyārādasau sthitaḥ |
yāvadeva hi mantrārtho mantreṇa pratipādyate ||
, tāva- deva śrutimantraṃ gārhapatyārthatāṃ nayet |
mantrārthaṃ mantrato buddhvā paścācchaktiṃ nirūpya ca ||
mantrākāṅkṣāvaśenendraśeṣatve śrutikalpanā |
śrutyā pratyakṣyā pūrvaṃ gārhapatyādgate ||
nirākāṅkṣī- kṛte mantre nirmūlā śrutikalpanā |
tena śīghrapra- vṛtyā śrutyā liṅgasya bādhanam ||
pratyakṣaṃ cānumāne ca yathā loke balābalam |
śīghrapravṛttitvāt tathedaṃ śrutiliṅgayoḥ ||
avirodhādvādho yo varṇitaḥ sa na yujyate |
liṅgasya hi pramāṇatvaṃ mantrākāṅkṣā- nibandhanam ||

gacchati |
virodhe ca śrutiliṅgaṃ balīyastvena bādhate ||
' soma -- evaṃ śrutyādibhiḥ viniyogaprakāre kathite sati adhyāyādau upakṣitaḥ balābalavicāraḥ prāptāvasaraḥ (iti saṃgatiḥ) |
vi- 'aindrīpsayītāṃ vahnirīndrānyovikalpanm |
samuccayo vota śakya evābhiḥ kevalo'thavā ||
, vikalpaḥ śrutiliṅgābhyāṃ guṇādyayā samuccayaḥ |
śrutiḥ śaktya- nusāreti śakya eko'sti liṅgataḥ ||
, śaktiraktā śrutiḥ śīghrā liṅgaṃ śrutyanumākam |
nairākāṅkṣyātmake bodhe śrutyā'sau kevale sthitiḥ ||
bhāṭṭa- tadevaṃ ṣaṭpramāṇeṣu nirūpiteṣu adhunā virodhe balābalaṃ nirūpyate |
virodhaikasya śeṣasya śeṣa- dvaye pramāṇadvasattve yathā aindrī mantrasya śrutyā gārhapatyā- ṅgatve liṅgasya indrāṅgatve |
yathā vā ekasmin śeṣeṇa śeṣadvayaviniyojakapramāṇadvaye yathā gārhapatye śrutyā aindrī- mantraḥ, liṅgādāgneyaḥ |
ayaṃ ca śeṣadvayaviniyogo dvāraisye satyeva balavatprayojakaḥ, na tu tadbhede'pi, vākya- prakaraṇābhyāṃ ye'dhaprayājādīnāṃ ekaśeṣatve'pi tada- bhāvāt |
yatra tu ekasya śeṣasya ekasminneva śeṣeṇa pramāṇadvayam, tatra vaiṣamye prabalasyaiva prayojanārthaṃ vini- yojakatvam |
sāmye tu ekasya viniyojakatvam, itarasya punaḥśrutivena prayojanāntarakalpanam |
niyāmaka- bhāve dvayorapyudayaśiraskatvakalpanāṃ karmāntaroghakatvaṃ vā |
evaṃ yatra 'aruṇā krīṇāti' ityādau āruṇyasyāpūrva- sādhanībhūtakrayārthatve pramāṇatrayam, tatrāpi śrutereva viniyojakatvam, na tvanyasya, vākyedeyasamarpakatva- mātratvāt |
ata eva na 'aindyā' ityatra liṅga- vākyavirodhaḥ |
vākyasya uddeśamātrasamarpakatvena śruti- sahakāritve'pi kṛtikārakatvabodhakatvaviniyojakatvā- bhāvāt |
prakaraṇaṃ tu apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇatātparyagrāhaka- mātram |
na tu tadapi viniyojakam, gauravāt |
ata eva viniyojakapramāṇabalamapi nirūpyameva |
tadiha śrutivirodhe aindrī mantrasya tṛtīyayā gārha- patyāṅgatvameva, na tu taditaśrutyā indrāṅgatvam |
tasya mī. ko. 367
sūktatvitvena prādhānyena kṛtikārakatvābhāvāt |
ataśca tasya mukhyaśrutitvābhāvāddurbalatvam |
evaṃ ca tasyaiva mantrasya liṅgāt indrāṅgatvamiti |
liṅgavirodhe- 'pi etadeva udāharaṇam |
atra hi sarvatra uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvakṛtvena prāmāṇyasya tattvanirūpaṇāvasare sthāpi- tatvāduttarottarasya śrutikalpaṃ yāvadavagatatve pūrvapūrveṇa śeṣaśeṣiṇo nirākāṅkṣatvāpādanena bādhaḥ |
na ca ajñānāṃ prakṛtyarthatvena irākāṅkṣaṇāmāpi vikṛtyākāṅkṣyāvātideśa- kalpanāt indrākāṅkṣayaiva liṅgasya śrutikalpatvo- papattiḥ, tasya dhyānādyapāyāntareṇāpi smṛtisiddheniyamana vikṛtitadanākāṅkṣatvāt |
ataḥ śrutyā gārhapatyatvameva |
na ca śruteḥ karaṇatvamātrābhidhāyakatvena gārhapatyanirū- pitatvasya vākyādhīnatvāt nāyaṃ śrutiliṅgavirodha iti vācyam |
tathā'pi hi brāhmaṇavākyatvena mantraliṅgāpekṣayā 'yadyapyanyadeva' paśyuḥ' iti itavat prabalatvopapatteḥ |
vastutastu yathā na kevalyā śrutyā virodho naivaṃ vākye- nāpi, tathā'pi gārhapatyasamīpe ityevamupapatteḥ |
ataśca ubhayavirodhe'pi 'pradhānena vyapadeśā bhavanti' iti nyāyena śrutiliṅgavirodhodāharaṇam |
maṇḍana - 'balīyasī śrutiliṅgāt |
' śaṃkara - 'śrutyā liṅgasya bādhaḥ syāt |
' (liṅgabalābalavicāraḥ---) bhāṣyam-- liṅga- vākyayorvirodhe kimudāharaṇam ? 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suṣedhaṃ kalpayāmi |
tasmin sīdāmṛte pratiṣṭhe vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ||
' iti |
atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kṛtsno mantra upastaraṇe puroḍā- śāsādanaṃ vā prayoktavyaḥ, uta kalpyā'myanta upastaraṇe, 'tasmin sīda' ityevamādiḥ puroḍāśāsādane iti |
yadi vākyaṃ balīyastataḥ kṛtsna ubhayatra |
katham ? 'ghṛtaidhaṃ kalpayāmi' ityetadapekṣa 'tasmin sīda' ityevamādiḥ pūrvaṇevākyavākyatāpyat kalpyā'mi tasmin sīdeti |
atha liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, tataḥ kalpyā'myanta: sadanakaraṇe |
katham ? 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi' iti sadanakaraṇa- mabhivaditumayamalamiti |
'tasmin sīda' ityayamapi puroḍāśaṃ sādayitumiti sādanaṃ viniyujyate |
kiṃ tāvat
prāptam |
tulyabale ete kāraṇe iti |
yathā liṅgaṃ prati śruterbalīyastvamuktam , na tathā vākyaṃ prati liṅgasya ucyate |
athavā vākyameva liṅgāt balīyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? taddhi śrutyā'pi bādhyate |
na ca balīyaḥ kāraṇaṃ śakyate bādhitum |
tenāsya maṅguratāmavyavasthāsam |
yastvakena bādhyate, śakyo'sau anyenāpi bādhitumiti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
liṅgavākyoḥ liṅgaṃ balīya iti |
kutaḥ ? arthaviprakarṣāt |
ko'tra arthaviprakarṣaḥ ? prakaraṇavataḥ saṃnidhau āgnānāt darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ mantra ityava- gamyate |
'tasmin sīda' iti puroḍāsāsādanābhidhāna- sāmarthyāt sādane viniyujyamāne kṛtasāmarthyaṃ mantrāmnāna- miti nāsti pramāṇam , yena upastaraṇe'pi viniyujyate |
tathā, 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomīti' itye'pi'pi prakaraṇa- sāmarthyādeva darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmāmnāyaḥ sāmarthyādevopastaraṇe viniyogāt kṛtapraya
tasyetarābhāvaṃ darśayitvā punarātadharmamupanīya itaradharma- nirākaraṇamiti anyo nirākulīkartavyaḥ |
pūrvaḥ prastāvaḥ pramāṇasadṛśāvābhyām, madhyamaḥ śaktyākhyābhyām, anyaśca dṛṣṭārthatvādeṣṭārthatvābhyāmiti vivekaḥ |
tasmāt vākyālliṅgaṃ balīya iti siddham |
(pṛ. 847-851) |
atha liṅgavākyādīnāṃ anumīyamānaśrutitvāt aviśeṣe sati kiṃkkṛtaṃ balābalamiti ? taducyate |
'ekadvitri- catuṣpañcasaptantarāṇakāritam' |
śrutyartha prati vaiṣamyaṃ liṅgadīnāmapītyate |
śrutimātrānumānāntareti hi liṅgasya śrutyarthaḥ |
vākyasya punaḥ liṅgaśrutyanumānayava- hitaḥ |
katham ? 'vācaikanaikvākyatvādihātdrācānāṃ satām |
kalpayitvā'bhidhāśakti śrutiḥ paścāt prakalpyate |
' sarvatra hi mantre kiñcideva padaṃ karmasama- vetārthaṃ vadati |
yathā 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' ityasmi- nirvapāmide |
śiṣṭāni tu akṣamavetāyābhidhāyāt- prayogādīni santi dṛśyamānekavākyatvā'nyathā'nupapattyā anumitasāmarthyābhidhānāni santi svārthamupasarjanīkṛtya tadviśiṣṭasamavetārthaprakāśanāne prayogātyarthaṃ pratipadyate |
tataśca śrutimanumāya viniyujyante |
taccāviśepe sati sarvamabhyanujñāyate |
yadā dṛśyamānekavākyatvayormantrayoḥ pṛthak pṛthak prakāśayitavyau arthau karmasamavetau dṛśyete, tadā ubhayopi bhedena prakāśakāpekṣaṇāt prakāśakasyośca prakāśyāpekṣaṇāt viniyogāya prasthite sati yasya yatra klṛptaṃ sāmarthyam, sa tatra śīghrataraṃ prāpnuvan nānyatraika- vākyatayā netuṃ śakyate |
nāpyanyameḥ tatā''gacchadathaḥ so'vakāśāṃ dadāti |
katham ? 'ekavākyatayā yāvat sāmarthyamanumīyate |
sāmarthyena śrutistāvat kalpyate viniyojikā |
' samudāye hi viniyujyamāno nāva- yatrān aviniyujya viniyoktuṃ śakyate |

soma- taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ abhiṣecanīyaprayogamadhye 'diśo'bhayaṃ rājā'bhūt iti pañcākṣān prayacchanti ' 'śaunaḥśepamākhyāpayate' iti videvānādīnāmnāya tada- nantaram ' māstasya caikaviṃśatikapālasya vaiśvadevāśrā- mikaśyāḥ agraye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' ityabhiṣecanī- yāṅgeṣu ihiviśeṣāmnāya 'apāṃ napte svāhā, ūrjaṃ napte svāhā, agne gṛhapataye svāhā iti tisra āhutī- rjuhoti' ityabhiṣecanīyāṅgomaviśeṣa āmnāyate |

prakaraṇakramayorvirodhe 'akṣairdīvyati' ityādi- videvānādīnāṃsaṃnidhānāt abhiṣecanīyākhyahomayāgāṅga- prasaktau prakaraṇāt rājasūyākhyam |
na ca abhiṣeca- nīyasyāpi phalavatvena prakaraṇaprāptyā, tasya vikṛtitvena klṛptopakāraprākṛtāṅganirakāṅkṣasya tadabhāvāt |
na ca vikṛtatvapi yat prākṛtānuvādena vaikṛtamaṅgaṃ vācinakaṃ vidhīyate yathā pṛṣṭhādi, tasyāpi vikṛtitākāṅkṣā-
yāmanivṛttāmeva vidheyatvāt tatsaṃdehasya tatpūrvabhāvitve sati pradhānottarabhāvinaḥ apūrvāṅgasya vā prakaraṇenaiva grahaṇopapatteḥ |
videvānādīnāṃ ca abhiṣecanīyottaramuktra- viṣābhiṣekapūrvabhāvitvena pāṭhāt prakaraṇagrahaṇopapatti- riti vācyam |
prākṛtānuvādena vihitasyāpyapūrvā- sya upahomavat vikṛtyākāṅkṣāyāṃ nivṛttāmeva vidhā- nāt |
yasya hi prākṛtākāryapañcatayā vaikṛtāṅgasya vidhānaṃ yathā audumbaratvaśarādeḥ; tasyaivānivṛttākāṅkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ tatsaṃdeśasya ca tatpūrvabhāvino vā pradhānottaraṅgasya vikṛ- tiprakaraṇena grahaṇam |
abhiṣecasya tu prākṛtakāryāpattatvā- bhāvāt tatpūrvapaṭhitānāṃ videvānādīnāmabhiṣecanīyaprakaraṇa- grāhyatvopapattiḥ |
vastutastu abhiṣecasya api svatantro- tpannasya prakaraṇāt rājasūyāṅgatvavagateḥ |
'māhendrasya stotraṃ pratyabhiṣicyate' ityatra pratiśabdayogena kālārthasaṃyogaḥ iti vakṣyate |
ato videvānādyabhiṣecitānāṃ sarveṣāmeva saṃnidhānādabhiṣecanīyāṅgasvaprasaktau prakaraṇa

dravyaṃ kriyārtham |
yadi prayojanavatī kriyā vyaktaṃ sā dravyeṇa nirvarta- yitavyā |
tasyā nirvartitatvādate na bhavatīti tannirvṛttaye dravyameṣitavyaṃ bhavati |
tasmāt kriyārthaṃ dravyam |
guṇaḥ śaknoti viśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ coditaṃ lakṣayitum |
lakṣite ca tena prayojanam |
viśiṣṭasya kriyāsādhanatvāt |
tasmāt so'pi dravyadvāreṇa kriyāyā upakarotīti kriyārtha eva |
saṃskāro nāma sa bhavati, yasmin jāte padārtho bhavati yogyaḥ kasyacidarthasya |
tenāpi kriyāyāṃ kartavyayāṃ prayojanamiti so'pi parārthaḥ |
tasmādravyaguṇasaṃskārāḥ parārthatvāccheṣabhūtā na tu yāgaphalapuruṣāḥ |
yāgastāva- tkartavyaḥ puruṣasya |
na hi tasminnirvartite kiñcidpara- masti kartavyam |
sa hi puruṣārthaḥ |
yadanyad dravyādi tat, tadarthaṃ tasya śeṣabhūtam |
sa tu na kiñcidbhinivartayituṃ kriyate |
phalamapi na tena kriyate |
tasmiṃstu kṛte svayameva tadbhavati |
tasminkṛte phalamasya bhavatītyeva- drabhyate |
nāsti śabdo yāgena kriyate phalamiti |
tasmā- dyāgo na śeṣabhūtaḥ kasya cidarthasya |
phalamapi na puruṣaṃ pratyupadiśyate |
yaḥ svargaṃ kāmayate sa yāgaṃ kuryāditye- tāvacchabdenopadiśyate, nā''tmanaḥ parasya veti |
svargaṃ praticchāmātreṇa svargakāma iti bhavati |
tasmāt puruṣaṃ prati guṇābhāvena na śrūyate svargaḥ |
tasmātso'pi na śeṣabhūtaḥ |
na cet phalayāgau guṇābhāvena codhyete, kasya puruṣaḥ pradhānabhūto bhavati |
pratyakṣaśca dravyatvāt karme prati guṇābhāvaḥ |
tasmādravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva śeṣabhāvaṃ bādarirmene iti |
vā-- idānīṃ śeṣatvasya viṣayaṃ kathayati |
tatra bādarirmatena tāvattraya eva śeṣāḥ |
'dravyaṃ hi 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' iti svabhāvata eva śeṣabhūtaṃ niyama|
nnidhayojanatvena kevalaṃ vyāva- rtyante |
guṇo'pyaruṇādiḥ kriyāyāḥ svāsādhanabhūtadravya- paricchedasāmarthyāt utpattaiva śeṣaḥ |
tathā saṃskāro'- pyavahanyādiḥ yāgasādhanapuroḍāśādinirvṛttaye coditānāṃ brīhādīnāṃ svarūpeṇopāyatvādevatāhanāṃ yogyatvādevahatānāṃ yogyatvamāpādayan utpattaiva bhavati |
na tu yāgādā- vautpattikaṃ śeṣatvaṃ dṛśyate |
na ca śabdena codyate |
yāgastāvat saṃskārakairanuṣṭhīyate |
na cānyatra vyāpyimāno dṛśyate |
phale iti cet, na |
ciranirvṛtte yāge phale- tsitpratīteḥ |
nanu ca bhāvārthādhikaraṇe karaṇatvaṃ yāgasyo- ktam |
satyamuktaṃ na tu sādhitam |
svargakāmādhikaraṇā- dhīnasiddhinā tena nāmapadakaraṇatvamātranirākaraṇāt |
ata idānīmasiddhatvāttvenaiva karaṇatvena vyavaharati |
phalamapi yāgaṃ prati sādhyamānatvāt pradhānam, puruṣaṃ prati tvasya śeṣabhāvo naivopāyataḥ, kāmyamānatvena sutarāṃ pradhānatvāt |
puruṣa eva tu kāmaṃ dravyatyāge guṇatvena syāt |
tasmādravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva śeṣabhāva iti |
kamaṇyapi jaiminiḥ phalārthatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- jaiministu khalvācāryaḥ karmāṇyapi śeṣabhūtāni manyate sma, na bādarirvādhāraṇamāmanyamene |
sa hi darśa, na yāgaḥ kartavyatayā codyate |
phalakāmasya tu tatsādhanopāyatveneti |
evaṃ śruto'rthaḥ parigṛhīto bhaviṣyati, arthāśraupadeśaḥ |
enamevārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhe'dhyāye sūtrai- reva sādhayiṣyati |
iha tu tatsiddhenaiva phalārthatvena śeṣa- bhāvaṃ yāgasyā''pādayati sma |
tasmādanavadhāraṇā, dravya- guṇasaṃskārāḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ, yāge'pi śeṣabhūtaḥ phalaṃ pravatīti |
vā-- gatārthametat |
phalaṃ ca puruṣārthatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- phalamapi puruṣaṃ pratyupadiśyate |
yaḥ svargo me bhavedityevaṃ kāmayate tasya yāgaḥ |
na yaḥ svargaḥ sa ātmānaṃ lamete |
kutaḥ ? ātmanepadaprayogāt |
karma- bhiprāye etadravati |
kriyāphalamamubhet kathaṃ puruṣa iti yāgaḥ prayujyate |
tasmāt phalaṃ puruṣārthaṃ yāgāt śrūyate, nā''tmanirvṛttyartham |
tasmāccheṣabhūtam |
vā-- kāmapadopādānādeva phalasya puruṣārthatvaṃ gamyate |
na hi kaściduddiṣṭāpyakāryaṃ kāmayate svargaṃ ātmānaṃ labhatāmiti |
kiṃ tarhi ? mamopabhogyaḥ syāditi |
punaścā''tmanepadanirdeśāt karturevopabhogyo nānyasya iti gamyate |
tenopabhokkāraṃ prati phalamapi śeṣabhūtam |
puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- puruṣo''pyaudumbarīsaṃmānādiṣu guṇabhūtaḥ śrūyate |
tassādanavadhāraṇeṣā dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣu śeṣatvaṃ bādarirmene iti |
athedānīmata bhagavān vṛttikāraḥ pari- niścitāya |
dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva niyato yaji prati śeṣabhāvaḥ, āpekṣika itareṣām |
yāgasya dravyaṃ prati pradhānabhāvaḥ, phalaṃ prati guṇabhāvaḥ |
phalasya yāgaṃ prati prādhānyam, puruṣaṃ prati guṇatā |
puruṣasya phalaṃ prati pradhānatā, audumbarīsaṃmānādi prati guṇatvam |
tasmāt samatā''vadhāraṇā, dravyaguṇasaṃskārā yāgaṃ prati niyogato guṇabhūtā eveti |
mī. ko. 370 vā-- puruṣo'pi yajetetyākhyātena guṇabhūta ākṣitaḥ |
audumbarīsaṃmānādau vihita iti śeṣaḥ |
evaṃ catuḥsūtreṇā- dhikaraṇena samastaḥ śeṣatvaviṣayaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
atra codyate |
yattāvat 'dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣu' ityatra 'na tu yāgaphalapuruṣeṣu śeṣatvam' ityabhidhāyānte puruṣa śeṣi- tvanirākaraṇaṃ tadasaṃbhavam |
yattu 'pratyakṣaśca dravyatvātkarma prati guṇabhāvaḥ' iti, tadapi vyāhataṃ punaruktaṃ ca, pūrva- mevābhihitatvāt |
na ca yāgaphalābhyāṃ śeṣatvanirākaraṇa- vadatryā sahāyātulyapravṛttitvāduccāraṇaṃ yuktam |
tasmādade- tat |
yadyadhikaraṇasamāsāduktam 'athedānīmatra bhagavān vṛttikāraḥ pariniścityāya' iti, tadapi prathamameva dravya- guṇasaṃskārāṇāṃ nirapekṣatvenābhidhānāt karmaphalapuruṣāṇāṃ ca dravyādīni prati prādhānye''vasite sūtraireva parasparapekṣa- śeṣatvapratipādanāduktārthamiti mandaphalaṃ dṛśyate |
tenaivaṃ parihartavyam |
athādhikaraṇasya vyākhyānadvayaṃ kṛtam |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvat svamatena 'śeṣaḥ parārthatvāt' ityabhihite bādarimatamupakāralakṣaṇaśeṣatvābhiprāyeṇa dravyaguṇasaṃskāre- bveva śeṣatvamityevaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtya jaiminimatameva siddhānta- tvena varṇayati |
tathā ca pūrvatra dṛṣṭophārānukamameva bhāṣye dṛśyate |
tatra ca puruṣasya dravyatvāt pratyakṣameva kriyānivṛttihetutvādiṣṭameva śeṣatvam |
yāgaphalostu na kiñcit pratyakṣaṃ sādhanatvamupalabhyate ityaupaśaulvam |
yattu na yāgaphalapuruṣeṣviti trayāṇāmapi bhāṣye saṃkīrtanam, na tat prakṛtaśeṣapadānuṣaṅgādeva kalpayitavyaṃ na teṣāṃ śeṣatvamiti |
kiṃ tarhi ? yatsiddhānta- vādisaṃmataṃ tatra bhavatītyevaṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
sarvatra hi pūrvapakṣavādinā siddhāntavādinaṃ pratiṣeddhavyaṃ na yatkiñcit |
śeṣatvameva hi asau tadabhipraitemeveti prati- ṣedhati, na svarūpamātreṇa |
siddhāntavādinamantaṃ yaduta yāgaphalapuruṣāṇāṃ dvayākāratvaṃ kiñcidapekṣya śeṣatvaṃ kiñci- dapekṣya śeṣatvamititi, tad bādarimatanusārī bhāṣyakāraḥ pratiṣedhati, na tu yāgaphalapuruṣeṣu siddhāntavādisaṃmataṃ vyākāratvam |
yāgaphalorekāntainaiva śeṣatvāt puruṣasya cātyantaśeṣatvāt |
sarvathā
etāvatā tuthyadharmatvāt saha nirdeśaḥ |
‘karmaṇyapi jaiminiḥ’ ityādibhirantarṇītadharmākārameva śeṣatvaṃ prati- pāditam, pārārthyalakṣaṇaśeṣatvāṅgīkaraṇāt |
nanvevaṃ sati puruṣasya dravyatvāt pūrvapakṣadanirvaivābhyupagamya śeṣatvam, śeṣatve nirākṛte siddhāntavādinā tadeva pratipādanīya- miti na vaktavyaṃ ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ iti |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
tena hi yāgaphalyoraśeṣatvāttasya śeṣitvaṃ nirākṛtam |
tataśca yāvadeva satradvayena yāgaphalyoḥ śeṣatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ tāvadeva yāgopasarjanaṃ phalaṃ prati pradhānatvādbhū prati kevalaṃ śeṣitvameva prasaktamiti dvayākāratve punaḥ śeṣatvapratiprasavādyucyate ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ iti |
athavā paropakāradvāreṇa śeṣatvamabhyupagamya, tadayuktaṃ manyamānaḥ phalayāgayorevāsthyāpi pārārthyakṛtameveti prati- pādayiṣyāha ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ na tadupakāritvā- diti |
vṛttikāramatena sūtracatuṣṭayamanyathā vyākhyāsyāha ‘athavā bhagavān’ iti |
naivedānīṃ bādarimaṃta pūrvapakṣaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? ‘śeṣaḥ pārārthyāt’ iti sāmānyena lakṣaṇa- muktvā tasyaiva viṣayapradarśanadvāreṇa prapañcaḥ kriyate |
tatra pūrvavyākhyāyāṃ dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva śeṣatvamityeva- mavadhāraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣe kṛtam |
idānīṃ tu siddhāntatvenaiva bādarimaṃtapratiṣedhanāmataṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇaprapañcābhyāṃ śeṣatvaṃ varṇayiṣyate |
dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣu śeṣatvamevetyavadhārayati |
ataśca dravyaguṇasaṃskārāḥ śeṣatvena niyatāḥ |
śeṣitvaṃ na pratipadyante |
śeṣatvaṃ punaraniyatatvāt yāgaphalapuruṣeṣya- syeveti tatpratipādanāyanthyasūtratathākalpyate |
tasmādā- pekṣikaśeṣopalakṣaṇamātramevaitat sūtraiḥ pratipādyate |
tathā ca bhāṣye darśitam |
tataśca dviprakāra eṣa śeṣaviṣayo naiyamika āpekṣikaścetyubhavati |
nanu ca dravyaguṇasaṃskāraṇāmapi svājñani prati pradhānatvādvā prati guṇādāpekṣikameva śeṣaśeṣitvam |
tathā hi ‘vrīhīdīnāṃ pradhānatvamava- ghātādiṣu sthitam |
musalādīnyapekṣyaivamavaghāta- pradhānatā |
’ vrīhyādayo hyavaghātādīn prati pradhāna- bhūtāḥ, puroḍāśanirvṛttiṃ prati guṇāḥ |
tathā guṇāḥ saṃkhyādiḥ saṃkhyaiyaṃ prati paricchedāccheṣaḥ |
yeṣāṃ tu guṇānāṃ niṣpādyā sā tān prati śeṣiṇī |
tathā saṃskāraḥ saṃmārgāghātādiribhyādeḥ śeṣaḥ, khasādha- nānāmidhmasannahanolūkhalamusalādīnāṃ śeṣī |
tasmāttvā- dhāraṇaṃ siddhīti |

‘dravyāderyatra śeṣatvaṃ tatra naivāsti śeṣitā |
phalayāgarāṇāṃ tu vyākāratvaṃ parasparam |
’ dravyaguṇasaṃskārā hi phalavantaṃ yāgaṃ prati niyogataḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ |
satyāpi svājñani prati śeṣitve taṃ prati nāstītyamidhīyate |
ata eva bhāṣyakāro'pi ‘niyogato yaṃji prati śeṣa- bhāvaḥ’ ityāha, na bravīti ‘niyataḥ śeṣabhāvaḥ’ iti |
‘āpekṣika itareṣāma’ ityatrāpi yaṃji pratīya- nuvartate |
tathā hyekasya dvau dvau prati guṇatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca dṛśyate |
yāgasya tāvad dravyātmakaṃ nirvartakaṃ puruṣaṃ prati prādhānyam, phalaṃ prati guṇatā |
yaśca phalaṃ prati guṇaḥ sa śakyate phalasya svāminaṃ puruṣamapi prati sutarāṃ guṇa iti vaktum |
tathā yasya puruṣaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ tasya tadupa- sarjanaṃ phalaṃ prati śrutā tadapi śakyanirūpam |
evaṃ phalasya yāgaṃ prati prādhānyattsādhanaṃ puruṣamapi prati prādhā- nyam, puruṣaṃ prati guṇatvādanuṣṭheye yāge'pi guṇatvam |
tathā puruṣasya phale prati prādhānyāttatsādhanaṃ yāgamapi prati pradhānatvam |
yāgaṃ ca prati guṇābhāvāttasyāsya phale- 'pi guṇatvam |
natvevaṃ dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣviti viśeṣaḥ |
yaccidaṃ pārārthyeṇāpi śeṣatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ coktam, idamartha- lakṣaṇaṃ vastumātraspeṇaivagantavyam |

bādha:
bādhabhedaḥ 2960 bādhabhedanirūpaṇam
iti |
pṛ. 138-139, aprāptabādhabhedāḥ śāstrīyāḥ kramaprāmāṇya śruti-artha-pāṭha-sthāna-mukhya-pravṛttiṣu |
śrutiḥ ādīnāṃ bādhate iti 5 bādhabhedāḥ |
arthena pāṭhādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ bādhāta 4 bādhabhedāḥ |
pāṭhena sthānādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ bādhāta 3 bādhabhedāḥ |
sthānena mukhya-pravṛttyoḥ bādhāta 2 bādhabhedā |
mukhyena pravṛtteḥ bādhāta 1 bādhabhedaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ udāharaṇāni tu na santi |
pṛ. 136, aprāptabādhabhedāḥ śāstrīyāḥ |
śrutyā liṅgādīni pañca bādhyante |
liṅgena vākyādīni catvāri |
vākyena prakaraṇādīni trīṇi |
prakaraṇena kramādidvayam |
krameṇa samākhyā iti |
tathā - śrutyādiṣu dvābhyāṃ pramāṇabhyām, ekaḥ śeṣaḥ dvayoḥ śeṣiṇoḥ viniyujyate tatra durbalatvena bādhaḥ iti 5 medāḥ |
evaṃ ekasmin śeṣiṇi dvayoḥ śeṣayoḥ pramāṇadvayena viniyoge prabalatvena durbalasya bādhaḥ iti 5 militvā 10 pṛ. 134, aprāpta-bādhabhedāḥ 7 śāstrīyāḥ |
1 śrutyā śrutiḥ asaṃdigdhayā saṃdigdhā, 3 liṅgena liṅgam, 4 vākyena vākyam, 5 prakaraṇena prakaraṇam, 6 krameṇa kramaḥ, 7 samākhyāyā samākhyā |
ete ca sapta śeṣaśeṣibhedena dviguṇā bhavanti |
pṛ. 135, aprāptabādhabhedāḥ śāstrīyāḥ smṛtyā |
śrutiprabhavayā smṛtyā liṅgādisāmyātprabhavā smṛtiḥ bādhyate |
atra śrutiliṅgādīnāṃ bādhānāṃ pañcadaśabhedatvāt tattanmūlakasmṛtiviṣaye'pi 15 eva medā bhavanti |
30 medāḥ |
pṛ. 140, aprāptabādhabhedāḥ śāstrīyāḥ smṛtyācārasaṃbaddhāḥ ṣaṭ, ātmasmṛtyā anātmasmṛtiḥ bādhyate, avigītasmṛtyā vigītasmṛtiḥ, adṛṣṭārthasmṛtyā dṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ, āsācāāreṇa anāsācāraḥ, avigītā-cāreṇa vigītācāraḥ, adṛṣṭārthena ācāreṇa dṛṣṭārtha ācāraḥ |
bāla, pṛ. 139. bādhabhedanirūpaṇam ( te ca medāḥ 559 bhavanti ) |
bādho nivṛttiḥ anuṣṭhānaṃ iti yāvat |
sa ca dvividhaḥ; prāptabādhaḥ aprāptabādhaśceti |
yatra atideśā-mānyaśāstrādijanite jñāne aṃśe sarvaviṣaye vā 'mithyedaṃ'
iti pratyāyantaraṃ bhavati sa prāptabādhaḥ |
yatra tu liṅgādau śrutikalpanāpratibandhāt jñānotpattireva pratibadhyate asau aprāptabādhaḥ iti |
anayormadhye pūrvo miśraḥ : 'prameyā-pahāralakṣaṇo bādhaḥ' ityādi vyavahṛtaḥ |
uttaraśca 'mūle-cchedalakṣaṇaḥ' ityapi |
tatra prāptabādho'pi dvividho nityo vaikalpikaśca |
tatra nityastāvat ekaviṃśati-bhedaḥ |
tadyathā [1] pratyakṣena tadābhāso bādhyate |
[2] anumānena tadābhāsaḥ |
[3] śabdena tadā-bhāsaḥ |
[4] upamānena tadābhāsaḥ |
[5] arthāpatyā tadābhāsaḥ |
[6] amāvena tadābhāsaḥ |
ete ṣaṭ laukikā bādhāḥ |
atha śāstrīyāḥ |
[1] nityaṃ naimittikene, yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'pañcadaśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt' iti nityaṃ pāñca
bādhabhedanirūpaṇam
pāṭhena mukhyakramatvāde tadudāharaṇaṃ 'prakṛtau tu svaśabdatvāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|8|16) uktam|
abhīṣomīyanirvāpaḥ ājyanirvāpottaraṃ mukhyakramāt prāptaḥ auṣadhanirvāpatvena ājyanirvāpāt prāk pāṭhastathaiva kāryaḥ iti|
mukhya- krameṇa pravṛttikramatvāde 'avadānābhighāraṇāsādana- ṣānupūrvye pravṛttyā syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|2|4) uktam|
sāṃnāyyadharmā hi pūrve pravṛttāḥ paścādāgneyadharmāḥ, pradānaṃ tu āgneyasya prathamam, paścāt sāṃnāyyasya tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdavadānam|
prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇaṃ vedyāmāsādanaṃ tu sāṃnāyyasya pūrvaṃ pravṛttikramāt prāptam, mukhyakramāttu āgneyasya pūrvaṃ kāryamiti |
evaṃ pañcadaśānāṃ bādhānāṃ madhye arthena pāṭhabādhaḥ, pāṭhena sthānabādhaḥ, pāṭhena mukhya- bādhaḥ, mukhyena pravṛttibādha ityeteṣāṃ caturṇāṃ bādhabhedānā- mudāharaṇāni catvāri caturbhirdhikaraṇeṣu viśeṣata udāhṛtā- nyuktāni|
ādyabādhabhedodāharaṇaṃ ca 'kramakopa'rthaśabdā- bhyām' iti jaimininaiva kṛtvācintayopanibaddhamuktam |
itareṣāṃ tu daśānāṃ bādhabhedānāmudāharaṇāni anupalabdham pañcame noktāni asābhibhraṃśitaṃ |
śrutyādiṣu ca śruti- liṅgādivat sajātīyānāmnāpi anyonyabādhaḥ śrutyoḥ, arthayoḥ, sthānayoḥ, mukhyayoḥ, pravṛttyośca ityevaṃvidhāḥ udāharaṇasaṃbhavāt pañcame na cintitāḥ |
pāṭhostu vidhi- mantragatayormantragato balavān ityuktaṃ 'mantrastu virodhe syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|9|16) agnīṣomīyanirvāpaṇaṃ prāk paṭhitam, paścādāgneyabrāhmaṇam, mantrakāṇḍe tu prāgā- gneya yājyānuvākyāyugalam, tato'gnīṣomīyasya, tatra mantrapāṭhakrameṇa vidhipāṭhakramabādhāt āgneyaḥ pūrvamagneyaḥ paścādāgnīṣomīyaḥ iti|
te ete ṣoḍaśa bādhabhedāḥ pūrvoktairdvipaṣṭisthaiḥ bādhabhedaiḥ saha aṣṭasaptatiḥ aprāpta- bādhabhedāḥ siddhāḥ |
tathā śrutyā smṛtirbādhyate|
yathā- 'audumbarī spṛṣṭvodgāyet' iti śrutyā 'audumbarī sarvā veṣṭa- yitavyā' iti smṛtiḥ |
tathā śrutyā ācāro bādhyate|
yathā- apavādaprayogarūpa ācāraḥ 'tasmād brāhmaṇena na mlecchitavai' iti niṣedharūpayā śrutyā |
tathā smṛtyā- 'pi ācāro bādhyate|

'aṅkuro'pimanovṛddhi' ityamaraḥ |
bījaṃ vinā nāṅkuro jāyate, aṅkuraṃ vinā ca bījotpattiriti |
evaṃ yatra parasparakāryakāraṇabhāva- statrāyaṃ nyāyaḥ pravartate |
tathā ca bījajātīyaṃ pratya- ṅkurajātīyam, aṅkurajātīyaṃ ca prati bījajātīyaṃ na kāraṇam |
ato bījāṅkurapravāhānāditvā ca yadījaṃ prati yadaṅkurasya kāraṇatvaṃ tadaṅkuraṃ prati tadījasya na kāraṇatvato nānyonyāśrayaḥ |
evaṃ ca prāmāṇikatvāt gṛhyate, yatra ca prāmāṇikatvaṃ tatra nānāditvakalpaneti |
prāmāṇikapravāhasyaiva anāditvakalpanā, nānyasyeti siddhāntāt sūcitaṃ ca |
tathā ca śārīrakabhāṣye 'tatkṛtadharmādharmanimittaṃ śarīratvamiti cet, śarīra- saṃbandhasya dharmādharmayostatkṛtatvasya cetaretarāśrayatvaprasaṅgā- danyaparamparevaiṣā kalpanā' iti |
'ātmanaḥ śarīrasaṃbandhe jāte dharmādharmotpattiḥ, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ saṃvandharūpajanmametya- nyonyāśrayādekasyāsiddhyā dvitīyasyāsiddheḥ' syāditi pariharati- netyādinā |
na tvetadehajanyadharmādharmakarmaṇa etadehasaṃbandhahetutve syādanyonyāśrayaḥ |
pūrvadehakarmaṇa etadehasaṃbandhotpattiḥ, pūrvadehasya tatpūrvadehakarmaṇaḥ, tadehasaṃbandhotpattiḥ tatpūrvadehakṛtakarmaṇa iti bījāṅkura- vadanāditvānna doṣa ityata āha- anyeti |
